Job Description:

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

Process Overview

Our Global Banking & Markets division serves mid- to large-sized corporations and institutional clients worldwide. It is comprised of Business Banking, Global Commercial Banking, Global Corporate & Investment Banking, Global Markets and Wholesale Credit. Aligned with these client-facing groups are Global Capital Markets and Global Research. TWO is the process initiative aiming at enhancing the synergy between users and technology. Connects have been happening across users to ideate, develop and implement the ideas from ML, productivity enhancements.

Job Description: -

Responsible for developing and delivering software requirements to accomplish business goals. Ensures that software is developed to meet functional, non-functional, and compliance requirements. Codes solutions, unit tests, and ensures the solution can be integrated successfully into the overall application/system with clear, robust and well-tested interfaces. Familiar with development and testing practices of the bank. Contributes to story refinement/defining requirements. Participates and guides team in estimating work necessary to realize a story/requirement through the delivery lifecycle. Performs spike/proof of concept as necessary to mitigate risk or implement new ideas. Codes solutions and unit tests to deliver a requirement/story per the defined acceptance criteria and compliance requirements Utilizes multiple architectural components (across data, application, business) in design and development of client requirements. Assists team with resolving technical complexities involved in realizing story work. Helps in fine tuning the system from performance standpoint and manages system administration functions. Helps in efficient running of lower environment and production environment including contributing to upgrades. Contributes to existing test suites (integration, regression, performance); Analyzes test reports, identifies any test issues/errors; Triages the underlying cause. Documents and communicates required information for deployment, maintenance, support, and business functionality. Participates, contributes and can coach team members in the delivery/release (CI-CD) events. e.g. branching timelines, pull requests, issue triage, merge/conflict resolution, release notes

Responsibilities

- Overall responsibility for the governance and oversight of the Enterprise Software Development Lifecycle (eSDLC). Supports & guide AML team in applying best practices throughout the analysis, estimation, design, and deployment of new software and systems.

- Individual is responsible for end-to-end ownership of the architecture and design of the PEGA PRPC implementation or Pega packaged solutions like Pega CLM implementation

- Technical design for the Pega implementation based on the Business process defined with the Overall ownership of the technical design document for the program

- Rule set design and governance to ensure the rule sets are developed appropriately in the respective layers to align with ‘enterprise’s re-usability’ needs

- Perform code reviews and ensure the solution is compliance with Pega guardrails with a healthy guardrail score, review alert logs

- Devise rule set versioning strategy, branching strategy and Manage rule set versioning, release management and the deployment processes.

- Review Infrastructure requirements, Sizing and Estimation

- Work with the administration and development teams to ensure that designs effectively accommodate long-term maintainability, supportability, robustness, and scalability of software solutions

- Keep abreast of patches including minor and major version releases

- Regular deployments from non-production through production environments

- Evaluating merits and risks of upgrades; coordinating with appropriate staff to execute patches to deployed applications; monitoring day-to-day operational health of deployed applications

- Responsible for maintaining operational health of PEGA application

- Responsible for updating appropriate system level documentation and knowledge base documentation

- Advise development team on performance improving solutions

- Act as an application manager for ensuring the appropriate enterprise requirements are managed for a risk-free environment

- Ability to juggle multiple demands and reprioritize as necessary to align with changing business objectives

- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

- Excellent listener, with a positive and collaborative attitude who possesses skills in conflict-resolution, behavior influencing and leadership

- Must have the ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Self-Motivated and induce positivity across organization.

Requirements

- Education- B.E./ B Tech / M.E./M Tech; M.C.A [with B.Sc., B Com, BBM] ; M.Sc. (Computer Science, IT, S/W, Mathematics, Electronics, Physics, Statistics)

- Certifications if any- CSA, CSSA, LSA(Optional)

- Experience Range- 8 -11 years of experience in PEGA

Foundational skills:

- Experience in Pega PRPC -Process Flows, Activities, Harness, Sections, Decision Table, Data transforms, Agent and activity, Reporting

- Should have PCSSA (Pega Certified Senior System Architect) certification, CLSA good to have

- Should have hands on experience in end-to-end PRPC lifecycle - design, development, coding, testing and debugging skills in PEGA 8.x

- Expertise in PRPC Integration with external systems in an enterprise environment.

- Knowledgeable in Estimation, Performance Tuning and Deployment process.

- Strong Troubleshooting and performance optimization skills

- Experience in adopting Pega applications with CICD tools.

- Preferred to have experience with distributed development teams which span multiple geographies, time zones and cultures

- Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills

- Ability to drive collaboration and manage conflict

- Ability to adapt to frequent changes

Desired Skills

- Experience in Case Management, Client Life cycle Management (CLM) a plus

- Experience in SQL, Performance insights

- Experience in J2EE application development is a plus

- Experience in RPA, AI, ML, NLP is a plus

- Pega LSA (Lead System Architect) is a Plus.

Work Timings- 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Job Location- Hyderabad / Mumbai

The Applications Development Intermediate Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.

Responsibilities:

- Utilize knowledge of applications development procedures and concepts, and basic knowledge of other technical areas to identify and define necessary system enhancements, including using script tools and analyzing/interpreting code

- Consult with users, clients, and other technology groups on issues, and recommend programming solutions, install, and support customer exposure systems

- Apply fundamental knowledge of programming languages for design specifications.

- Analyze applications to identify vulnerabilities and security issues, as well as conduct testing and debugging

- Serve as advisor or coach to new or lower-level analysts

- Identify problems, analyze information, and make evaluative judgements to recommend and implement solutions

- Resolve issues by identifying and selecting solutions through the applications of acquired technical experience and guided by precedents

- Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.

- Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.

- Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.

- Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

- Independently exercise judgement and decision-making in managing day-to-day responsibilities, including evaluating complex situations, resolving issues, and determining appropriate courses of action. Drive and influence delivery of work within area of responsibility, contributing to operational priorities and ensuring progress against timelines. Will be accountable for delivery outcomes, including quality and timelines, and may have a measurable impact on business results within scope. In addition, will provide oversight on execution by reviewing outputs, guiding approach where required, and addressing gaps to ensure delivery meets expected standards. Take ownership of decisions and deliverables within remit, applying analytical thinking and professional expertise to solve problems and ensure effective outcomes.

- Support execution of business decisions within the function by translating direction into actionable steps and ensuring effective follow‑through. Address non‑routine situations and practical challenges by applying judgement to identify solutions or take decisions within scope. Will support effective functioning of the business area by ensuring processes are implemented consistently and outputs meet expected standards. Operate across varied and evolving situations, exercising discretion to respond to changing requirements and priorities, while ensuring reliability, timeliness, and quality in execution within defined scope.

- Applies domain expertise and advanced analytical capability to deliver outputs aligned with established standards and professional benchmarks. Evaluate business requirements by analyzing complex issues, forming well‑reasoned views, and recommending practical, implementable solutions. Apply structured thinking, analytical rigor, and creativity in approaching work, particularly in situations where standard methodologies may require refinement. Exercise sound professional judgement in interpreting requirements and determining appropriate courses of action, taking into account the broader business context and potential implications.

Qualifications:

- 5+ years of relevant experience in the Financial Service industry

- 4-6 years of experience in application development or systems engineering within complex environments

- Advanced Pega Developer Skills , CSA and above

- Proven Experience in Pega 24.x , 25.x versions

- Mandatory experience in Delinquency Management functions In Credit Card / Loans domain

- Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes, deploying and operating containerized services Experience in migration of Pega workloads from VM to OSE platform is desirable

- Hands on experience with databases , particularly Oracle , MongoDB

- Familiarity with prompt engineering, model integration patterns, and AI governance considerations in enterprise environments.

- Intermediate level experience in Applications Development role

- Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication

- Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making skills

- Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements

Education:

- Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer – Pega Development

Location: Bangalore

Business & Team:

CBA has a vision of building a brighter future for all.

Our team brings together Pega engineers, technical specialists and experienced leaders. We partner closely with ASB (Auckland Savings Bank, NZ) to design and deliver secure, scalable enterprise solutions that support key business outcomes.

Impact & Contribution:

As a Senior Software Engineer – Pega Development, you will design, build, test and support secure, scalable enterprise applications using Pega, working within an Agile squad to deliver reliable customer and business outcomes.

You will translate requirements into well-designed Pega solutions, develop reusable components and integrations, apply engineering standards, troubleshoot production issues, and contribute to continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Pega Application Development: Design, develop, test and deploy Pega applications and enhancements within an Agile squad.

Solution Design: Translate business requirements and solution designs into secure, scalable and maintainable Pega configurations and code.

Case Management & Integrations: Build and support integrations, reusable components, case management workflows and user experiences.

Engineering Best Practices: Apply Pega development, deployment, security, performance and engineering best practices.

Testing & Deployment: Participate in code and design reviews, automated testing, release activities and production support.

Production Support: Investigate incidents, defects, vulnerabilities and performance issues, and implement sustainable fixes.

Continuous Improvement: Share knowledge with engineers and contribute to continuous improvement of squad delivery practices.

Essential Skills:

Pega Development Experience:

- 5+ years of hands-on Pega development experience delivering enterprise applications.

- Pega Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA) certification, or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience across analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and production support.

- Strong understanding of Pega case management, data modelling, rules, user interface, security and application architecture.

Integration & Engineering:

- Good understanding of enterprise integration patterns, APIs, services and troubleshooting.

- Ability to apply knowledge of technology stacks to solve business problems and articulate technical trade-offs.

- Working knowledge of Agile delivery methods, CI/CD, source control, automated testing and secure engineering practices.

Pega Platforms & Frameworks:

- Experience with Pega Cloud, Constellation, or frameworks such as KYC/CLM, Smart Disputes/Investigate, Customer Service or AIM.

Collaboration & Communication:

- Strong communication and collaboration skills across business and technical audiences.

- Ability to collaborate with product, business, architecture, testing and operations stakeholders to resolve delivery challenges.

- Ability to contribute to peer reviews, knowledge sharing, engineering guardrails and continuous improvement across the squad.

Education Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer Science/Information Technology.

Job Title: Staff Software Engineer

Impact & Contribution:

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer with strong hands-on engineering and architecture experience across Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices and cloud-native platforms, complemented by expertise in Pega and enterprise workflow/case management solutions.

You will play a key technical leadership role in designing and modernising large-scale applications, building resilient services and integration capabilities, and evolving our platforms towards modern cloud-native architectures. The ideal candidate brings a strong software engineering and product mindset, is comfortable working across Java-based services and Pega applications, and can make pragmatic architectural decisions across distributed systems, APIs, data, cloud and workflow platforms.

Knowledge of AI fundamentals, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions is highly regarded. As a Staff Engineer, you will remain hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers and influencing engineering standards and architecture across teams.

Roles & Responsibilities:

- Lead the architecture, design and delivery of Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices and Pega solutions, ensuring scalable, resilient, secure and maintainable enterprise applications.

- Drive application modernisation and cloud-native engineering, including legacy decomposition, API enablement, AWS migration, containers/Kubernetes/ECS, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and DevSecOps.

- Define architectural boundaries and integration patterns across Pega, Java services, enterprise platforms and external systems, determining when capabilities should be implemented in Pega versus custom services.

- Establish and champion strong engineering practices covering clean code, API design, automated testing, security, observability, performance, production readiness, code/design reviews and troubleshooting.

- Provide technical leadership and mentoring across engineering teams, collaborate with product and architecture stakeholders, and enable appropriate adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within enterprise applications.

Essential Skills:

- 12–18 years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership across complex enterprise platforms and architecture-level decision-making.

- Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices and distributed systems, including RESTful APIs, enterprise integration, concurrency, resiliency, scalability, performance and troubleshooting.

- Strong experience with relational/NoSQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB, along with authentication and application security including OAuth2, JWT and OWASP principles.

- Hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-native engineering, including ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway, IAM, Secrets Manager and CloudWatch, as well as Docker and Kubernetes.

- Strong experience with CI/CD, DevSecOps and infrastructure automation, including GitHub Actions/Jenkins, Terraform/CDK, automated testing, code quality, secrets management and production observability.

- Hands-on experience designing and delivering Pega enterprise applications, with strong knowledge of case management, workflows, data/integration patterns, security, performance and application architecture; Pega LSA or equivalent architecture-level experience is highly regarded.

- Experience with modern Pega capabilities, including Constellation, Blueprint, App Signature and Pega GenAI features, is highly regarded.

- Ability to make architecture decisions across custom Java development, APIs/microservices and Pega low-code capabilities, selecting the appropriate technology for each business problem; TypeScript and modern front-end experience is desirable.

- Knowledge of AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures, with exposure to agent design/orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LangSmith, OpenAI/Bedrock Agent SDKs, CrewAI or AutoGen desirable.

Job Title: Pega Technical Architect

Department: ISPL, CIB IT

About Business Line/Function

Securities services department of CIB

Position Purpose

A Pega technical architect to take leadership role on application development and maintenance.

The position requires working in a virtual team and international environment and is multidisciplinary in nature. It involves coordination with other locations and divisions of BNP Paribas as necessary. It is important that the candidate should have some financial products knowledge along with analytical skills and attention to details.

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

- To constantly review and ensure that the technical quality of the application is of sufficient quality, ensure any issues are scheduled to be fixed.

- To be aware of non-functional requirements, ensure that implemented code is robust, maintainable, secure and efficient.

- To ensure technical documentation is created as appropriate, technical documentation should exist for all tasks or group of tasks over a certain level of complexity.

- To analyse and review technical specifications/implementations from junior members of the team.

- To coach and mentor junior members of the team.

- To work through the backlog of tasks as appropriate.

- To clarify precisely what actions the program is intended to perform when there is ambiguity

- To devise solutions to problems

- To work as a team to design and develop parts of the system

- To be aware of the business domain the software is being created for

- To follow technical architecture standards where applicable

- To work closely with testers and business analysts to ensure software functions as expected

- To be involved in support if a major problem in production arises

- To participate in out-of-hours / daytime support as required

- To escalate risks / issues to IT management

- Designing an Enterprise Class Structure for the application.

- Workflow Design and understanding of tool’s capabilities.

- Internal/External Services Integration.

Contributing Responsibilities

- Able to prepare the status reports for weekly updates with stakeholders

- Communication with Stakeholders, Business Analysts, End-users, and various teams like Higher Management, Development, Systems, Support, Implementation etc.

- Able to prepare the technical and functional documents for the project activities.

- Contribute towards innovation, suggest new technical practices to be investigated

- Contribute towards initiatives to improve processes and delivery

- Contribute towards recruitment efforts - both for the team as well as for the organization

- Support the SMs/PMs for coordination across down/up-stream applications.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

- CPLSA (Certified Pega Lead System Architect) (Preferable to demonstrate the skills)

- Have hands on experience in PEGA V 7.1 or higher versions. (Mandatory)

- PEGA Upgrade experience (Preferable)

- SQL (Building Stored procedures, writing functions, complex queries, etc).

- Knowledge of any defect management tool (optional)

Specific Qualifications

- Minimum 15 years of experience along with Bachelor's Degree – in computer science or related field or equivalent experience

- Prior experience in similar domain would be a plus

Technical Skills

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

- Pega 15 years, Strong Fundamentals

- SQL 5 years Strong basics

- CICD Platform 1 year Github, script development

Behavioral Skills

-

- Communication

- Analytical Ability

- Team Player

Education Level: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

Location: Chennai

Experience: 15 years

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

Meet Our Team

As a member of one of the most innovative and fastest growing groups at Pega, you will work closely with talented engineers and product owners across the globe to build a highly scalable Software.

Picture Yourself At Pega

Pega is changing the way the world builds software. Our goal is to be the no. 1 CRM SaaS company in the world. At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision making across the cloud platform.

We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

What You'll Do At Pega

- Leverage best in class GenAI technology to develop Pega Platform GenAI capabilities

- Work with ML engineers to integrate Harness that powers Pega’s Agents and AI Assistant that helps Pega Developers to build Pega Rules

- Implement solutions by leveraging the strong build in capabilities in Pega platform

- Contribute to GenAI Evaluations, Observability and Guardrailing capabilities

Who You Are

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast-changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.

You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You've Accomplished

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar field

- 2–4 years of Pega software development experience

- CSA and CSSA certified

- Knowledge in Java/J2EE will be an added advantage

- Agile/Scrum development methodology knowledge/experience

- Experience using the following: Relational Databases (Oracle, Postgres), SQL, JSP, OOPS experience

Pega Offers You

- Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products

- Continuous learning and development opportunities

- An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment

- Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company

At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. - Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment

- Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle

- Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions

- Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.

- Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro-actively respond to adhoc questions

Who You Are

- Pega CLSA Certified resource must.

- You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.

- 12 plus years of Pega experience in building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions.

- Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities

- Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate

- Willingness to go the extra mile

- Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example

- Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business & IT stakeholders

- Open to work from 1:00 - 10:00 PM IST

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.

You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You've Accomplished

- You’ve built and implemented model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions and applications.

- You’ve led end-to-end delivery of medium to large component of bigger solution.

- You’ve been exposed to a variety of technologies including Application Servers, programming languages, relational and non-relational data bases and integration techniques.

- You’ve demonstrated knowledge of and applicability of Object-Oriented techniques and principles.

- You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologie

Meet Our Team

This role is part of the Sales Automation(SA) development team and works closely with the Client Advocacy team, giving you a unique blend of meaningful business impact and deep technical depth.

The Client Advocacy Program is intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Technology at Pega. We are building a best-in-class advocacy program from the ground up — designing the advocate lifecycle, streamlining reference workflows, and developing the platform that powers it all. This is a greenfield opportunity to shape how Pega engages, rewards, and grows its most strategic client relationships.

Picture Yourself At Pega

- You will be the technical backbone of a high-visibility program, building and iterating on Pega-based workflows that directly support Pega’s sales and marketing strategy.

- This is a rare opportunity to build on a greenfield platform — you will design, develop, and own the end-to-end technical implementation across multiple build phases (MLP 1, 2, and 3) through the end of 2026 and beyond.

- You will work in a small, fast-moving team where your decisions have direct impact, collaborating with business leads, legal, finance, and external agency partners to deliver a program that sets the standard for client advocacy at Pega

- At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.

- We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

What You'll Do At Pega

- Design and build Pega-based case types, workflows, and automation using Blueprint to support the Client Advocacy Program—including Reference Requests, Advocate Onboarding, Activity Logging, and Pega Points management.

- Own the technical implementation of platform build phases MLP 1, 2, and 3 (August – December 2026), including sprint planning, UAT, go/no-go gate reviews, and post-launch monitoring.

- Lead SA data migration, deduplication, and field standardisation to establish a clean, reliable advocate database ahead of go-live.

- Build test scripts and acceptance criteria; participate in go/no-go decision gates with stakeholders.

- Build and maintain reporting dashboards and KPI tracking to support monthly and quarterly readouts for VP and CMO review.

- Ensure all platform builds comply with GDPR and internal data governance and privacy standards for advocate records.

- Support change management activities alongside the Program Lead — contributing to training materials, adoption communications, and stakeholder office hours.

- Partner with the SA development team on integration architecture, maintaining a dotted-line relationship to ensure alignment with SA standards and roadmap.

Who You Are

- A technically strong platform engineer who is equally comfortable in a discovery workshop and a development sprint — you can translate business goals into platform design and explain technical constraints in plain language to a non-technical team.

- Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity: you thrive in greenfield environments where processes are still being defined and you know when to move forward and when to escalate.

- A collaborative partner who builds trust across teams with different priorities — you can manage a dotted-line relationship with the SA development team while staying aligned to the Client Advocacy team’s goals.

- Detail-oriented about data quality and process design — you understand that clean advocate data is the foundation of effective reference matching and program reporting.

- A clear and confident communicator while collaborating cross-functionally with, including legal, finance, and external agency partners, with poise in stakeholder-facing situations.

- The role sits within the Marketing function so you will become proficient in understanding what marketing needs to achieve and how it interfaces with all parts of the organization.

- You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.

- You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You've Accomplished

We're looking for someone with a genuine curiosity about how AI can enhance the way they work. You'll be encouraged to explore and experiment with AI-powered tools as part of your day-to-day, including Pega Blueprint, our AI-assisted application design platform. Whether you're streamlining a process or approaching a problem in a new way, an open and experimental mindset will serve you well in this team.

- 2–4 years of Pega Platform development experience; CSA certification required, CSSA strongly preferred.

- Hands-on experience building Pega case types, business rules, data objects, and Constellation UI.

- Experience integrating Pega with CRM or sales management platforms (Sales Automation, Salesforce, or equivalent) using Pega Connect and REST-based connectors.

- Experience building integrations between Pega and external systems using REST APIs, Pega Connect, JSON/XML data formats, and OAuth authentication. SQL experience for data auditing, deduplication, and reporting.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate for workflow automation, with basic Java and HTML sufficient for Pega activity steps and UI customisation.

- Data migration and cleansing experience — including deduplication, field mapping, and data standards definition.

- UAT planning and execution experience, including writing test scripts and acceptance criteria.

- Familiarity with GDPR and data privacy requirements as they apply to contact and customer records.

- Agile/Scrum experience; comfortable operating in cross-functional, multi-stakeholder team structures.

Nice to Have

- SharePoint administration and Microsoft Graph API familiarity.

- Experience with Power BI or equivalent reporting and dashboard tools.

- Prior experience in a customer advocacy, reference program, or sales enablement technology context.

- Exposure to change management practices and supporting end-user adoption of new platforms.

Pega Offers You

- Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.

- A high-visibility, greenfield program with direct executive exposure — your work will be presented to VP and CMO stakeholders from day one.

- Continuous learning and development opportunities, including access to Pega Academy training.

- An innovative, inclusive, agile, and collaborative work environment within a team that values craft and impact equally.

- Competitive global benefits programme inclusive of pay, bonus incentive, and employee equity in the company.

jobs.description_text:
Summary

Position Summary

Senior Software Engineer – Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) - Pega, .NET & Integration

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join Deloitte Tax in India’s Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC). In this role, you will design, build, and support scalable enterprise applications and integrations that help enable workflow automation, platform modernization, and business process transformation. The role offers the opportunity to work across Pega, .NET, APIs, microservices, and event-driven technologies in a product-led engineering environment. Experience with AI-enabled engineering, cloud technologies, and modern workflow platforms will be viewed favorably.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) team, you will be responsible for:

- Design, develop, and support workflow automation solutions using Pega, including case management, business rules, and integrations

- Build and enhance enterprise applications and services using .NET, .NET Core, C#, REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven technologies such as Kafka

- Own technical activities for assigned modules, including estimation, design, development, code review, unit testing, deployment support, and production issue resolution

- Troubleshoot production defects, improve application performance and stability, and support engineering, security, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) standards

- Collaborate with product, architecture, and delivery teams to contribute to reusable platform components, modernization efforts, and mentoring of junior engineers

The team

The Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) is the product organization responsible for the technology platforms that support Deloitte Tax’s Global Employer Services practice. The team helps enable tax, immigration, payroll, and mobility services through workflow automation, enterprise integration, and platform engineering. Professionals in this group work on technology solutions that help modernize tax operations in a global environment.

Location: Hyderabad

Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM

Qualifications

Required:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a comparable discipline

- 8-12 years of experience in software development for enterprise applications

- Experience with Pega platform development, including workflow, case management, business rules, and integrations

- Experience with .NET, .NET Core, and C# development

- Experience building integrations using REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven technologies such as Kafka

- Experience with SQL and data design, analysis, or handling

- Experience supporting production applications, including debugging, defect resolution, and performance optimization

Preferred:

- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a comparable discipline

- Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) services and cloud-native development patterns

- Experience with artificial intelligence-enabled engineering, data engineering, or Python-based solution development

- Experience implementing generative artificial intelligence or agentic artificial intelligence solutions using Pega or similar technologies

- Experience with ServiceNow, Appian, Salesforce, or other workflow or low-code platforms

- Pega certification such as Lead System Architect (LSA) or progress toward certification

Our purpose

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) - Lead Software Engineer I

Role Overview: As an Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.

Key Responsibilities:

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.

- Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, low-level architecture and component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.

- Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.

- Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.

- Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.

- Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.

- Possess deep expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.

- Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.

- Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.

- Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The successful candidate will possess:

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

Required Qualifications:

- A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.

Prior experience with enterprise case management & low-code workforce platforms (PEGA) is important.

- 10 + years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.

- 3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).

- 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems.

- 1+ years of experience establishing engineering standards and golden paths, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards, treating the platform as a product.

- Prior experience with AI control-plane and agent-runtime patterns: model/LLM gateway, A2A and MCP integration, agent runtimes (e.g., Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore), guardrails (PII redaction, prompt-injection, content, tool permissioning/tool-RBAC), policy-as-code, and multi-tenant isolation.

- Prior experience with enterprise data platform engineering: data pipelines, self-service and data-product enablement, governance-as-code enforcement, and metadata/lineage.

- Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.

- Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, and ArgoCD to deliver high-quality platforms and products rapidly.

Other:

- Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.

- Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

jobs.description_text:
Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) - Software Specialist Engineer II

Role Overview: As an Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.

Key Responsibilities:

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.

- Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.

- Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.

- Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.

- Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.

- Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.

- Possess expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.

- Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.

- Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.

- Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The successful candidate will possess:

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

Required Qualifications:

- A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.

Prior experience with enterprise case management & low-code workforce platforms (PEGA) is important.

- 6 + years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.

- 3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).

- 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems.

- Prior experience with AI control-plane and agent-runtime patterns: model/LLM gateway, A2A and MCP integration, agent runtimes (e.g., Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore), guardrails (PII redaction, prompt-injection, content, tool permissioning/tool-RBAC), policy-as-code, and multi-tenant isolation.

- Prior experience with enterprise data platform engineering: data pipelines, self-service and data-product enablement, governance-as-code enforcement, and metadata/lineage.

Job Title - Pega Developer

Location – Bangalore

This position is only applicable for Immediate Joiners

Experience - 6 to 9 Years

About KPMG in India

KPMG entities in India are professional services firm(s). These Indian member firms are affiliated with KPMG International Limited. KPMG was established in India in August 1993. Our professionals leverage the global network of firms, and are conversant with local laws, regulations, markets and competition. KPMG has offices across India in Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chandigarh, Chennai, Gurugram, Jaipur, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Kochi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Vadodara and Vijayawada.

KPMG entities in India offer services to national and international clients in India across sectors. We strive to provide rapid, performance-based, industry-focused and technology-enabled services, which reflect a shared knowledge of global and local industries and our experience of the Indian business environment.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced Senior/Lead Pega Developer with a strong background in Pega CS, end-to-end application development on Pega Infinity, and deep knowledge of modern UI frameworks including Theme Cosmos, UI Kit, and Cosmos React. This role demands not only technical expertise but also leadership and mentoring abilities to guide and support the development team.

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, develop, and configure Pega applications from scratch, ensuring alignment with business requirements and enterprise architecture standards.

- Lead and own the end-to-end delivery of Pega Customer Service modules including onboarding, due diligence, and risk assessment processes.

- Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to define solution architecture and implementation approach.

- Build modern, responsive UIs using Theme Cosmos, Cosmos React, and UI Kit based on the application needs and user experience goals.

- Perform code reviews, unit testing, and quality assurance to ensure robust and maintainable solutions.

- Mentor junior developers, enforce best practices, and contribute to the continuous improvement of development standards and practices.

- Troubleshoot complex technical issues across Pega layers and work closely with other teams to resolve them.

- Prepare technical documentation, estimation, and design specifications as required.

- Stay up to date with Pega product releases, particularly around Pega Infinity and its evolving capabilities.

- Required Skills & Qualifications:

- Minimum 6 years of experience in Pega development with at least 2 years in a developer role.

- Strong hands-on experience with Pega CS frameworks, data models, and out-of-the-box rules.

- Proven experience in developing Pega applications from scratch on Pega Infinity (v8.7 or above).

- Expertise in Theme Cosmos, UI Kit, and Cosmos React with a clear understanding of SPA behavior and DX APIs.

- Pega certifications such as Certified Lead System Architect (CLSA) or CSSA are highly preferred.

- Experience with DevOps practices, unit testing (e.g., PegaUnit), and CI/CD pipelines in Pega is an added advantage.

- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and team collaboration skills.

- Prior experience in mentoring and leading small to mid-sized development teams.

Equal employment opportunity information

KPMG India has a policy of providing equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of their color, caste, religion, age, sex/gender, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or other legally protected status. KPMG India values diversity and we request you to submit the details below to support us in our endeavor for diversity. Providing the below information is voluntary and refusal to submit such information will not be prejudicial to you.

Project Role : AI Native Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Build and ship production-ready software using AI as a core part of the engineering lifecycle. Apply AI-native practices to develop and validate solutions, maintain quality and compliance, and continuously improve how software is built and operated.

Must have skills : Pega Platform

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Roles & Responsibilities :

Experience in designing the application, orchestrating the process flows, SLA, Skill based routing.

Experience in Integration with Database, External systems via SOAP/REST services, JMS, MQ.

Experience in defining Class structure, data model, Indexing and Reporting.

Experience in Code quality measures like Code reviews, Compliance to Guardrail, working with AES,SMA tools.

Ability to design security for Application with Access groups, Roles and Privileges.

Thorough understanding of Ruleset hierarchy and building re-usable components.

Good Hands-on of HTML, Javascript, PL/SQL programming.

Thorough understanding of environments involved and the deployment activities.

Understanding of project level metrics.

Proficient on the UI and Reporting elements.

Strong knowledge on the Decision Management Techniques in PEGA.

Experience in Integration (SOAP,HTTP Connectors and Services), Listeners and Batch Processes and Agents.

Experience in application development/system integration (avoid profiles with experience predominantly on maintenance projects).

Experience in Agile delivery & should have handled multiple scrum teams.

Professional & Technical Skills:

Experience in Pega frameworks like CS, CSHC, CWS, CMF.

Experience in Python Development.

Experience in Prompt engineering.

Communication should be good and able to handle client calls independently.

Able to Handle pressure situations in the Project.

Team Management- Able to handle the team efficiently.

Additional Information:

Overall minimum 8 years of hands on experience.

Mandatory Certification: CSA, CSSA :: CLSA part 1(Good to have).

Certification in Anthropic, AWS or Google is good to have.

React.Js/Node.Js Good to have.

Any upgrade experience is a plus.

Job Summary

This hybrid role is for a senior developer with six to eight years of experience specializing in Pega platform engineering and application development in Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM). The position focuses on complex Pega upgrades frameworks data and integration and case management to deliver resilient and scalable solutions. Exposure to check processing domain flows is beneficial. The role operates in a day shift with no travel expectations.

Responsibilities

- Design and implement high performing Pega applications that align with enterprise architecture guidelines and support scalable digital workflows for business stakeholders in a hybrid work environment

- Execute end to end Pega upgrade activities including impact analysis configuration refactoring regression support and post upgrade optimization to maintain platform stability and longevity

- Configure and extend Pega frameworks to address complex business rules ensuring reuse consistency and maintainability across multiple applications in the portfolio

- Develop robust Pega case management solutions that orchestrate work allocation service level management and exception handling to improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction

- Build and optimize Pega data and integration components to connect with enterprise systems using secure and efficient patterns that ensure reliability and data quality

- Create detailed technical designs for Pega features including class structures data models flows and UI behavior to provide clear guidance for future enhancements and maintenance

- Conduct code reviews and solution walkthroughs to ensure adherence to Pega guardrails internal quality standards and regulatory expectations while minimizing technical debt

- Collaborate closely with business analysts testers and infrastructure teams to refine requirements clarify edge cases and deliver incremental value through iterative releases in day shift operations

- Troubleshoot complex production and lower environment issues by performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes that reduce incidents and improve platform resilience

- Optimize application performance by tuning rules data access and caching strategies to achieve responsive user experiences and efficient resource utilization

- Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for Pega components including upgrade runbooks configuration baselines and integration contracts to support knowledge continuity

- Guide peers on Pega best practices by sharing practical patterns for case design integration and testing which helps elevate overall team capability and delivery quality

- Align Pega solutions with organizational objectives by translating business outcomes into modular features that contribute to improved operational accuracy and faster processing cycles for clients and society

Qualifications

- Exhibit professional experience between six and eight years in Pega application development with a consistent focus on delivering robust enterprise grade solutions

- Demonstrate strong hands on expertise with Pega platform capabilities including case types flows data transforms activities decision rules and user interface rules

- Show proven experience leading Pega upgrade initiatives including version assessment rule remediation regression support and performance validation in complex environments

- Apply solid knowledge of Pega frameworks and integration patterns to design modular components that support reuse and reduce implementation time across programs

- Display practical experience in Pega data and integration configuration including connectors services and data pages to enable reliable communication with upstream and downstream systems

- Possess working experience in Pega case management configurations such as stages processes service level rules and routing logic to streamline digital work queues

- Bring familiarity with check processing or related payment operations to interpret domain specific requirements and translate them into accurate Pega implementations when applicable

- Demonstrate proficiency in hybrid collaboration tools and practices that support effective communication documentation and coordination during day shift operations

- Maintain a disciplined approach to unit testing defect resolution and peer review so that each deployment enhances platform stability and user confidence across the organization

- Exhibit strong analytical abilities and problem solving skills that enable efficient handling of production incidents incident prevention and continuous improvement initiatives

- Show commitment to secure coding privacy awareness and compliance with organizational policies which ensures safe and responsible technology adoption for customers and society

The PEGA Architect will design, develop, integrate, and maintain enterprise applications on the PEGA platform. The role combines hands-on implementation with technical guidance, collaboration with business and delivery teams, and ownership of application quality throughout the development and release lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Application Design and Development: Lead the design and delivery of scalable PEGA

applications using case management, workflow, decisioning, and reusable components

aligned with business requirements.

Integration and Technical Implementation: Define integration architecture and guide

implementation using REST/SOAP services, connectors, data pages, and enterprise

systems while ensuring security and reliability.

System Maintenance and Optimization: Oversee production support, performance

tuning, defect resolution, and application upgrades to improve stability, scalability, and

compliance with PEGA best practices.

Collaboration and Mentorship: Partner with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and

delivery teams while mentoring PEGA developers through design reviews, code reviews,

and technical guidance.

Project Planning and Documentation: Support estimation, sprint and release planning,

risk management, and preparation of solution designs, technical specifications,

deployment plans, and governance documentation.

Certifications: Certified System Architect (CSA), Senior System Architect (CSSA)

Skill Requirements

• Strong hands-on experience developing PEGA applications, including case types, stages, processes, flows, assignments, routing, service-level agreements, and correspondence.

- Job Title: Architect/Senior Architect

- Job Role: Pega LSA

- Job Type: Full Time

- Work Mode: Hybrid (3 Days per week Work From Office)

- Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Gurgaon, Bhubaneshwar, Pune

Job Description:

We are looking for an accomplished Pega Architect (LSA Certified) with proven expertise in architecting and developing enterprise-scale Pega applications. The role involves leading solution design, mentoring development teams, enforcing Pega best practices, and ensuring successful delivery of high-quality, scalable solutions.

Essential Technical Qualification:

- Mandatory - Certified Lead System Architect (LSA) (both Part 1 & 2)

- Overall 8+years and 7+ years relevant Pega experience and at least 3-5 Pega projects implementation.

- Pega experience across versions 6.6 to Pega Infinity 25.1 and above.

- Proven experience in architecting and implementing end-to-end Pega solutions in large-scale enterprise environments.

- Hands-on experience/knowledge with Pega Constellation.

- Familiar with Generative AI tools and capabilities.

- Experience in solutions development on Pega using Pega forms, workflows, data models, layer cake, integration and Pega mobility.

- Hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, coding, integration, implementation, and deployment within Pega environments.

- Strong understanding of Case management concepts, Activities, Flows, SSO Integrations, Connectors, Services and Data Interactions.

- Debugging Skills & User Interfaces in PRPC. Experience of integrating Pega with other Technology Platforms.

- Experience in working on Agile/Scrum methodologies.

- Experience with building security first solutions, authorisation, identity, encryption, authentication, OWASP, SSOA and RBAC.

- Good understanding of Relational Database Management Systems including architecting and designing for performance and scalability and working with Object to Relational Mapping schemes for distributed data access.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead and mentor the development team, providing technical guidance and support as required.

- Responsible for architecting and designing business applications using Pega PRPC and related Pega frameworks.

- Drive the design, development, testing, and deployment of scalable and maintainable solutions within the PRPC Rules environment.

- Collaborate with the Solution Architect to deliver end-to-end Pega applications and projects.
