- Responsible for estimation and enterprise class structure design, ensuring the overall application design aligns with enterprise standards.

- Demonstrated expertise in code review, optimization, and Pega application performance analysis, including performance tuning. Responsible for analysing, identifying, and logging application enhancements and defects.

- Ensure the application not only meets current business needs but is also designed to accommodate future scalability and feature enhancements.

- Analyze and resolve complex design and configuration challenges to meet defined objectives.

- Prepare High-Level Designs (HLDs), low-code platform solutions, and gather non-functional requirements (NFRs).

- Review and approve solution designs, logic configurations, and technical artifacts to ensure alignment with Pega best practices.

- Oversee and execute deployment activities across all environments, including Production.

- Provide accurate time and resource estimates for project deliverables in line with established processes.

- Offer technical inputs on dependencies, sequencing, and risks to assist the Project Manager in project planning and execution.

Preferred Qualification: (Optional/Good to have)

- Experience in any of the Pega frameworks, Underwriting, CS, CRM, CPM, BFSI, Smart Dispute, Smart Investigate, CLM/KYC etc.

- Exposure to Pega Decisioning or Pega Marketing modules, with a solid grasp of their application within customer engagement and business process workflows.

AI Solution Architect – Agentic AI & Engineering Transformation

Seeking a highly experienced AI Architect to lead the design, adoption, and scaling of AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices and Agentic AI solutions across the organization.

Why this Role is important

This is not a traditional architecture role.You will be at the forefront of transforming a large-scale engineering organization into an AI-First Delivery Enterprise, defining how software is designed, built, tested, and operated in the age of Generative AI and Agentic AI.

You will have the opportunity to:

- Shape the organization's enterprise AI strategy and engineering future state.

- Build and scale Agentic AI capabilities from the ground up.

- Define next-generation AI-driven SDLC practices.

- Work on real-world AI transformation initiatives rather than isolated proofs of concept.

- Partner with senior architects, engineering leaders, business executives, and technology vendors.

Location: Offshore – India

Experience: 12+ years overall; strong recent GenAI / Agentic AI architecture experience

Domain: Banking & Financial Services – Cards, Payments, Customer Service, Collections, Identity, Loyalty, Digital Servicing

Drive the CTFS AI transformation across the managed-services / vendor-consolidation portfolio, focusing on AI-enabled SDLC, Agentic AI, application modernization, engineering productivity, operational automation and measurable savings.

CTFS Context

Work across:

- DSS: Java-based digital servicing platform with ~55 microservices

- Pega: Customer service, servicing and disputes

- Collections: Delinquency/default servicing and recovery workflows

- Cards & Payments: TSYS, payment gateway and transaction integrations

- Digital Channels: Mobile/web servicing

- Identity & Fraud: CIAM, authentication and fraud integrations

- Batch & Integration: APIs, MQ/middleware, batch and partner systems

- Legacy Modernization: Java/WebSphere and cloud migration

- Data platform Modernization: Migration from traditional warehouse to cloud(preferably Databricks)

Key Responsibilities

- Define AI target architecture and adoption roadmap

- Drive AI across requirements, design, coding, testing, documentation, release and support

- Design Agentic AI solutions using agents, MCP/API integrations and human-in-the-loop controls

- Establish reusable patterns for LLMs, RAG, agents, security, evaluation and observability

- Identify and prioritize AI use cases across DSS, Pega, Collections, Batch and Digital

- Apply AI to legacy analysis, modernization, testing and migration acceleration

- Enable AI-assisted incident triage, RCA, knowledge retrieval and operational automation

- Drive PoC → Pilot → Production with security and governance controls

- Measure productivity improvement and translate it into validated capacity / cost savings

- Mentor engineering teams and create reusable accelerators

- Establish AI adoption frameworks, governance models, and implementation standards.

- Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and platforms.

- Provide technical guidance to engineering teams, architects, and product owners.

Core Skills

Technical skills:

- AI & Generative AI : Strong experience in:

- Large Language Models (LLMs)

- GPT-based architectures

- OpenAI ecosystem

- Azure OpenAI

- Anthropic Claude

- Gemini

- Prompt Engineering

- RAG architectures

- Vector databases

- Embedding models

- Fine-tuning concepts

- AI evaluation frameworks

- Agentic AI: Hands-on experience with:

- Multi-agent architectures

- Autonomous workflow agents

- AI orchestration frameworks

- Agent lifecycle management

- Planning and reasoning systems

- Tool integration frameworks

- Human-in-the-loop patterns

- MCP Server

- Preferred exposure to below AI platforms/framework:

- LangGraph

- AutoGen

- LangChain

- CrewAI

- Microsoft Copilot Studio

- Azure AI Foundry

- Software Engineering: Strong understanding of:

- Agile delivery

- Microservices

- Event-driven architecture

- SDLC methodologies

- Cloud & Platforms: Experience with:

- Microsoft Azure

- AWS

- Google Cloud

- AI services and cloud-native architecture

- Devops pipeline for both Brownfield and GreendField applications

Leadership Skills

- Ability to influence senior leadership and engineering organizations

- Executive stakeholder management

- Team mentoring and coaching

- Strong communication and presentation skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services, cards/payments, customer servicing, collections, fraud/identity, enterprise modernization, Pega, Java/Spring, NodeJS, MQ, Azure, batch processing and regulated environments.

Expected Outcome

AI Roadmap → Prioritized Use Cases → Production AI Solutions → SDLC/Productivity Improvement → Measurable Savings

Success Metrics: The AI Architect will be measured on:

- AI adoption across engineering teams

- SDLC productivity improvement

- Reduction in development and testing effort

- Number of AI-enabled delivery programs

- Agentic AI implementation success rate

- Reusable AI accelerators created

- Architecture compliance and governance adherence

- Engineering team AI maturity growth

What To Expect Next

We believe great experiences start with transparency—and that includes our hiring process. Here’s what you can typically expect after you hit "Apply":

- HR Interview – A conversation to get to know you better and align on expectations.

- Technical Interview – A chance to showcase your skills and experience.

- Client Interview – Ensuring mutual fit between you and the client team.

- Offer Stage – If everything aligns, we’ll be happy to make it official.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description_text:
Meet Our Team

Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high-quality, outcome-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.

Picture Yourself At Pega

Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.

At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.

We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

What You'll Do At Pega

- Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment

- Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle

- Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions

- Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.

- Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro-actively respond to adhoc questions

Who You Are

- Pega CLSA Certified resource must.

- You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.

- 12 plus years of Pega experience in building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions.

- Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities

- Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate

- Willingness to go the extra mile

- Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example

- Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business & IT stakeholders

- Open to work from 1:00 - 10:00 PM IST

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.

You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You've Accomplished

- You’ve built and implemented model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions and applications.

- You’ve led end-to-end delivery of medium to large component of bigger solution.

- You’ve been exposed to a variety of technologies including Application Servers, programming languages, relational and non-relational data bases and integration techniques.

- You’ve demonstrated knowledge of and applicability of Object-Oriented techniques and principles.

- You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologie

Pega Offers You

- Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.

- Continuous learning and development opportunities.

- An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment.

- Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company

- An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

Ultimately, your success is judged by the success of those customers in deriving real world business value as shown by repeat business and increased adoption.

- Very Good Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes – software containerization platform to create deploy and run application by using container (having CKAD certification is a plus)

- Very good understanding and experience in Cloud technologies (AWS, GCP or AZURE and having certification is a plus)

- Troubleshooting and debugging experience would be an added advantage

- Desire to continually learn.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Ability to identify, propose and implement solutions.

What You've Accomplished

- Working programming knowledge and experience

- Ability to rapidly gain in-depth knowledge of existing and new Pega products.

- Demonstrated effective oral and written communication skills, including poise in pressure situations.

- Aptitude for streamlining processes to identify efficiencies and improvements

Pega Offers You

- Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.

- Continuous learning and development opportunities

- An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment

- Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay + bonus incentive, employee equity in the company

- Opportunities working with modern cloud native technologies including Kubernetes, Microservices, Serverless and more.

Job Description

As a Workflow Developer on the Securities Services Operations Transformation team, you will be part of the Intelligent Solutions team within the JPMorganChase CIB – Securities Services Operations Transformation organization. Your role involves building low code/no code solutions for operations users to enhance efficiency and streamline processes.

- Translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and workflows.

- Design and map processes by reviewing SOPs and creating detailed process flows.

- Utilize BPMN to model, optimize, and document business processes.

- Design, develop, and implement complex workflows using low code/no code platforms.

- Customize advanced forms/screens to enhance user experience and meet business needs.

- Perform thorough testing and debugging to ensure workflow quality and functionality.

- Integrate workflows with various APIs and third-party services.

- Provide technical support and troubleshooting for workflow-related issues.

- Support change management activities and monitor adherence to risk, controls, compliance, and regulatory requirements.

- Own end-to-end delivery tracking (scope, milestones, dependencies, risks/issues) and manage work execution through JIRA to ensure predictable outcomes. Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders to remove blockers, drive decisions, and ensure teams meet committed timelines.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced OpenShift Administrator to manage, maintain, and optimize our container platform infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployments, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security of the platform.

- Responsible for providing administrative and operational support for RH OpenShift infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and reliability for PEGA applications

- Install, configure, and maintain OpenShift clusters in on-premises or cloud environments

- Manage cluster lifecycle: upgrades, patches, and performance tuning

- Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using OpenShift tools

- Monitor cluster health, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high availability

- Configure and manage networking, storage, and security policies within OpenShift

- Work closely with development teams to support containerized application deployments

- Automate operational tasks using Ansible, Helm, or other scripting tools

- Ensure compliance with security best practices and perform regular audits

- Provide documentation and knowledge transfer to internal teams

- Actively engage and lead product support issues and incidents

Required Qualifications:

- 3+ years of experience in OpenShift administration and Kubernetes

- Strong knowledge of Linux administration (RHEL preferred)

- Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Podman)

- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab, Tekton)

- Understanding of networking concepts (Ingress, Load Balancers, Service Mesh)

- Knowledge of storage solutions in OpenShift (Persistent Volumes, Storage Classes)

- Experience with monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)

- Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or Ansible

- Good understanding of security practices (RBAC, OAuth, TLS)

Desired Qualifications:

- Working knowledge with OpenShift/Containers

- Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration (or equivalent)

- Experience and/or certification with Pega Designer Studio

- Automation skills to reduce manual activities

- Proven team player who can work comfortably in a multicultural environment

- Proven ability to work independently, multi task and effectively work in a complex environment with a global team structure

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills; Strong influencer, facilitator, and collaborator

- Detail oriented and organized

- Must be pro-active, enthusiastic, flexible, results driven with attention to detail

- Strong problem solving and critical thinking skills

- Motivation to achieve results and the ability to quickly integrate into teams

Skills:

- Innovative Thinking

- Production Support

- Result Orientation

- Risk Management

- Solution Design

- Adaptability

- Analytical Thinking

- Collaboration

- Influence

- Solution Delivery Process

- Architecture

- Automation

- DevOps Practices

- Project Management

- Stakeholder Management

1st shift (United States of America)

Hours Per Week:

40

About Citi:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients' best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We'll enable growth and progress together.

About the Team:

The Lead Solutions Architect is a strategic professional and visionary technologist within the Consumer Operations Technology Engineering & Architecture organization. Operating at the leading edge of enterprise architecture, digital transformation, and intelligent automation, this pivotal role establishes the structural foundation for scalable, resilient, and next-generation platforms that power financial services for millions of customers globally. As a subject matter expert in end-to-end system design, artificial intelligence integration, and enterprise workflow orchestration, the successful candidate will bridge technical strategy with complex business execution, spearheading architectural blueprints that ensure continuous modernization, operational excellence, and long-term competitive advantage.

In this role, you will partner collaboratively with engineering directors, business executives, product strategists, and cross-functional technology teams across a global matrixed environment. You will champion innovation by identifying emerging industry paradigms—such as generative AI, intelligent decisioning, and low-code workflow platforms—driving technical governance, and de-risking critical technology investments while safeguarding the enterprise against operational and regulatory risks. By translating ambitious business imperatives into high-performing, future-proof architectural frameworks, you will play an instrumental role in elevating Citi’s technological capabilities and driving our mission of delivering secure, seamless, and world-class client experiences.

Responsibilities:

- Design and deliver enterprise architecture solutions across major, complex IT programs, ensuring all systems align with and conform to established enterprise blueprints and standards.

- Build and maintain technology roadmaps that reflect emerging industry trends, and present clear, evidence-based recommendations to guide business direction and investment decisions.

- Translate complex business problems into well-structured, technically sound solutions that span hardware, software, and system integration design.

- Architect and integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions into enterprise workflows to enhance decisioning, automate operations, and optimize consumer banking journeys.

- Design, optimize, and standardize enterprise workflow and case management solutions on the Pega Platform (including Pega Infinity, Customer Decision Hub, and 1:1 Customer Engagement), ensuring seamless integration with core banking systems.

- Provide technical leadership across systems design initiatives, taking ownership of both individual components and overall solution architecture where required.

- Identify and recommend innovative technologies and platforms that enhance existing systems and strengthen IT infrastructure to meet strategic goals.

- Advise and mentor junior architects and engineers, sharing technical expertise to raise capability and support professional development across the team.

- Assess risk in architectural and technology decisions with a focus on safeguarding the organization, ensuring adherence to relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies.

Qualifications:

- 6+ years of hands-on experience in solutions architecture, system design, software engineering, or enterprise IT architecture.

- Demonstrated hands-on expertise in architecting end-to-end distributed systems across diverse hardware, software, and networking topologies using sound engineering principles.

- Working knowledge of industry-standard enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or Zachman, with experience applying architectural artifacts, principles, and governance models.

- Practical knowledge and experience applying Agentic AI, Autonomous AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in solutioning and automating complex business applications.

- Hands-on experience architecting and deploying scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native solutions on platforms such as AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS) or Microsoft Azure (AKS, Azure OpenAI, Functions, Cosmos DB).

- Proficiency in core programming languages such as Java, Python 3.10+, TypeScript, Go, or C++, with direct experience developing and maintaining high-throughput enterprise systems.

- Extensive experience designing event-driven and message-oriented integration architectures using technologies such as Apache Kafka, TIBCO, MuleSoft, or RabbitMQ.

- Strong practical knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Red Hat OpenShift, covering cluster deployment, scaling, and fault tolerance.

- Practical experience with CI/CD automation pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD to support automated testing and deployment lifecycles.

- Proficiency with enterprise data stores, including relational databases such as Oracle and PostgreSQL as well as NoSQL platforms such as MongoDB, Redis, or vector databases, with expertise in schema design and performance optimization.

- Proven experience implementing observability, telemetry, and distributed tracing solutions using tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK Stack to maintain system health and reliability.

- Robust analytical and technical debugging capability to solve multi-variable architectural bottlenecks, latency challenges, and failure modes across complex IT ecosystems.

- Familiarity with architecting enterprise applications and workflow solutions using the Pega framework (e.g., Pega Infinity, PRPC, or Pega Cloud) is a strong plus.

Education:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant technology or engineering field.

- Master's degree in a technology, engineering, or related discipline is beneficial.

- TOGAF certification, Pega certifications (CSA/CSSA/CLSA), or relevant Cloud/AI Architecture certifications are an advantage.

Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

(SDE/T Focus)

This role operates as a full-stack Software Development Engineer in Test (SDE/T) within an Agile Scrum team. The position combines hands-on software development, quality engineering, and digital accessibility responsibilities to deliver customer-facing banking and credit card features across web browser and mobile channels.

As a seasoned professional, the SDE/T is expected to apply in-depth technical knowledge while contributing to the improvement of development, testing, and accessibility practices. The individual will integrate subject matter expertise in frontend, backend microservices, test automation, and ADA compliance, ensuring high-quality, inclusive digital experiences.

Key Additional Responsibilities (SDE/T Specific)

- Actively participate in all stages of the Agile SDLC, including user story grooming, story pointing, decomposition of large features, and definition of clear acceptance criteria.

- Develop, configure, and debug full-stack applications consisting of Angular-based browser/mobile frontends and Spring Boot microservices.

- Create, maintain, and execute automated and manual test scripts using BDD frameworks. This includes Selenium for web, Appium for mobile, and API testing with Postman or equivalent tools.

- Build and integrate CI/CD pipelines by creating and maintaining Jenkins jobs that run automated test suites.

- Validate Responsive Web Design and ADA Accessibility compliance using screen readers (NVDA, VoiceOver, Talkback), automated scans with Axe, color contrast analysis, and other accessibility tools.

- Own testing artifacts including Test Plans, Exit Reports, and full traceability between user stories, test cases, and defects. Maintain strict SDLC hygiene to ensure no untested code reaches production.

- Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for defects, application issues, and performance concerns. Collaborate across scrum teams, upstream/downstream systems, and external partners to resolve issues.

- Continuously build and document Subject Matter Expertise (SME) covering end-to-end flows from digital channels through downstream systems and external partners.

- Adhere to Citi’s SDLC standards, ADA guidelines, and participate in retrospectives, process improvement workshops, and audits.

- Provide post-production support, including technical go-live checkouts and RCA for production issues.

- Review metrics and proactively introduce improved visibility mechanisms to keep programs on track and aligned with organizational objectives.

- Work effectively in a fast-paced environment with both onshore and offshore team members.

- 3+ yers of combined Development and Quality Engineering (SDET) experience in a fast-paced, time-to-market driven environment.

- Working knowledge of PEGA (or similar workflow systems), Jira, Zephyr, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Office suite.

Overview

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States. Preference will be given to those located in North Carolina, Florida, Texas and Arizona.

Software Engineer Consultant Pega AI & CDH

We are seeking a highly hands-on Pega AI and Customer Decision Hub (CDH) Architect. The individual will have deep, hands-on experience implementing Pega AI capabilities and Pega CDH. The role is approximately 50% Pega AI and 50% CDH. This individual will personally design, configure, develop, integrate, troubleshoot, and implement Pega AI and Customer Decisioning solutions. The individual will be capable of independently driving technical implementation activities with minimal supervision.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities:

- Design, configure, and implement Pega AI capabilities.

- Implement Pega Knowledge Buddy solutions.

- Implement Pega Voice AI capabilities.

- Design and implement AI-powered workflows and AI orchestration.

- Configure and integrate LLMs and external AI services with Pega.

- Implement Pega AI components and AI-powered business solutions.

- Configure and optimize Next-Best-Action strategies.

- Build customer decisioning strategies and engagement policies.

- Configure adaptive models and predictive models.

- Implement real-time decisioning capabilities.

- Configure customer profiles, propositions, and eligibility rules.

- Develop customer journeys and engagement strategies.

- Integrate Pega with enterprise APIs, data platforms, and AI services.

- Troubleshoot and optimize AI and decisioning solutions.

- Support AI governance, model governance, and responsible AI requirements.

- Follow Pega guardrails and implementation best practices.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience in Software Application Development and Maintenance

OR

High School Diploma or GED and 12 years of experience in Software Application Development and Maintenance

Area of Experience: Pega CDH

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on Pega CDH experience.

- 3+ years of hands-on Pega AI experience.

- Experience implementing Pega Knowledge Buddy.

- Experience implementing Pega Voice AI.

- Experience with Pega AI capabilities and AI-powered workflows.

- Experience integrating LLMs and AI services.

- Strong experience with Next-Best-Action Designer.

- Strong experience with Strategy Designer.

- Strong experience with adaptive and predictive models.

- Strong experience with customer decisioning.

- Strong experience with REST APIs.

- Strong experience with JSON, XML, and SQL.

- Experience with real-time and event-driven integrations.

- Pega Certified Decisioning Consultant (PCDC).

- Pega Lead Decisioning Architect certification.

- Banking or financial services experience.

- Experience with AI governance and model governance.

- Experience with enterprise AI implementations.

- Experience with customer engagement and personalization.

Additional Information

This job posting is expected to remain active for 45 days from the initial posting date listed above. If it is necessary to extend this deadline, the posting will remain active as appropriate. Job postings may come down early due to business need or a high volume of applicants.

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with expertise in the Pega Platform to drive the design, development, and implementation of enterprise-scale workflow, within CAB Technology. The ideal candidate must be a Pega Lead System Architect (LSA) and possess strong hands-on experience with Pega and understand enterprise application architecture. This role will partner with business and technology stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative solutions while establishing technical standards and mentoring development teams.

Responsibility:

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Utilizes programming specifications to construct modules, develop testing methods, and design materials. Provides new feature time estimates for system changes and assists in implementing modifications. Executes test plans to validate application functions as designed.

- Analysis - Collects data related to user requests and determines scope, time estimates, and system impacts. Inspects business specifications, programming specifications, coding, test plans, documentation, and implementation plans for accuracy.

- Business Support - Provides technical support to production systems by addressing reported issues, anticipating maintenance requirements, and ensuring functionality for end user needs. Drafts documentation to be used for system, end user, and operational purposes, including technical specifications and application designs.

- Technical Expertise - Responsible for complex involvement in the software development life cycle including the creation, enhancement, implementation, and evaluation of software. Serves as a technical resource for management, associates, and business units.

- On-call Support - Provides 24/7 on-call support via rotations.

- Stay current with emerging Pega capabilities, AI technologies, and industry best practices.

- Design, architect, and deliver enterprise-grade applications using the Pega Platform.

- Serve as the technical lead for complex Pega implementations.

- Design and implement AI-powered solutions leveraging Pega GenAI, Knowledge Buddy, Agentic AI, and related capabilities (Nice to Have).

- Lead solution architecture, application design, and code reviews to ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance.

- Develop reusable frameworks, components, and enterprise design standards.

- Integrate Pega applications with enterprise systems using REST, SOAP, messaging, and event-driven architectures.

- Drive CI/CD implementation, DevOps best practices, automated testing, and release management.

- Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide technical leadership for critical incidents.

jobs.description_text:
Overview

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States. Priority given to those candidates located in North Carolina, Arizona.

Senior Software Engineer - Pega

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with expertise in the Pega Platform to drive the design, development, and implementation of enterprise-scale workflow, within CAB Technology. The ideal candidate must be a Pega Lead System Architect (LSA) and possess strong hands-on experience with Pega and understand enterprise application architecture. This role will partner with business and technology stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative solutions while establishing technical standards and mentoring development teams.

Responsibility:

Responsibilities & Qualifications

- System Enhancement - Performs a variety of actions that evaluate and improve department systems, processes, and applications. Utilizes programming specifications to construct modules, develop testing methods, and design materials. Provides new feature time estimates for system changes and assists in implementing modifications. Executes test plans to validate application functions as designed.

- Analysis - Collects data related to user requests and determines scope, time estimates, and system impacts. Inspects business specifications, programming specifications, coding, test plans, documentation, and implementation plans for accuracy.

- Business Support - Provides technical support to production systems by addressing reported issues, anticipating maintenance requirements, and ensuring functionality for end user needs. Drafts documentation to be used for system, end user, and operational purposes, including technical specifications and application designs.

- Technical Expertise - Responsible for complex involvement in the software development life cycle including the creation, enhancement, implementation, and evaluation of software. Serves as a technical resource for management, associates, and business units.

- On-call Support - Provides 24/7 on-call support via rotations.

- Stay current with emerging Pega capabilities, AI technologies, and industry best practices.

Qualifications:

Preferred Licenses or Certifications: Pega Lead System Architect (LSA)

Bachelor's Degree and 4 years of experience in Software application development and maintenance

OR

High School Diploma or GED and 8 years of experience in Software application development and maintenance

Preferred Qualifications:

- Design, architect, and deliver enterprise-grade applications using the Pega Platform.

- Serve as the technical lead for complex Pega implementations.

- Design and implement AI-powered solutions leveraging Pega GenAI, Knowledge Buddy, Agentic AI, and related capabilities (Nice to Have).

- Lead solution architecture, application design, and code reviews to ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance.

- Develop reusable frameworks, components, and enterprise design standards.

- Integrate Pega applications with enterprise systems using REST, SOAP, messaging, and event-driven architectures.

- Drive CI/CD implementation, DevOps best practices, automated testing, and release management.

- Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide technical leadership for critical incidents.

- Mentor and coach developers, Senior System Architects, and System Architects on Pega best practices.

- Ensure compliance with enterprise security, governance, and regulatory standards.

Additional Information

This job posting is expected to remain active for 45 days from the initial posting date listed above. If it is necessary to extend this deadline, the posting will remain active as appropriate. Job postings may come down early due to business need or a high volume of applicants.

This job posting has been extended until October 2, 2026.

If hired in North Carolina or Arizona the base pay for this position is generally between $117,614 and $140,000. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment.

Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits.

jobs.description_text:
Cigna-Evernorth Services Inc. seeks a Software Engineering Advisor for the Morris Plains, NJ location responsible for creating detailed specifications and designs, conducting assurance reviews of peer application programming, and acting as a technical resource for team members with less experience.

Responsibilities

- Ensure quality and timeliness of product development, technical design and solution implementation as a development team member.

- Coordinate with offshore vendors and HIH team members and partner with other stakeholders (Business, finance operations and TPOs) to gather requirements, conduct analysis, design, develop, and enhance customized applications.

- Create technical designs and solutions that deliver quality solutions for our clients and businesses.

- Build batch and on-line adjustment claim system.

- Partner with QA teams to resolve solution design deficiencies and related deliverables.

- Troubleshoot, maintain, and develop application and system solutions for business mandated products and regular operational processes.

- Perform impact analysis to resolve user queries as necessary. Modify existing applications, implementing, and providing support and training stakeholders as necessary.

- Interact with QA testers to provide necessary information to differentiate defects and set up issues in end-to-end testing.

- Perform root cause analysis to identify the cause of issues in the Test/ Quality environment during SIT and Quality test and assist in fixing the defects.

- Perform stress test analysis and report any deviation or malfunction of any product within software release to achieve the project mission in product development.

- Hybrid work schedule.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering or related field and 3 years of experience.

- Must have experience with: Mainframes; COBOL; DB2;

- Teradata; CICS (Customer Information Control System);

- Pega; GitHub; Endevor; Claude.ai; and AWS Kiro.

Salary Range: $149,000-$186,100/year

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 111,700 - 186,100 USD / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.

This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.

At The Cigna Group, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits, with a focus on supporting your whole health. Starting on day one of your employment, you’ll be offered several health-related benefits including medical, vision, dental, and well-being and behavioral health programs. We also offer 401(k), company paid life insurance, tuition reimbursement, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off per year, paid holidays, and leaves of absence. For more details on our employee benefits programs, click here.

About The Cigna Group

Doing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. At The Cigna Group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. Through our divisions Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services, we are committed to enhancing the lives of our clients, customers and patients. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, disability, sex, childbirth (including pregnancy) or related medical conditions including but not limited to lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital or familial status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, citizenship status or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete the online application process, please email seeyourself@thecignagroup.com for assistance. Please note that this email inbox is dedicated to accommodation requests only and cannot provide application updates or accept resumes.

The Cigna Group has a tobacco-free policy and reserves the right not to hire tobacco/nicotine users in states where that is legally permissible. Candidates in such states who use tobacco/nicotine will not be considered for employment unless they enter a qualifying smoking cessation program prior to the start of their employment. These states include: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Vermont, and Washington State.

Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with all federal, state and local ordinances.

jobs.description_text:
At Prime Therapeutics (Prime), we are a different kind of PBM, with a purpose beyond profits and a unique ability to connect care for those we serve. Looking for a purpose-driven career? Come build the future of pharmacy with us.

Job Posting Title

Sr. Principal Enterprise Information Architect - Client and Member - Remote

Job Description

The Sr. Principal Enterprise Information Architect is responsible for initiating and leading strategic information and data solutions that fulfill specific business and technology outcomes. Solutions include projects, products, systems (including applications, technologies, processes, and information), shared infrastructure services and shared application services. The Enterprise Information Architect leads the analysis and design tasks to support the development of enterprise solutions that cross multiple domains to ensure that the resulting architecture meets the business needs and align with architecture governance and standards. This position also leads the creation of deliverables that help develop target-state guidance (reusable standards, guidelines, individual parts, platforms, and configurations) for evolving the architecture across the enterprise. The Enterprise Information Architect will focus on our Client and Member information domain.

The Sr. Principal Enterprise Information Architect will be responsible for managing the lifecycle of standard elements required to implement and sustain an overall information and data (structured, semi-structured and unstructured) discipline at Prime Therapeutics. This individual focus is primary on enterprise information requirements: design, access, usage, privacy, and stewardship. The position also requires an understanding of industry standards and emerging regulatory issues surrounding information assets (such as consumer privacy laws, data retention policies, outsourced data, and specific industry guidelines – especially in healthcare, insurance, and banking). The Enterprise Information Architect will provide architectural oversight and governance to products and projects in the information and data domain as well as other solutions that emphasis data management, integration, and movement. This includes defining an enterprise information vision, strategy, architectural blueprints, and roadmaps while acquiring buy-in from the enterprise. The Enterprise Information Architect will guide and direct Data Architects to define and oversee all aspects of data architecture and governance, design, analysis techniques, and data architecture processes.

Responsibilities

- Lead and provide thought leadership in all areas of data and information management, including master and reference data management, data modeling, data governance, data quality, data standardization, and metadata management.

- Lead and/or facilitate enterprise information and data strategy development to achieve enterprise goals and objectives

- Actively manage, communicate, and market the enterprise information architecture strategy and techniques via creation and maintenance of architecture blueprints, roadmaps, and executive presentations

- Promote and support elimination of data redundancy, fragmentation, and unnecessary movement of data through the establishment and enforcement of data system of record (SOR), source of truth (SOT), source of origin (SOO).

- Continuously improve and mature information and data architecture practice and processes

- Lead the development and application of information policies, principles, standards, patterns, and governance processes for information, data, and metadata to achieve an integrated definition of data for enterprise information, and to ensure the accuracy, validity, and reusability of metadata.

- Maintain awareness, research, drive, and lead adoption of emerging IT trends, disruptions, and practices relevant to enterprise information and data architecture

- Engage leadership to identify business and technology-enabled innovation opportunities that enable and drive business outcomes

- Lead the analysis of the business-IT environment to detect critical deficiencies, legacy, and technical debt, and recommend solutions for improvement

- Develop, maintain, and evolve the architecture and solution intent (current state, transition state, and future state) across domains

- Assist in maintaining the repository of current state, transition state, and future state information architecture deliverables

- Lead and facilitate Data Architecture community of practice meetings and represent the information and data architecture domain at the Architecture Review Board.

- Work closely with the product portfolio owners and product managers to drive a robust information and data architectural runway that can support future business requirements throughout the product and solution lifecycle

- Coach, mentor, and collaborate with technical subject matter experts and architecture peers to develop architecture that enables and drive new business capabilities and operating models

- Other duties as assigned

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related area of study, or equivalent combination of education and/or relevant work experience; HS diploma or GED is required

- 10 years of related work experience in Business Analysis, System Design and Development, Systems Engineering, or technical architecture; to include 5 years direct experience working within an Architect role

- Must be eligible to work in the United States without need for work visa or residency sponsorship

Additional Qualifications

- Significant experience defining and standardizing design and architecture patterns for assigned domain

- Advanced ability to communicate and present effectively at multiple levels of the organization

- Ability to define, plan, initiate and lead architecture and teams for assigned area and scope

- Demonstrate wide understanding of multiple domain areas, with ability to apply practical and pragmatic solutions

- Self-learner, ability to work independently and direct the learning and work of others

- Experience handling all of solution types, ranging from organization and process to implementing new system builds, legacy enhancements, commercial-off-the-shelf packages, and Cloud solutions

- Experience as a senior level architect working on significant enterprise initiatives

- Previous experience with data modeling, data lineage, data quality, data profiling, and metadata management tools (ER/Studio, XMLSpy, InfoSphere Data Architect, Informatica, etc.)

- Working knowledge of transactional (OLTP), reporting and analytics (OLAP), business event, messaging, and API contract design best practices and patterns

- Previous experience with enterprise architecture tool and knowledge repository such as Planview CTM / Enterprise Architect, Sparx, Software AG, etc.

- Previous experience with SAFe Agile Framewor

Preferred Qualifications

Job Number: R0243139

Pega Business Architect

The Opportunity:

You know that true progress is made at the intersection of business and tech, and as a Business Architect, you’re highly skilled in both. Here, you’ll have the chance to work with an agile team as they develop digital products to support your clients’ most pressing missions. We’re looking for someone like you to propel business analytics and processes forward, as well as delve into technology trends to deliver user friendly client experiences.

As a Business Architect on our team, you’ll work with the Pega Delivery Excellence operating model, discovery and journey map execution, business process modeling, and enterprise architecture, and partner with business and IT stakeholders to document and communicate business functionality for implementation. You’ll develop business architecture (BA) deliverables, including process flows and use cases, and present current state and target state architecture.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

- Experience facilitating meetings to gather requirements that support the business process transformation, in collaboration with the business, IT stakeholders, and subject matter experts (SMEs) to satisfy the needs of both the client organization and the customer

- Experience with Business Process Modeling Notation (BPMN) and delivering business process flows and use cases

- Experience developing and presenting BA materials to different audiences, such as process models, use cases, business epics, or journey maps

- Experience conducting business research and interviews in support of business capabilities and features

- Experience with the design and implementation of enterprise-level applications and application platforms

- Experience with the design of complex IT solutions involving multiple software applications, processing platforms, and integration software

- Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements

- Bachelor's degree

- Pega Certified Business Architect certification

Nice If You Have:

- Experience delivering solutions using Agile best practices

- Experience designing, configuring, and building processes in Pega, including shared frameworks

- Experience with EA modeling and visualization tools, including Visio, Tableau, and PowerPoint

- Experience leading projects, tasks, or teams

- Knowledge of Pega Agile Studio and JIRA

- Knowledge of out-of-box functionality and Pega implementation best practices

- Possession of excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

- Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills

Vetting:

Applicants selected will be subject to a government investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements of the U.S. government client.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

- Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

- Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.

- Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

- Strong program planning and risk management experience.

- Experience managing program scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, and dependencies.

- Experience establishing governance processes and executive reporting mechanisms.

- Proven ability to build relationships with business leaders, product owners, IT teams, and executive stakeholders.

- Experience facilitating steering committee meetings and executive governance reviews.

- Ability to track program metrics including velocity, quality, productivity, and business value realization.

- Strong stakeholder and client management skills.

jobs.description_text:
Are you someone who is driven to build and test high quality software, acts autonomously, and has experience leading software quality teams in broadscale transformation programs? Are you someone who loves to learn and enjoys solving the most complex problems? Are you ready to take the next leap in your career by leveraging your experience to influence how the future of Workflow capabilities drives business value at Deloitte Global Employer Services (GES)?

If you want your work to matter at global scale, in a stack that's actively modernizing (including AI-led engineering), and on a team that values judgement as much as code - we'd like to meet you.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Software Engineer on our GlobalAdvantage (GA) platform, you'll own the design and delivery of the workflow and integration capabilities at the center of that transformation. This is a role for an engineer who's ready to move past executing tasks and into owning outcomes - someone who can navigate ambiguity, make sound technical calls without being told how, and raise the bar for people around them while still learning something new every week.

You'll own the technical delivery of workflow and integration features end to end - from design through deployment and production support - and help set the engineering standard across the platform. Your impact will be measured by delivery quality, speed of execution, and the business value you unlock. Day to day, you will:

- Design and build workflow and task management capabilities that power GES business processes - using Pega, .Net, C# and other technologies.

- Develop and support REST APIs, microservices, and integration services across internal and client-facing platforms.

- Own your modules and features - including technical design, effort estimation, unit testing, deployment support, and production issue resolution - and drive quality, maintainability, and reuse across the codebase.

- Contribute to and shape technical design decisions, code reviews, and engineering standards, exercising judgment on trade-offs rather than deferring them.

- Elevate the team by mentoring less experienced engineers, sharing context, and improving how the group builds - while staying open to learning from architects, quality engineers, and peers.

- Collaborate across functions with product managers, architects, technical program managers, engineering managers, quality engineers, and business stakeholders.

- Improve the platform continuously - performance tuning, application stability, supportability, and delivery practices.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

- The ability to operate independently with minimal direction and be trusted with ownership of meaningful work

- South technical judgement in ambiguous situations - knowing when to decide, when to ask, and how to defend a trade-off

- A quality-first mindset and genuine attention to detail in what you ship

- The instinct to lift others up - mentoring, unblocking, and modeling good engineering

- Clear, effective written and verbal communication with both technical and business audiences

- The composure to prioritize and deliver across multiple workstreams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

The team

At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Global Employer Services (GES) Technology Group consultants help multinational clients develop programs, processes and digital offerings to manage a global workforce and the compliance obligations arising from global mobility, business travel and remote working. People within our technology group come from a diverse background - they partner with our go-to-market teams and global clients to solve challenging problems and design experiences and products that anticipate what our Deloitte clients will want and solutions that keep them compliant with global and local regulations.

Qualifications

Required:

- Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires US Tax professionals to co-locate in person 2 - 3 days per week

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field.

- 3+ years of software development experience in workflow automation, process management, or case management solutions - through COTS tools such as Pega, custom development such as .NET, or a combination - including demonstrated ownership of features or modules delivered end to end with limited oversight.

- Proven ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions, and a track record of collaborating with, guiding, or mentoring other engineers.

- Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

- Ability to travel up to 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

- One of the following active accreditations obtained in process, or willing/able to obtain:

- Licensed CPA in state of practice/primary office if eligible to sit for the CPA

- If not CPA eligible:

- Licensed Attorney

- Enrolled Agent

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect

- Certified SAFE Agile Software Engineer

- Certified SAFE DevOps Practitioner

- Certified SAFE Architect

Preferred:

- Background supporting multinational clients

- Background with global mobility technology, workforce mobility tools, or compliance reporting solutions

- Experience with cloud infrastructure platforms such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including networking, security controls, and deployment architecture

- Experience with DevOps or DevSecOps practices, continuous integration/continuous deployment tooling, and infrastructure as code

- Experience applying cybersecurity or compliance frameworks such as National Institute of Standards and Technology, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or data privacy standards such as General Data Protection Regulation

- Experience with monitoring, logging, deployment, testing, and other application tooling platforms, as well as Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, or similar program tracking or information technology service management tools

- Pega or TOGAF certification (or willing to obtain)

- Effective written and verbal communication and strong attention to quality.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $102,750 to $195,250.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Location: Alpharetta, Dallas

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Workflow Platform Engineer to help design, build and scale enterprise workflow, orchestration and intelligent automation platforms. The successful candidate will contribute to reusable workflow services, API-driven integrations, event-driven architectures, AI-powered automation capabilities and cloud-native platform services.

This role is ideal for engineers who possess deep expertise in at least one workflow, BPM, orchestration or low-code platform and are excited to work across a broader ecosystem of technologies supporting enterprise-wide automation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Workflow & Platform Engineering

- Design and implement enterprise-scale workflow and orchestration services.

- Develop reusable workflow components, connector frameworks, accelerators, SDKs and platform services.

- Build workflow lifecycle management capabilities including deployment, versioning, monitoring, auditing and governance.

- Support BPMN-based process automation, case management, business rules and event-driven workflows.

- Contribute to multi-tenant, highly scalable workflow platform architectures.

Integration & Automation

- Design integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, messaging systems, cloud services and external platforms.

- Implement API-first and event-driven integration patterns.

- Enable intelligent automation capabilities using AI services, document processing solutions and automation platforms.

- Develop reusable connectors and integration patterns that can be leveraged across multiple business solutions.

Cloud & Engineering Excellence

- Build cloud-native microservices and distributed systems.

- Contribute to DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, observability and platform reliability practices.

- Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews and technical mentoring activities.

- Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, compliance and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or related discipline.

- 7+ years of software engineering experience.

- 3+ years of workflow, orchestration, BPM, low-code or automation platform experience.

- Experience delivering enterprise-scale distributed systems in Agile environments.

Workflow & Automation Platform Experience

Candidates should possess hands-on experience with at least one platform from either of the two categories listed below.

Open BPM & Orchestration Platforms

- Camunda 7 / Camunda 8, Flowable, Fluxnova, Temporal.

Low-Code Platforms

- Pega Infinity, Appian, Microsoft Power Platform, ServiceNow Workflow Automation or IBM Business Automation Workflow.

Business Process & Workflow Knowledge

- BPMN 2.0 and DMN concepts.

- Case Management and Human Task Management.

- Workflow Orchestration and Business Rules Management.

- Process Governance and Workflow Versioning.

- Event Correlation, Long-Running Transactions and Compensation Patterns.

Software Engineering Skills

Programming Languages - experience with at least one

- Java, preferably Spring Boot.

- Python.

- Node.js.

- Go.

Integration Technologies

- REST APIs.

- GraphQL.

- gRPC.

- OpenAPI.

- Event-Driven Architecture.

- Enterprise Integration Patterns.

Messaging & Event Streaming - experience with at least one

- Apache Kafka.

- Confluent Platform.

- RabbitMQ.

- IBM MQ.

- Azure Event Hubs.

Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure

Experience with at least one cloud-native platform or container ecosystem:

- Kubernetes.

- OpenShift.

- Docker.

- Terraform.

- Helm.

- ArgoCD.

- Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI/CD.

Data Technologies

Experience with at least one of the following:

- PostgreSQL.

- Oracle.

- SQL Server.

- Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

- Redis.

- Cassandra.

AI & Intelligent Automation - Preferred

- Azure OpenAI or AWS Bedrock.

- LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI or Semantic Kernel.

- Model Context Protocol (MCP).

- UiPath or Automation Anywhere.

- ABBYY, Intelligent Document Processing or OCR solutions.

Preferred Industry Experience

- Banking, Financial Services or Capital Markets.

- Insurance or Healthcare.

- Public Sector or other highly regulated industries.

What Will Make You Stand Out

- Experience building Workflow-as-a-Service (WaaS) platforms.

- Experience developing reusable workflow frameworks and connector ecosystems.

- Multi-tenant SaaS platform experience.

- Process Mining exposure such as Celonis, Signavio or Camunda Optimize.

- Strong understanding of governance, compliance, audit and operational excellence frameworks.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

- We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:

-

- New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $80,300 to $149,100

- Bay Area California offices – $83,700 to $155,300

- All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $67,000 to $136,800

- Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

- Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

- To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.

- EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

- For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.

Pega Developer (medior/senior) bij BPM Company in Utrecht. Hybride, vast contract, €48.000 - €85.000 bruto/jaar. Je hoeft nog geen Pega te kennen, dat leren we je.

Vind je het leuk om bedrijfsprocessen te doorgronden en bouw je graag applicaties die ze automatiseren? Bij BPM Company breng jij je ervaring als developer mee, en leiden wij je op tot Pega-specialist. Je werkt aan de digitale transformatie van klantorganisaties als de Rabobank, Transavia, De Mandemakersgroep, PGGM of de Nederlandse overheid

In het kort

- Locatie: Utrecht, hybride (deels kantoor, deels thuis)

- Contract: vast (onbepaalde tijd), voltijds

- Salaris: €48.000 - €85.000 bruto/jaar (naar ervaring), plus leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding

- Niveau: medior/senior (± 3 jaar ervaring of meer)

- Instap: uitgebreid onboardingprogramma met officiele Pega-certificeringen

Wat je doet

- Je vertaalt de requirements van de Business Analisten naar een technisch design

- Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het concept, de bouw en een succesvolle implementatie van de applicatie

- Je automatiseert complexe bedrijfsprocessen met het Pega-platform voor klanten in finance, overheid en retail

- Je ontwikkelt je tot een gecertificeerd Pega-specialist, met doorgroei richting Senior Developer of System Architect

Wat je meebrengt

- Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur IT-gerelateerd

- ± 3 jaar ervaring met softwareontwikkeling

- Sterke analytische vaardigheden en een passie voor het automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen

- Je communiceert moeiteloos in het Nederlands en Engels

- Drive om jezelf en anderen verder te ontwikkelen en kennis te delen

Mooi meegenomen (geen dealbreakers)

- Ervaring met BPM en/of case management applicatieontwikkeling

- Ervaring met een low-code platform (Pega, Mendix, OutSystems) of talen als Java of .NET

- Ervaring met of interesse in Pega

Nog nooit met Pega gewerkt? Dat hoeft ook niet. Kom je uit Java, .NET of een ander low-code platform, dan leiden wij je via een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma en officiele certificering op tot Pega-specialist.

Onze kernwaarden

- Connect: Je vindt het vooral leuk maar eveneens belangrijk om écht onderdeel te worden van de organisatie. Betrokkenheid is dan ook iets wat goed bij je past en bent in staat om sterke relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden.

- Driven: Je hebt een proactieve en resultaatgerichte instelling en streeft continu naar verbetering én vindt persoonlijke ontwikkeling belangrijk.

- Deliver: Je levert consistent hoge kwaliteit in je werk en bent betrouwbaar in het nakomen van afspraken.

Wat wij bieden

- Vast contract (onbepaalde tijd)

- Totaal jaarsalaris €48.000 - €85.000 (naar ervaring)

- Uitgebreid onboardingprogramma met officiele Pega-certificering

- Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding, telefoon en laptop

- Training, kennissessies en begeleiding door een team van ervaren Pega Developers

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting Lead System Architect of Solution Architect

- Langdurige, uitdagende projecten bij gerenommeerde klanten

- Een betrokken team dat ook buiten het werk leuke dingen doet (zomer-BBQ, kerstdiner, jaarlijkse company-trip)

Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap?

Solliciteren kan gemakkelijk via LinkedIn, je kan ook altijd eerst een DM sturen of mail naar: careers@bpmcompany.eu
