jobs.description_text:
Vertaal bedrijfsbehoeften naar digitale oplossingen die écht werken.

Als Pega Business Architect bij BPM Company help je toonaangevende organisaties hun processen te verbeteren met innovatieve Pega-oplossingen. Je werkt aan complexe digitaliseringsprojecten bij klanten als Rabobank, Transavia en de Nederlandse overheid, en ontvangt direct een vast contract.

Salaris: € 60.000 – € 85.000 per jaar (afhankelijk van ervaring).

Solliciteer zonder motivatiebrief, binnen 2 werkdagen ontvang je een reactie.

Wat je gaat doen

- Begeleiden van workshops met stakeholders om bedrijfsbehoeften te achterhalen.

- Analyseren van processen en vertalen van de huidige naar de gewenste situatie.

- Ontwerpen van functionele en high-level oplossingen binnen het Pega-platform.

- Samenwerken met Pega System Architecten en ontwikkelteams voor implementatie.

- Borgen van kwaliteit en bruikbaarheid van de uiteindelijke software.

Waarom deze rol impact heeft

Als Pega Business Architect verbind je business en technologie.

Je zorgt dat digitale oplossingen de organisatie versterken — niet andersom.

Met jouw analytische inzicht en communicatieve vaardigheden help je klanten sneller, slimmer en schaalbaarder werken met Pega.

Nog geen ervaring met Pega? Geen probleem.

Als Pega Gold Partner leiden wij ook ervaren Business Analisten of Consultants op tot gecertificeerd Pega Business Architect. Via ons interne opleidingsprogramma behaal je officiële Pega-certificeringen en werk je vanaf dag één aan projecten met impact.

Wie jij bent

- Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Business Analist of Pega Business Architect.

- Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding.

- Analytisch, resultaatgericht en communicatief sterk.

- Bij voorkeur gecertificeerd Pega Business Architect (CBA) of bereid dit te behalen.

- Interesse in digitale transformatie, procesautomatisering en low-code technologie.

Onze kernwaarden

Binnen BPM Company vormen onze kernwaarden de basis van alles wat we doen:

- Connect – we werken samen, delen kennis en bouwen vertrouwen.

- Driven – we zijn ambitieus, leergierig en streven altijd naar beter.

- Deliver – we doen wat we beloven en leveren kwaliteit die resultaat oplevert.

Met de grootste Nederlandse Pega-community bieden we een omgeving waarin je blijft leren. Je krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en volgt een persoonlijk ontwikkeltraject via onze Talent Manager.

Wat je krijgt

- Vast contract vanaf de start.

- Jaarloon tussen € 60.000 en € 85.000.

- Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

- Netto onkostenvergoeding.

- Laptop, telefoon en 25 vakantiedagen.

- Pensioenregeling en bonus (individueel + bedrijfsresultaat).

- Persoonlijke begeleiding en opleidingsbudget.

- Bedrijfsactiviteiten zoals ski-trip, zomerevent, BBQ en kerstfeest.

Klaar om business en technologie te verbinden, met of zonder Pega-ervaring?

Solliciteer nu op de functie Pega Business Architect – BPM Company in Utrecht.

Een motivatiebrief is niet verplicht — reageren kan binnen 2 minuten.

Samen met hen ontwikkelen we duurzame software oplossingen en dragen zo bij aan hun digitale toekomst. We onderscheiden ons door een bovengemiddelde focus op kwaliteit en realiseren dit door onze collega’s volledig te faciliteren en begeleiden tot de best ontwikkelde Pega specialisten.

Bij BPM Company werk je met de meest ervaren Pega-specialisten aan oplossingen die bedrijfsprocessen versnellen, vereenvoudigen en toekomstbestendig maken.

Salaris: € 75.000 – € 110.000 per jaar (afhankelijk van ervaring).

Wat je gaat doen

- Leiden van het technisch ontwerp en coachen van ontwikkelteams.

- Vertalen van functionele behoeften naar robuuste, schaalbare Pega-oplossingen.

- Waarborgen van kwaliteit, performance en security gedurende de hele lifecycle.

- Samenwerken met businessanalisten, architecten en developers aan end-to-end oplossingen.

Je werkt aan langdurige digitale transformaties bij organisaties als Rabobank, Mandemakers Groep en de Nederlandse Overheid.

Je bepaalt als technische autoriteit hoe bedrijven hun processen automatiseren en moderniseren met Pega.

Binnen BPM Company krijg je ruimte om richting te geven aan architectuurkeuzes, innovatie en strategie, samen met collega’s op topniveau binnen de grootste Pega-community van Nederland.

Wie jij bent

- Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in IT of vergelijkbaar.

- Pega CLSA-certificering met minimaal 5 jaar ervaring.

- Ervaring met het leiden van teams en complexe implementaties.

- Actuele kennis van Pega-features, best practices en architectuurprincipes.

- Communicatief sterk in Nederlands en Engels.

- Leergierig en gericht op kennisontwikkeling.

Onze kernwaarden

Connect – we werken samen, delen kennis en bouwen vertrouwen.

Driven – we zijn ambitieus, leergierig en streven altijd naar beter.

Deliver – we doen wat we beloven en leveren kwaliteit die resultaat oplevert.

- Jaarloon tussen € 75.000 en € 110.000.

- Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

- Laptop, telefoon en netto onkostenvergoeding.

jobs.description_text:
Je bent LSA. Je draait complexe projecten. Maar wanneer heb je voor het laatst écht invloed gehad op de technologische koers? Bij BPM Company ben je meer dan alleen een technisch uitvoerder. Je werkt aan impactvolle projecten bij toonaangevende en dynamische organisaties, met de ruimte om jouw visie vorm te geven en bij te blijven met de innovaties van Pega. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar je samenwerkt met inhoudelijk sterke collega’s en waar je continu wordt uitgedaagd om het beste uit jezelf te halen.

Waarom BPM Company dé plek is voor jou als Pega Lead System Architect

Ben je als LSA toe aan meer afwisseling en échte invloed? Bij BPM Company werk je aan impactvolle projecten binnen een divers klantportfolio: van financiële instellingen tot retail en overheid. Dankzij onze langdurige klantrelaties zitten we vroeg aan tafel en ben jij als LSA technisch koersbepalend. Je denkt actief mee over innovatie, schaalbaarheid en toekomstbestendigheid en hebt directe invloed op de business. Tegelijkertijd investeren we doelgericht in jouw professionele groei. Je krijgt hierbij ondersteuning van een eigen Field Manager: een inhoudelijk betrokken sparringpartner die jouw vak verstaat, met je meedenkt en helpt om jouw ambities te vertalen naar concrete groeistappen.

Jouw rol als Pega Lead System Architect

Als LSA ben jij de technische autoriteit binnen onze Pega-projecten. Je ontwerpt schaalbare, herbruikbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen, leidt het technische design en begeleidt het development team. Je waarborgt kwaliteit, performance en security gedurende de hele Application Lifecycle en werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders, developers en andere architecten. Daarbij blijf je actief op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen Pega, zodat je jouw architectuurkeuzes steeds kunt onderbouwen met actuele inzichten en best practices.

Onderdeel van een sterke Pega community

Bij BPM Company maak je deel uit van een hechte community van LSA’s en SSA’s. We stimuleren kennisdeling en innovatie in de volle breedte van het vak: van interne kennissessies tot hackathons en inhoudelijke practice sessies met thema’s als de overgang naar Constellation UX en toepassingen van nieuwe GenAI-mogelijkheden metpraktische toepassingen. Daarnaast nemen we jaarlijks collega’s mee naar PegaWorld, zodat jij als een van de eersten inzicht hebt in de nieuwste roadmap, features en strategische richting van het platform. Zo blijf je altijd een stap voor en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen.

Dit breng jij mee als LSA

- HBO/WO opgeleid

- Pega CLSA gecertificeerd met minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring

- Ervaring met het (bege)leiden van ontwikkelteams

- Ervaren met de nieuwste Pega features en best practices en continu up-to-date met ontwikkelingen.

- Gedreven om jezelf te ontwikkelen

- Communicatief vaardig in zowel het Nederlands & Engels

Dit verdien jij

- Een contract voor onbepaalde tijd

- Bandbreedte jaarsalaris: €75k – €110k

- Een volledige uitrusting zoals leaseauto (of mobiliteitsvergoeding), telefoon en laptop

- Carrière ontwikkeling door ons unieke talent management systeem gericht op Pega

- Een cultuur waarin we samen hard werken, maar waar dat hand in hand gaat met mooie extra’s, zoals bonussen en jaarlijkse skitrips.

- Een plek binnen een betrokken en gedreven team van gelijkgestemde collega’s

Spreek met een professional

Wil jij met één van onze Lead System Architecten praten over werken bij BPM Company? Plan een gesprek in via ons recruitment team en stel al jouw vragen direct aan je eventuele toekomstige collega! Start jouw volgende carrièrefase bij BPM Company, marktleider in low-code en Pega-technologie. Als Business Analist help je toonaangevende organisaties hun processen te digitaliseren met het Pega-platform. Je werkt hybride aan projecten bij klanten als Rabobank, Transavia en de Nederlandse overheid, en ontvangt direct een vast contract.

Salaris: € 60.000 – € 85.000 per jaar (afhankelijk van ervaring).

Solliciteer zonder motivatiebrief, binnen 2 werkdagen ontvang je een reactie.

Wat je gaat doen

- Analyseren en modelleren van bedrijfsprocessen, van as-is tot to-be.

- Vertalen van user stories naar functionele ontwerpen met low-code, GenAI en Robotics.

- Werken met ontwikkelaars, stakeholders en product owners om oplossingen te realiseren.

- Bouwen aan digitale transformaties waar jouw analyses direct zichtbaar resultaat opleveren.

Waarom deze rol impact heeft

Als Business Analist ben jij de schakel tussen business en IT. Je combineert inhoudelijke kennis met technische inzichten en helpt organisaties hun processen te automatiseren met Pega.

Je werkt op strategisch en operationeel niveau aan projecten die direct effect hebben op klanten en gebruikers.

Wie jij bent

- Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Business Analist of Consultant.

- Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding.

- Ervaring met IT en softwareontwikkeling.

- Bekend met Agile/Scrum en procesmodellering.

- Ervaring met BPM is een pré

- Bereidheid om Pega te leren, interesse in AI en Robotics.

- Analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en resultaatgericht.

Onze kernwaarden

Binnen BPM Company vormen onze kernwaarden de basis van alles wat we doen:

- Connect – samenwerken, kennis delen en vertrouwen bouwen.

- Driven – leergierig blijven en elke dag beter worden.

- Deliver – doen wat we beloven en kwaliteit opleveren die resultaat geeft.

Bij BPM Company staan persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling centraal. Met je Talent Manager stel je een persoonlijk kompas op waarmee je gericht werkt aan jouw carrière en vaardigheden.

Wat je krijgt

- Vast contract vanaf de start.

- Jaarloon tussen € 60.000 en € 85.000.

- Leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

- Individuele en bedrijfsbonus.

- Laptop, telefoon en 25 vakantiedagen.

- Pensioenregeling en opleidingsbudget.

- Coaching, training en kennissessies met Pega-experts.

- Teamactiviteiten zoals BBQ’s, ski-trip en kerstevent.

Klaar om met jouw analyses het verschil te maken?

Solliciteer nu op de functie Business Analist (Pega) – BPM Company in Utrecht.

Een motivatiebrief is niet verplicht, reageren kan binnen 2 minuten.

jobs.description_text:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Wir sind als eine der führenden europäischen Management- und Technologieberatungen ein echter Tech-Player. Wir sehen uns als Vordenker*innen, handeln und denken strategisch, entwickeln mit unseren Kunden maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, sowie präzise Prozesse und implementieren innovative Technologien. Weltweit sind wir über 50.000 tech-affine und kluge Köpfe – gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft unserer Kunden und die der Gesellschaft.

Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Einführung der PEGA-Plattform. Die Rolle unterstützt Service- und Projektteams bei der technischen Umsetzung, Weiterentwicklung sowie bei der erfolgreichen Einführung von PEGA in organisatorische Abläufe im Defence-Umfeld.

Bist du bereit, das digitale Europa mitzugestalten?

Stellenbeschreibung

- Als technische Ansprechperson begleitest du alle Fragestellungen rund um PEGA und unterstützt bei der Abstimmung zwischen fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen

- Die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Anwendungen und Workflows gehört ebenso zu deinem Alltag wie die Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen in Prozessen und Systemlösungen

- In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Architekt*innen sowie Projektteams treibst du Lösungen voran und sorgst für eine nachhaltige Integration

- Zusätzlich begleitest du Tests, Qualitätssicherungsmaßnahmen und die Dokumentation, um eine hohe Lösungsqualität sicherzustellen

- Beratung heißt Flexibilität: Dein Projekteinsatz richtet sich nach Kunden und Projektsituation – deutschlandweit, in unseren Offices, beim Kunden vor Ort und remote von zu Hause

Qualifikationen

- Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet deine Basis

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit der PEGA-Plattform, z. B. als PEGA System Architekt, Entwickler oder Business Architekt, bringst du bereits mit und kannst diese sicher in Projekten einsetzen

- Kenntnisse in der Businessanalyse sowie im Anforderungsmanagement helfen dir dabei, fachliche Bedarfe strukturiert zu erfassen und in nachhaltige Lösungen zu überführen

- Erfahrung in der Implementierung von Workflow- und Prozessautomatisierungslösungen sowie in der Einführung oder Weiterentwicklung von Plattformlösungen in komplexen IT-Umgebungen runden dein Profil fachlich ab

- Idealerweise verfügst du über eine PEGA-Zertifizierung sowie erste Erfahrungen oder Zertifizierungen im Projektmanagement

- Ein gutes Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und deren Digitalisierung zeichnet dich aus und unterstützt dich bei der Entwicklung effizienter Lösungen

- Deine Arbeitsweise ist strukturiert, analytisch und lösungsorientiert, verbunden mit einer ausgeprägten Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1 Niveau) sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab

Zusätzliche Informationen

- Weiterbildung: umfangreiche fachliche und methodische Trainings inkl. Zertifizierungen sowie vielfältige Entwicklungsperspektiven innerhalb des Unternehmens

- Work-Life-Balance: hybrides Arbeiten innerhalb von Deutschland und für einen begrenzten Zeitraum in definierten EU-Ländern, Familienservice, Firmenfitness sowie die Möglichkeit zu einem Sabbatical

- Flexible Urlaubsgestaltung: 30 Tage Urlaub und die Möglichkeit zur individuellen Erhöhung oder Verringerung des jährlichen Urlaubs um bis zu 5 Tage

- SpenditCard: Monatlich stehen dir zusätzlich zum Gehalt 50 Euro steuerfreies Guthaben zur Verfügung, die du flexibel für Shops in deiner Nähe nutzen kannst

- IT-Equipment: Wir unterstützen dich bei der Ausstattung von benötigtem Zusatzequipment für ein optimales ortsflexibles Arbeiten

- Mobilität: Firmenwagen und Dienstfahrrad per Gehaltsumwandlung sowie Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets

- Unser Mindset: Teamspirit, offene Türen, Duzkultur, gelebte Vielfalt

Vielfalt ist eine wichtige Grundlage unserer Unternehmenskultur. Wir möchten ein inklusives Umfeld schaffen, das die Diversität all unserer 2.700 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland und Österreich berücksichtigt und in dem du dich bestmöglich entfalten kannst. Denn wir bei Sopra Steria sind davon überzeugt, dass deine Individualität der Schlüssel zu einem nachhaltigen Unternehmenserfolg ist.

Wir setzen uns für eine nachhaltige Zukunft ein: Ob mit konzernweiten Stipendien- und Corporate Volunteering-Programmen oder mit Projekten zur Förderung von Bildung, Chancengleichheit und digitale Inklusion – wir übernehmen Verantwortung für die Gesellschaft. Wir glauben fest daran, dass digitale Innovationen ein Schlüssel zu Gleichberechtigung, Inklusion und Klimaschutz sind.

Impressum

jobs.description_text:
Job ID: 1658

We are looking for a Pega Lead System Architect to join our Corporate Loans team. In this role, you will lead the technical design and implementation of Pega-based solutions supporting loan origination, loan servicing, and the corporate lending lifecycle.

Welcome to Group Technology, where we engineer solutions and support Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view of the bank and its surrounding environment. Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We are a tech-driven bank on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly impacting millions of customers every day.

About This Opportunity

You will join an engineering team within the Corporate Loans Service Domain working with different lending systems. In the team we designs and delivers large-scale Pega solutions in close collaboration with Product Owners, Business Architects, and experienced Pega engineers. With us you will be part of a diverse and inclusive team with real architectural ownership in large‑scale corporate banking transformation, within a culture that values performance, learning, and continuous growth.

You will work alongside our Pega Architects and collaborate with a wider architecture community across Nordea, giving you strong visibility and influence beyond a single application.You will act as the technical expert for the team, setting the development direction, ensuring scalability and quality, and guiding teams through complex design decisions.

What you’ll be doing:

- Lead the system design and development of Pega-based solutions supporting corporate lending.

- Own technical direction and architectural decisions together with our Pega governance in Nordea.

- Ensure scalability, performance, and compliance with enterprise standards and governance.

- Design and govern integration patterns with internal and external systems.

- Drive best practices in architecture, quality, and delivery following Nordea target architectures

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other System Architects and development teams.

- Act as the main escalation point for complex technical challenges.

- Contribute to the inclusive team culture based on trust, shared ownership, and sustainable ways of working.

We follow hybrid model of working. Your future team sits in Gdansk and Łódź ,and leader is based in Copenhagen. We welcome Poland or Finland based applicants to apply.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you:

- Have at least 5 years of relevant IT work experience

- Pega Certified Lead System Architect (CLSA)

- Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade Pega solutions

- Strong understanding of Pega architecture, integration patterns, and performance considerations

- Experience working in complex, multi-stakeholder, international environments

- Confidence to take ownership and drive architectural decisions end-to-end

- Fluency in English

- Are looking for regular employment contract and not B2B

It would be ideal if you also:

- Experience in corporate lending, credit origination, or loan servicing

- Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

- Integrating Pega solution with GenAI and Pega Blueprint experience

What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 30/09/2026. Please note that we will proceed with potential candidates already during the application period.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Only for candidates in Poland: Please include permit for processing personal data in CV as following:

In accordance with art. 6 (1) a and b. Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation) hereinafter ‘GDPR’. I agree to have: my personal data, education and employment history proceeded for the purposes of current and future recruitment processes in Nordea Bank Abp.

The administrator of your personal data is: Nordea Bank Abp operating in Poland through its Branch, address: Aleja Edwarda Rydza Śmiglego 20, 93-281 Łodź. Your personal data will be processed for the recruitment processes in Nordea Bank Abp. You have a right to access your personal data, right to rectify and right to delete. Disclosing the personal data in the scope specified by the provisions of Polish Labour Code from 26 June 1974 and executive acts are mandatory. Providing personal data is necessary to conduct the recruitment processes. The request for the deletion of your personal data means resignation from further participation in recruitment processes and causes the immediate removal of your application. Detailed information concerning processing of your personal data can be found at: https://www.nordea.com/en/doc/nordea-privacy-policy-for-applicants.pdf

- Basic knowledge of BPM principles and process automation

- Experience working in Agile (Scrum) environments and understanding of DevOps practices

- A proactive team player eager to learn, collaborate, and grow within the Pega ecosystem

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT, business, or a related field

- Strong communication skills in English (B2 or higher); German language is a plus

Job Description

We are seeking a structured and analytical Pega CoE Support Developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience to join our centralized Pega Center of Excellence (CoE). Along with building Pega applications, you will play a critical role in supporting, governing, and optimizing our organization's enterprise-wide Pega ecosystem.

In this role, you will assist multiple delivery teams, help manage the shared Enterprise Class Structure (ECS), troubleshoot complex system defects, and ensure all projects adhere to corporate guardrails. This position offers a unique, high-visibility opportunity to see how Pega operates at a massive enterprise scale and accelerate your path toward senior architecture roles.

Responsibilities

- Developer Support & Troubleshooting: Act as the first line of technical support for project teams encountering platform bugs, environmental issues, or rule configuration roadblocks using tools like Tracer and Clipboard.

- Guardrail & Governance Compliance: Monitor application guardrail scores and review rule-sets across different business units to ensure compliance with CoE development standards.

- Component Reusability Management: Help maintain, document, and promote the adoption of centralized, reusable components, data models, and UI templates across the enterprise.

- Release & Deployment Assistance: Assist the CoE deployment leads with rule-set management, skim operations, product rule creation, and CI/CD pipeline deployments.

- Platform Upgrades & Testing: Support the CoE in regression testing, impact analysis, and log monitoring (using PAL/PDC) during Pega platform upgrade cycles.

- Knowledge Sharing: Maintain the CoE wiki, document best practices, and help onboard junior developers or external vendors to the company’s specific Pega environment.

Qualifications

- Pega Certification: Pega Certified System Architect (PCSA) designation preferred; progression toward or completion of the Pega Certified Senior System Architect (PCSSA) is highly preferred

- Hands-on Experience: 2 years of active development or technical support experience on Pega 8.x (or higher); Constellation experience is a plus

- Enterprise Architecture Awareness: Strong understanding of the Pega Enterprise Class Structure (ECS), rule inheritance, and rule-set versioning

- Diagnostic Toolkit: Proficient in analyzing Pega log files and using tools like Pega Diagnostic Center (PDC), Tracer, Clipboard, and Live UI to isolate issues

- Platform Basics: Familiarity with Pega's security model (Access Groups, Roles, Privileges) and basic integration concepts (REST connectors and Data Pages)

- Software Foundations: Basic knowledge of SQL for database queries and an understanding of CI/CD concepts (such as Jenkins or Pega Deployment Manager)

- Service-Oriented Mindset: Strong patience and communication skills to assist and guide developers from various project teams

- Attention to Detail: Analytical approach required to audit code quality and identify architectural deviations

- Multitasking: Ability to handle support tickets from multiple projects simultaneously without losing focus on corporate standards

Actual pay may vary based on Delta Dental’s assessment of the candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), related experience, education, certifications and ability to meet required minimum job qualifications. Other factors impacting pay include prevailing wages in the work location and internal equity.

Job Description

We are seeking a structured and analytical Pega CoE Support Developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience to join our centralized Pega Center of Excellence (CoE). Along with building Pega applications, you will play a critical role in supporting, governing, and optimizing our organization's enterprise-wide Pega ecosystem.

In this role, you will assist multiple delivery teams, help manage the shared Enterprise Class Structure (ECS), troubleshoot complex system defects, and ensure all projects adhere to corporate guardrails. This position offers a unique, high-visibility opportunity to see how Pega operates at a massive enterprise scale and accelerate your path toward senior architecture roles.

Responsibilities

- Developer Support & Troubleshooting: Act as the first line of technical support for project teams encountering platform bugs, environmental issues, or rule configuration roadblocks using tools like Tracer and Clipboard.

- Guardrail & Governance Compliance: Monitor application guardrail scores and review rule-sets across different business units to ensure compliance with CoE development standards.

- Component Reusability Management: Help maintain, document, and promote the adoption of centralized, reusable components, data models, and UI templates across the enterprise.

- Release & Deployment Assistance: Assist the CoE deployment leads with rule-set management, skim operations, product rule creation, and CI/CD pipeline deployments.

- Platform Upgrades & Testing: Support the CoE in regression testing, impact analysis, and log monitoring (using PAL/PDC) during Pega platform upgrade cycles.

- Knowledge Sharing: Maintain the CoE wiki, document best practices, and help onboard junior developers or external vendors to the company’s specific Pega environment.

Qualifications

- Pega Certification: Pega Certified System Architect (PCSA) designation preferred; progression toward or completion of the Pega Certified Senior System Architect (PCSSA) is highly preferred

- Hands-on Experience: 2 years of active development or technical support experience on Pega 8.x (or higher); Constellation experience is a plus

- Enterprise Architecture Awareness: Strong understanding of the Pega Enterprise Class Structure (ECS), rule inheritance, and rule-set versioning

- Diagnostic Toolkit: Proficient in analyzing Pega log files and using tools like Pega Diagnostic Center (PDC), Tracer, Clipboard, and Live UI to isolate issues

- Platform Basics: Familiarity with Pega's security model (Access Groups, Roles, Privileges) and basic integration concepts (REST connectors and Data Pages)

- Software Foundations: Basic knowledge of SQL for database queries and an understanding of CI/CD concepts (such as Jenkins or Pega Deployment Manager)

- Service-Oriented Mindset: Strong patience and communication skills to assist and guide developers from various project teams

Job Description

Job Summary

Provides subject matter expertise in the delivery, execution and maintenance of products. Accountable for maximizing the value of assigned technical products that support enterprise operations. Owns the product vision, backlog, and delivery outcomes and serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.

Defines what is built and why, ensuring solutions align to business outcomes, regulatory requirements, and enterprise strategy, while partnering closely with engineering, architecture, data, QA, and operations teams on how solutions are delivered. Maintains ownership of products across the full lifecycle—from discovery and intake through implementation, stabilization, optimization, and eventual retirement.

This team supports the clinical team, maintaining functionality of systems like LTSS Pega.

Job Duties

- Owns and communicates a clear product vision aligned to enterprise strategy and operational outcomes.

- Maximizes product value by continuously prioritizing work based on business impact, regulatory requirements, risk, dependencies, and sustainability.

- Acts as the single point of accountability for product decisions, tradeoffs, and acceptance of delivered work.

- Serves as the primary escalation point for scope, priority, and requirement decisions.

- Owns the end‑to‑end product lifecycle, including enhancements, defect prioritization, technical debt, and modernization efforts.

- Creates, refines, and maintains a prioritized product backlog reflecting stakeholder needs and technical realities.

- Writes and maintains high‑quality epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.

- Leads backlog refinement and actively participates in Agile ceremonies (planning, reviews, retrospectives).

- Accepts or rejects completed work based on defined acceptance criteria, quality standards, and regulatory alignment.

- Partners with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, constraints, and regulatory obligations.

- Collaborates closely with engineering, architecture, data, QA, operations teams, and Health Plans to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and supportable.

- Translates complex technical concepts into business‑understandable terms and business needs into actionable technical requirements.

- Understands and supports leadership escalation protocols.

- Ensures product delivery aligns with security, regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements.

- Partners with health plan, compliance, legal, and audit teams as needed to support reviews and implementations.

- Ensures product documentation, controls, and artifacts remain current, accurate, and audit‑ready.

- Proactively identifies delivery risks and works with teams to mitigate impacts.

- Monitors product performance, usage, and outcomes; uses data and feedback to inform backlog priorities.

- Identifies opportunities for automation, optimization, and simplification of solutions.

- Supports enterprise goals related to standardization and reduction of unmanaged complexity.

- Owns one or more defined products or product areas with moderate complexity.

- Works under established product strategy, governance, and prioritization frameworks.

- Partners closely with stakeholders to clarify requirements and translate needs into backlog items.

- Manages competing priorities within a defined scope and escalates complex tradeoffs as needed.

- Demonstrates growing autonomy in backlog management, delivery decisions, and stakeholder engagement.

- Case management experience with LTSS Pega OR Project / Program management is required.

- Experience working with Jira preferred.

- Clinical experience is highly preferred.

Job Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- At least 5 years of experience in product ownership, product management, business analysis, or technical solution delivery.

- Demonstrated experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery models.

- Experience supporting technical products such as enterprise platforms, configuration tools, data solutions, integrations, or operational systems.

- Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and Agile principles.

- Proven ability to write clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria.

- Experience prioritizing work in complex, highly regulated environments.

- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence across technical and non‑technical audiences.

- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information.

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior Product Owner or Product Manager certification strongly preferred at time of hire.

- Experience with enterprise platforms, APIs, integrations, or configuration‑heavy systems.

- Experience in healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industries.

- Familiarity with Agile tooling (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally).

Vos futures missions

Au sein du Centre d’expertise et de supervision (CES) PEGA, vous contribuerez à garantir une utilisation optimale et pérenne de la solution au service des entités du Groupe. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement structuré, composé d’équipes agiles et d’expert(e)s dédié(e)s à l’industrialisation, à la performance et à l’intégration de PEGA dans le SI Groupama. Votre rôle soutiendra directement l’extension de notre périmètre fonctionnel et technique.

Pour atteindre ses objectifs, notre équipe est constituée d'experts et de développeurs expérimentés (40 personnes) organisés en équipes agiles adaptées à une solution transverse commune à l'ensemble de nos entités (Groupama, Gan Assurance, Gan Vie).

- Assurer l’intégration de la solution dans le SI Groupama et contribuer à son alignement architectural.

- Participer à l’industrialisation de la solution (DevOps) et à l’amélioration continue.

- Tester les configurations, corriger les défauts et documenter les réalisations.

- Suivre les évolutions éditeur pour garantir la cohérence des choix techniques.

- Pratique des méthodes agiles (Scrum, Kanban).

Join Tata Consultancy Services, Asia Pacific and be part of an organization committed to sustainable development for our future. TCS follows the Tata group philosophy of building sustainable businesses that are rooted in the community and demonstrate care for the environment. Our unique values position us to combine a purpose-driven worldview with digital innovation, collaborating with customers, communities and governments to lead and shape innovative solutions for a sustainable future. TCS has been carbon neutral in its operations across 11 countries, 12 delivery centres and 18 offices in Asia Pacific since 2022. This is only the initial stage in TCS’ journey as we strive to achieve long-term net zero emissions by 2030.

Corporate sustainability is embedded in our triple-bottom-line, focusing on people, the planet, and our purpose. Our offices are designed with eco-friendly features that significantly reduce our carbon footprint and enhance energy efficiency. We actively champion green initiatives, such as promoting paperless operations, implementing energy-efficient practices, and fostering employee engagement in sustainability efforts. When you become part of the TCS family, you will play an essential role dedicated to innovation, excellence, and crafting a brighter, greener future together. Join us and be a part of our mission to drive sustainability through technology and talent at Tata Consultancy Services, APAC today.

Role: Pega Senior Decision Architect

Location: Sydney

You'll make impact by:

- Design, build and optimise Next Best Action strategies in Pega Customer Decision Hub, translating business objectives and customer lifecycle goals into scalable, model driven decision logic that delivers relevant, personalised customer interactions.

- Own the end‑to‑end decisioning design within CLM squads, working closely with NBA Designers, Analysts, Data Science and business stakeholders to define decision frameworks, requirements, and measurable outcomes.

- Configure and govern Pega CDH components, including actions, treatments, engagement policies, arbitration rules, taxonomies and strategy frameworks, ensuring alignment with Pega guardrails, CDH best practices, and enterprise architecture standards.

- Lead decisioning experimentation and performance optimisation, designing and executing A/B testing, multivariate testing, control groups, and simulations to drive continuous improvement and quantify business uplift.

- Partner with Data Science and Insights teams to analyse customer, behavioural, and performance data, ensuring decision strategies are data‑driven, explainable, and continuously optimised over time.

- Provide strategic oversight and stewardship of the decisioning ecosystem, contributing to the evolution of NBA frameworks, reusable patterns, and best practices to support long‑term maturity of the Martech & Decisioning capability.

- Ensure decisioning solutions comply with regulatory, consent, and ethical marketing requirements, embedding privacy, fairness, and governance considerations into all NBA designs.

- Act as a senior subject‑matter expert for Pega CDH, coaching team members, uplifting capability, and fostering a collaborative, innovative, and high‑performing decisioning culture across CLM and Martech teams.

What you’ll bring:

- Degree in relevant areas such as Business, Marketing, IT, Maths, Information Systems or Finance

- Extensive hands‑on experience with Pega Customer Decision Hub, including designing and implementing Next Best Action strategies using Pega’s Strategy Framework (v8.23 preferred; v8.7+ acceptable), with exposure to Pega 1:1 Operations Manager preferred.

- Strong analytical and capabilities, with the ability to translate complex business objectives into scalable, well‑governed decision logic.

- Proven experience designing and evaluating experimentation frameworks, including A/B testing, control groups, and performance measurement to drive continuous improvement of customer decisioning strategies.

Ideally, you will also have:

- Solid data literacy, including strong SQL skills and a good understanding of relational data models (experience with Teradata and/or PostgreSQL is advantageous), enabling confident collaboration with analytics and data science teams.

- Exposure to cloud‑based environments such as AWS, Azure, or Pega Cloud.

- A clear understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for direct marketing and customer decisioning, including privacy, consent, and ethical use of data (Privacy Act, Spam Act, DNCR Act).

Top Reasons to Join Our Team at TCS Australia

Attractive compensation & rewards

We offer a highly competitive salary package aligned with the Australian market, complemented by performance-based incentives, recognition programs, and comprehensive employee benefits. Your achievements are celebrated, and your contributions truly matter.

Global exposure with local impact

At TCS, you’ll work with leading Australian enterprises across diverse industries while collaborating with our global network of experts. This means access to world-class practices, transformative technologies, and the chance to shape solutions that have a real impact — locally and globally.

Empowering leadership & supportive environment

Our leadership team is committed to helping you succeed. We encourage initiative, reward innovation, and provide a collaborative environment where your ideas are heard and valued.

Long-term career growth

We believe in careers, not just jobs. With continuous learning, certification support, career mobility, and clear progression pathways, TCS empowers you to grow and evolve — whether you want to deepen your expertise, explore new domains, or take on leadership roles.

Inclusive, collaborative culture

Diversity, inclusion, and respect are central to who we are. At TCS Australia, you’ll join a workplace where collaboration thrives, individuality is valued, and everyone can contribute to meaningful outcomes.

Continuous learning & cutting-edge innovation

We invest heavily in your development, offering structured learning programs, global certifications, leadership development, and opportunities to work with emerging technologies. You’ll be part of an environment that constantly challenges and expands your capabilities.

A Great Fit for the TCS Culture

We’re looking for people who are:

- Passionate about technology and transformation

- Driven by curiosity, innovation, and continuous learning

- Excited to work in a collaborative, purpose-driven environment

- Motivated by delivering real impact for clients, communities, and society

Our core values — Integrity, Excellence, Responsibility, Pioneering Spirit, and Unity — shape how we work and how we grow together.

The TCS Community in Australia and Beyond

- Global strength: Over 600,000+ associates in 55+ countries, united by a shared purpose — to innovate and make a difference.

- Local presence: A trusted partner to Australia’s leading enterprises across financial services, government, retail, healthcare, telecom, and more.

- Social impact: Deeply committed to sustainability, digital inclusion, and community engagement initiatives in Australia and around the world.

- Empowered workplace: We foster a culture where diversity, equity, and accessibility are integral to how we operate.

We don’t just imagine a better future — we help build it.

The role involves leading solution design, mentoring development teams, enforcing Pega best practices, and ensuring successful delivery of high-quality, scalable solutions.

Essential Technical Qualification:

- Mandatory - Certified Lead System Architect (LSA) (both Part 1 & 2)

- Overall 8+years and 7+ years relevant Pega experience and at least 3-5 Pega projects implementation.

- Pega experience across versions 6.6 to Pega Infinity 25.1 and above.

- Proven experience in architecting and implementing end-to-end Pega solutions in large-scale enterprise environments.

- Hands-on experience/knowledge with Pega Constellation.

- Familiar with Generative AI tools and capabilities.

- Experience in solutions development on Pega using Pega forms, workflows, data models, layer cake, integration and Pega mobility.

- Hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, coding, integration, implementation, and deployment within Pega environments.

- Strong understanding of Case management concepts, Activities, Flows, SSO Integrations, Connectors, Services and Data Interactions.

- Debugging Skills & User Interfaces in PRPC. Experience of integrating Pega with other Technology Platforms.

- Experience in working on Agile/Scrum methodologies.

- Experience with building security first solutions, authorisation, identity, encryption, authentication, OWASP, SSOA and RBAC.

- Good understanding of Relational Database Management Systems including architecting and designing for performance and scalability and working with Object to Relational Mapping schemes for distributed data access.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead and mentor the development team, providing technical guidance and support as required.

- Responsible for architecting and designing business applications using Pega PRPC and related Pega frameworks.

- Drive the design, development, testing, and deployment of scalable and maintainable solutions within the PRPC Rules environment.

- Create technical designs, define enterprise class structures, and review infrastructure requirements such as data architecture definitions and data management plans.

- Collaborate with the Solution Architect to deliver end-to-end Pega applications and projects.

- Understand the customer's enterprise technology landscape and position Pega effectively within the overall architecture.

- Responsible for estimation and enterprise class structure design, ensuring the overall application design aligns with enterprise standards.

- Demonstrated expertise in code review, optimization, and Pega application performance analysis, including performance tuning. Responsible for analysing, identifying, and logging application enhancements and defects.

- Ensure the application not only meets current business needs but is also designed to accommodate future scalability and feature enhancements.

- Analyze and resolve complex design and configuration challenges to meet defined objectives.

- Prepare High-Level Designs (HLDs), low-code platform solutions, and gather non-functional requirements (NFRs).

- Review and approve solution designs, logic configurations, and technical artifacts to ensure alignment with Pega best practices.

- Oversee and execute deployment activities across all environments, including Production.

- Provide accurate time and resource estimates for project deliverables in line with established processes.

- Offer technical inputs on dependencies, sequencing, and risks to assist the Project Manager in project planning and execution.

Preferred Qualification: (Optional/Good to have)

- Experience in any of the Pega frameworks, Underwriting, CS, CRM, CPM, BFSI, Smart Dispute, Smart Investigate, CLM/KYC etc.

- Exposure to Pega Decisioning or Pega Marketing modules, with a solid grasp of their application within customer engagement and business process workflows.

Accenture is a leading global provider of a broad range of professional services in strategy and consulting, interactive marketing, information technology and business operations services, with digital capabilities in all of these areas. Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The work

The Pega Senior System Architect (SSA) is responsible for designing, building, and configuring Pega applications that meet complex business process and application requirements. In this role, you will leverage deep Pega Platform expertise to streamline business processes, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver high‑quality technical solutions. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration, deployment, and continuous improvement of Pega applications. A strong background in Pega development—supported by required Pega certification—and familiarity with DevOps tools and practices will be key to success. Your ability to interpret business needs, transform them into scalable technical designs, and support the full development lifecycle will play a critical role in driving project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and configure Pega Platform applications to meet business and technical requirements

- Translate business requirements into functional and technical solution designs

- Develop application components including data models, process flows, case structures, integrations, UI, and business rules

- Apply Pega SSA best practices and guardrails in all development activities

- Collaborate with DevOps teams to support code integration, deployment, and environment readiness

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the application lifecycle

- Ensure solutions are performant, scalable, secure, and maintainable

- Provide knowledge transfer, mentoring, and technical guidance to junior team members

- Maintain clear, well‑structured, and supportable technical documentation

Here’s What You Need

- Pega Certification Required — aligned with internal certification guidance (e.g., Pega Certified Senior System Architect – CSSA)

- Hands-on experience building Pega applications including rules, case types, integrations, and UI

- Experience designing solutions that meet business process and technical requirements

- Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools supporting CI/CD pipelines

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

- Ability to interface effectively with both technical and business partners

Nice to have

- Experience supporting large-scale enterprise implementations

- Exposure to cloud-based Pega deployments or containerized environments

- Knowledge of complementary technologies (APIs, databases, authentication methods)

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field

Job Profile

Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Software Engineer Sr - Pega Developer within PNC's Treasury Management Service & Implementations Technology organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA; Dallas, TX.

The Software Engineer Senior will join a highly visible team within Corporate & Institutional Banking that is transforming how large commercial clients establish and manage banking relationships. And develop enterprise-scale automation solutions that streamline complex account onboarding, compliance validation, customer due diligence, and servicing processes for large corporations operating across multiple locations.

This role combines deep Pega Platform expertise with strong technical design capabilities, solution architecture experience, and a passion for building scalable business process automation solutions in a fast-paced Agile environment.

PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.

PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

Core Responsibilities

- Lead the technical design, architecture, and development of complex enterprise applications using the Pega Platform to automate banking onboarding, compliance, and servicing workflows.

- Translate business requirements into scalable Pega solutions that support customer validation, due diligence, compliance verification, and operational process automation.

- Design and develop sophisticated Case Management, Business Process Management (BPM), workflows, stages, case types, business rules, and decisioning capabilities.

- Build and maintain applications utilizing Pega Constellation and modern Pega Infinity 24+ capabilities to deliver intuitive and responsive user experiences.

- Develop and configure Data Pages, Data Transforms, Decision Tables, Activities, Report Definitions, and reusable application components.

- Design and implement integrations using REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, JSON, XML, DX APIs, messaging frameworks, and external systems.

- Partner with architects, project managers, business analysts, QA teams, and stakeholders to ensure successful solution delivery.

- Apply Pega Guardrails, platform best practices, and enterprise development standards to ensure maintainable and scalable applications.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

Meet the KYC (Know Your Customer) team. We collect, assess, and profile customers to support effective cooperation and comply with legal standards.

Our Technology team is based in Warsaw and 3City, Poland, within the Financial Crime Prevention Service Area. We work with Java microservices, the PEGA CLM application, and Cloudera/Hadoop data centers.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

- Lead the architecture and design of Pega-based solutions, ensuring scalability and performance.

- Collaborate with stakeholders to define requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

- Drive change and innovation within the organization by introducing best practices and modern approaches.

- Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams.

- Ensure compliance with enterprise standards and governance.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you have:

- Minimum 5 years of experience in Pega architecture and development.

- Proven expertise in CLM frameworks and related integrations.

- Strong understanding of Pega design principles and implementation strategies.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ownership and accountability in delivering complex projects.

- Ability to drive change and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Your background and skills include:

- Pega CLSA certification.

- Experience in financial services or regulated industries.

- Knowledge of integration patterns and API management.

- Know KYC framework in PEGA.

- Live in 3City, Poland.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of t he largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 09/10/2026.

- Preliminary CV selection

- Online interview with the hiring leader

- Background check & References

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

Mō Mātou | About us

At ASB, we believe progress is more than just financial - it's about helping New Zealanders, communities, and our environment thrive together. We're a purpose-led organisation with a proud history and a clear vision: to support Kiwis in getting one step ahead. Our work is guided by strong values - care, courage and curiosity - and brought to life by a diverse team of people who genuinely care about making a difference.

As one of Aotearoa's most trusted banking partners, we combine the stability and scale of a large organisation with a culture that ensures you're recognised as an individual. Your ideas, your growth, and your contribution matter here - and you'll be supported to do meaningful work that has a real impact, every day

Mō te Tūranga | About the role

ASB is establishing a Pega Centre of Excellence (CoE) to provide enterprise-wide governance, standards, reusable practices and expert support across our Pega ecosystem. We are looking for a Pega System Architect to help execute the CoE roadmap while building practical experience across Pega delivery, platform standards and continuous improvement.

Working with senior Pega architects, engineers, Product Owners and delivery teams, you will configure and enhance Pega applications, contribute to reusable assets and documentation, and support squads in applying CoE guardrails. This role suits a Pega engineer who has a sound foundation in the platform, enjoys learning and is ready to grow through hands-on delivery and coaching.

Key Responsibilities

- Configure, test and maintain Pega application features under the guidance of senior System Architects and Lead System Architects.

- Translate well-defined business requirements and user stories into secure, supportable Pega solutions.

- Build and update case types, workflows, user interfaces, data objects, decision rules and integrations in line with agreed designs.

- Apply Pega guardrails, development standards, naming conventions and reusable patterns promoted by the CoE.

- Support the creation and maintenance of reusable components, templates, guidance and technical documentation.

- Participate in design discussions, peer reviews, testing, defect resolution and deployment activities.

- Use Pega tools and delivery pipelines to manage application changes, investigate issues and support reliable releases.

- Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Architects, testers, engineers and operational teams to deliver customer-focused outcomes.

- Contribute to CoE initiatives such as standards adoption, platform health, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

- Keep your Pega knowledge current and actively seek feedback, coaching and opportunities to grow your technical capability.

Ō Pūkenga | About you

You are a Pega engineer with a solid understanding of the platform and some practical experience delivering or supporting Pega applications. You are comfortable working within established designs and standards, ask thoughtful questions and take ownership of delivering high-quality work.

You bring curiosity, care and a collaborative mindset. You communicate clearly, respond constructively to feedback and enjoy working with others to solve problems. You are motivated to deepen your Pega capability while helping the CoE embed standards, reusable practices and continuous improvement across day-to-day delivery.

Ngā mea kia whai angitū ahau? | What do I need to be successful?

- Pega Certified System Architect (PCSA) certification is required.

- Practical experience configuring or supporting Pega applications in a project, internship or production environment.

- Foundational understanding of Pega case management, workflows, user interfaces, data models, decision rules and application security.

- Ability to interpret user stories and solution designs and implement well-scoped changes with guidance.

- Awareness of Pega guardrails, reusable design, troubleshooting and application performance principles.

- Experience with unit testing, defect resolution, peer review and maintaining clear technical documentation.

- Basic understanding of APIs and integrations, source control, CI/CD or Pega deployment practices.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to quality and customer outcomes.

- Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an agile, cross-functional team.

- A learning mindset and willingness to develop towards the Pega Certified Senior System Architect pathway.

- Experience in financial services or another regulated environment is advantageous but not essential.

He aha tā mātou | What can we offer

Get the work-life equation right. We understand life is full of priorities, and we’re here to help you find balance with a flexible and supportive working environment.

What’s important to you is important to us. We support your wellbeing with comprehensive health insurance, wellness initiatives, parental and flexible leave, and customisable benefits.

Bring your whole self to work. We’re building a culture where everyone feels safe, included, and empowered to succeed.

Grow your technical capability. With access to modern tooling, cloud platforms, and large-scale systems, you’ll continue to deepen your expertise while delivering meaningful outcomes.

Me pēhea te tona | How to apply?

We know great people come from all sorts of backgrounds, and you don't need to tick every box to apply. What matters most is you bring your unique strengths and enthusiasm to the team.

To be considered, all applications need to go through our online career channels and will be treated with confidentiality. Check out the position description to find out more.

We appreciate the time and effort you put into applying and will keep you updated throughout the process.

- Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology.

- Activities and utility functions

- Report definitions and performance optimization

- Authentication (OAuth, SSO, LDAP)

Soft Skills

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

- Ability to lead technical discussions and design workshops

- Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams

- Mentorship and team leadership capabilities

jobs.description_text:
Stellen-ID: 288857

Bei Vodafone arbeiten wir jeden Tag an einer besseren Zukunft. Für eine Welt, die besser vernetzt, inklusiver und nachhaltiger ist. Denn für uns ist Technologie nur so stark wie die Menschen, die sie nutzen. Sei dabei und lass uns gemeinsam die Welt von morgen gestalten.

In der Gruppe „IESD BPM Delivery“ arbeiten wir an der Automatisierung und Digitalisierung der Prozesse der Vodafone Enterprise IT in allen Bereichen, wie z.B. Order Fulfillment oder Customer Care/Customer Request Management. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem indischen VOIS offshore Team setzen wir dabei auf die Plattform Pega Infinity in einem AWS Cloud Setup und nutzen darüber hinaus weitere moderne Technologien und Methoden (DevOps, AI/Machine Learning, SAFe/Scrum/Agile etc.)

Was Dich erwartet:

- Du übernimmst als Pega Infinity Architekt CSSA/CLSA (m/w/d) die Lead-Designer-Rolle für eine Applikation basierend auf der Plattform Pega Infinity

- Du arbeitest in einem agilen Setup eng mit den Business Stakeholdern deiner Applikation zusammen, unterstützt sie in regelmäßigen Workshops bei der Definition ihrer Anforderungen und erstellst darauf basierend ein Application-/Feature-Design

- Du arbeitest in einem agilen Setup eng mit dem indischen offshore Development Team (VOIS) zusammen und leitest es bei der Implementierung deiner Designs an

- Du hast einen permanenten Blick auf Erweiterbarkeit, Wiederverwendbarkeit, Erhöhung des Automatisierungsgrades und den kreativen Einsatz moderner Technologien

Was Dich auszeichnet:

- Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, des Ingenieurwesens oder der Mathematik.

- Mindestens 5 Jahre Development Erfahrung mit der Plattform Pega Infinity sowie Erfahrung im Pega Applikations-Design (idealerweise CSSA/CLSA Zertifizierung)

- Abstraktionsfähigkeit und die Lust, komplexe Anforderungen in elegante, erweiterbare und implementierbare Designs herunterzubrechen

- Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu kommunizieren

- Spaß an der Lösung von Problemen sowie an strategischen Applikationserweiterungen

- Kenntnisse agiler Methoden und Tools (Scrum, SAFe, Confluence, Jira)

- Hohe Innovationsbereitschaft und die Fähigkeit, Innovationen erfolgreich umzusetzen

- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B2 nach GER).

Diese Stelle kann in Vollzeit oder vollzeitnaher Teilzeit (mind. 30 Stunden) ausgeübt werden.

Deine Stärken und Erfahrungen zählen. Uns sind Vielfalt und gleiche Chancen wichtig. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung. Und beachten sie bei gleicher Eignung besonders.

Wir besetzen diese Stelle am Standort Düsseldorf für die Vodafone GmbH.

Was wir Dir bieten:

- Flexibilität: Hybrid Working ermöglicht Dir die Arbeit im Büro oder bis zu 3 Tage/Woche aus dem Homeoffice. Zusätzlich kannst Du bis zu 20 Tage pro Jahr im EU-Ausland sowie in immer mehr Nicht-EU-Ländern arbeiten

- Attraktive Vergütung und Altersvorsorge: Neben deinem Grundgehalt bekommst Du eine erfolgsabhängige Bonus- oder Provisionszahlung und mit unserem Pensionsplan auch eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge

- Weiterbildung: Du entscheidest, mit welchen unserer Lern- und Trainingsprogrammen Du Deine individuelle Entwicklung förderst

- Work-Life-Balance: Ob Kita, Gesundheits- & Achtsamkeitsprogramme oder Fitnessstudio: Du gestaltest flexibel Deinen Job und Dein Privatleben. Wir unterstützen Dich. Auch bei der Pflege von Angehörigen

- Rabatte und Zusatzleistungen: Als Mitarbeiter:in bekommst Du besondere Angebote auf alle unsere Produkte für Mobilfunk, Festnetz, Internet und TV.

Wer wir sind:

Vodafone feiert und fördert Diversität und Inklusion. Wir sind so verschieden wie unsere Kund:innen und unsere Gesellschaft. Ob ethnische Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung, Religion, politische Zugehörigkeit, Gewerkschaftszugehörigkeit, Nationalität, Gesundheitszustand, soziale Herkunft oder kultureller Hintergrund: Bei Vodafone ist kein Platz für Diskriminierung.

Together we can.

We are

At Synechron, we believe in the power of digital to transform businesses for the better. Our global consulting firm combines creativity and innovative technology to deliver industry-leading digital solutions. Synechron’s progressive technologies and optimization strategies span end-to-end Artificial Intelligence, Consulting, Digital, Cloud & DevOps, Data, and Software Engineering, servicing an array of noteworthy financial services and technology firms. Through research and development initiatives in our FinLabs we develop solutions for modernization, from Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain to Data Science models, Digital Underwriting, mobile-first applications and more. Over the last 20+ years, our company has been honored with multiple employer awards, recognizing our commitment to our talented teams. With top clients to boast about, Synechron has a global workforce of 16,700+, and has 57 offices in 22 countries within key global markets.

Position Overview

- We are seeking an experienced Pega Developer with strong expertise in Pega Constellation architecture and application development. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and implementing scalable Pega applications using modern UI and low-code development practices.

- The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience delivering enterprise-grade solutions using Pega Platform, Constellation UI, Case Management, App Studio, and Pega Infinity.

Additional Information

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within Charlotte, NC is $120K - $130K/year & benefits (see below)

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, configure, and implement Pega applications using Pega Constellation.

- Build modern, responsive user experiences using Constellation UI components and design patterns.

- Develop and configure case types, workflows, stages, processes, data objects, views, and business rules.

- Use Pega App Studio and Pega Dev Studio to deliver business applications.

- Translate business and technical requirements into scalable Pega solutions.

- Configure case lifecycle management, approvals, SLAs, notifications, correspondence, and service-level workflows.

- Develop integrations with external systems using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, APIs, connectors, and data pages.

- Design and configure data models, data objects, data views, and reusable application components.

- Apply Pega best practices for architecture, performance, security, maintainability, and reuse.

- Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, QA engineers, product owners, and stakeholders.

- Participate in code reviews, technical design sessions, unit testing, defect resolution, and deployment activities.

- Troubleshoot application issues and optimize performance using Pega debugging and monitoring tools.

- Support CI/CD, version control, release management, and deployment across environments.

- Prepare technical documentation, solution designs, development standards, and implementation guides.

- Stay current with Pega Constellation product capabilities, roadmap updates, and emerging best practices.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

- 10+ years of experience in Pega development, preferably on Pega Infinity or Pega Platform.

- Strong hands-on experience with Pega Constellation and modern Pega application development.

- Experience with Pega App Studio and Dev Studio.

- Strong knowledge of:Case Management

- Workflow and process design

- Data modeling and data objects

- Views, forms, layouts, and UI configuration

- Business rules and decision logic

- Data pages and integration patterns

- Security, roles, access groups, and authorization

- SLAs, notifications, correspondence, and approvals

- Experience developing integrations using REST and SOAP web services.

- Proficiency in Pega debugging, tracing, performance analysis, and error handling.

- Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Pega Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA) or higher.

- Pega Constellation certification or relevant Constellation implementation experience.

- Experience migrating or modernizing applications from Theme Cosmos or traditional Pega UI to Constellation.

- Experience with Pega DX API, React-based front-end integration, or headless application patterns.

- Knowledge of Pega Customer Service, Pega Platform, Pega Financial Services, Pega Healthcare, or other industry frameworks.

- Experience with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

- Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Pega Cloud.

- Experience with automated testing and PegaUnit testing.

- Understanding of accessibility, responsive design, and user-centered application design.

Key Skills

- Pega Constellation

- Pega Platform / Pega Infinity

- Pega App Studio

- Pega Dev Studio

- Case Management

- Workflow Automation

- UI and View Configuration

- Data Pages and Data Modeling

- REST and SOAP Integrations

- Pega DX API

- Decisioning and Business Rules

- Agile/Scrum

- CI/CD and DevOps

- Application Performance and Troubleshooting

We offer:

- A highly competitive compensation and benefits package.

- A multinational organization with 60 offices in 20 countries and the possibility to work abroad.

- 10 days of paid annual leave (plus sick leave and national holidays).

- Maternity & paternity leave plans.

- A comprehensive insurance plan including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and long-/short-term disability (plans vary by region).

- Retirement savings plans.

- A higher education certification policy.

- Commuter benefits (varies by region).

- Extensive training opportunities, focused on skills, substantive knowledge, and personal development.

- On-demand Udemy for Business for all Synechron employees with free access to more than 5000 curated courses.

- Coaching opportunities with experienced colleagues from our Financial Innovation Labs (FinLabs) and Center of Excellences (CoE) groups.

- Cutting edge projects at the world’s leading tier-one banks, financial institutions and insurance firms.

- A flat and approachable organization.

- A truly diverse, fun-loving, and global work culture.

SYNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT

Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.

All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At ASB, we believe progress is more than just financial - it's about helping New Zealanders, communities, and our environment thrive together. Our work is guided by strong values, care, courage and curiousity, and brought to life by a diverse team of people who genuinely care about making a difference.

Key Responsibilities

- Provide expert consultation on software architecture, integration, and tooling

- Build reusable, scalable, and secure solutions using modern engineering practices

- Promote clean code, automation, and performance optimisation

銀行、保険など金融業界のお客様に加え、通信業界、eコマースなど様々な業種へ展開中

■組織構成

課長3名、主任5名、担当1名

【携わる事業・ビジネス・サービス・製品など】

■当事業部では、業種業態を超えてPegaの適用・展開を目ざしており、お客様へのプレから受注後の要件定義から設計・開発、保守まで対応します。

Pega Platformの適用を通じて、グローバルで活用できる技術を身に着け、個々人の価値を高めていって頂きたい。

・日立HP：（https://www.hitachi.co.jp/products/it/harmonious/cloud/service/pega/index.html）

・ペガシステムズHP：（https://www.pega.com/services/partnerships/partner-finder/results?q=hitachi）

【募集背景】

国内におけるBPMソリューションのニーズ拡大への対応が急務であり、特にPega Platform適用プロジェクトのリーダとして、中規模、大規模開発案件のリーダ層が必要。また、今後は日立グループ海外要員のタレントを積極的に活用していくため、外国人を含むプロジェクトをリードできる人材が必要になるため、人財募集を行う。

【職務概要】

担当するPega Platform適用プロジェクトのアーキテクチャの責任者として、アーキテクチャの設計および各担当の成果物のレビューを行い、適切にフィードバックする。

【職務詳細】

・1つ以上のプロジェクトに参画し、設計における最終責任者となる。

・技術的バックグラウンドもあり、Pega開発部分のアーキテクチャの設計、担当者の設計・開発のレビューを行う。

【ポジションの魅力・やりがい・キャリアパス】

■国内では有数のPega Authorized Partnerに認定された弊社でのプロジェクト経験を通じて、3rd Partyソリューションの展開ビジネスを広く理解することができます。

■グローバルで展開されているPega Platformの適用経験を積んでいただくことで、将来は国内のみならず米国やその他外国でのキャリア構築が期待できます。

■幅広い業種業態を通して、様々なお客様や社内との連携により、様々なノウハウ取得でき、新たな価値を提供できる。また、人脈形成が可能です。

【働く環境】

1.配属組織/チーム構成

配属組織は、ペガの専門部隊となります。各お客様適用案件にてご活躍頂きますので、配属組織のメンバーより、プロジェクトメンバーとのコミュニケーションが多くなります。

2.働き方

配属先プロジェクトにより、リモートワーク、弊社新川崎オフィス勤務、顧客先勤務の可能性があります。

※上記内容は、募集開始時点の内容であり、入社後必要に応じて変更となる場合がございます。予めご了承ください。

応募資格
【必須条件】

■TOEIC 650点以上 または 外国人と英語でプロジェクト推進した経験のある方。

・Innovation（イノベーションを起こす）：

【その他職種特有】
