jobs.description_text:
Meet Our Team

Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high-quality, outcome-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.

Picture Yourself At Pega

Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.

At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.

We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

What You'll Do At Pega

- Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment

- Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle

- Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions

- Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.

- Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro-actively respond to adhoc questions

Who You Are

- Pega CLSA Certified resource must.

- You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.

- 12 plus years of Pega experience in building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions.

- Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities

- Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate

- Willingness to go the extra mile

- Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example

- Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business & IT stakeholders

- Open to work from 1:00 - 10:00 PM IST

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.

You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You've Accomplished

- You’ve built and implemented model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions and applications.

- You’ve led end-to-end delivery of medium to large component of bigger solution.

- You’ve been exposed to a variety of technologies including Application Servers, programming languages, relational and non-relational data bases and integration techniques.

- You’ve demonstrated knowledge of and applicability of Object-Oriented techniques and principles.

- You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologie

Pega Offers You

- Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.

- Continuous learning and development opportunities.

- An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment.

- Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company

- An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

jobs.description_text:
MAIN PURPOSE

We are looking for a PEGA SA/SSA to provide enterprise-level PEGA development for our Customer Service front-end application.

PEGA SA/SSA responsibilities include capturing and understanding business requirements, designing and implementing solutions, as well as supporting the application during its entire lifecycle. This includes monitoring, diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving issues on different technical platforms but mostly on PEGA Platform 8 and PEGA 25.

You will refer to the Tech Team Lead, who will guide you on the priorities. For more complex problems that require nuanced instruction, you will be in touch with the platform Technical Lead and the platform architect/LSA.

Role

To be qualified for this role, you should hold a degree in a relevant field, such as Computer Science or Software Engineering with experience on:

- PEGA Platform 8 or above

- Rest APIs

- Event-Driven architecture

- Salesforce Marketing Cloud (nice to have)

- Javascript & Python

- ITIL (JIRA/ServiceNow)

If you’re naturally a helper, enjoy assisting people with issues, organized and able to explain technical details simply, we’d like to meet you.

Ultimately, you will be a person our internal customer's trust. They will rely on you to provide timely and accurate solutions to their technical problems.

Key Responsibilities

- Take full responsibility for the assigned tickets (analysis, development, unit test, deployment, and documentation) in the issue tracker.

- Evaluate system issues and proactively suggest enhancements to enrich the solution.

- Assist the Tech Lead to estimate and challenge the development effort.

- Refer to internal database or external resources to provide accurate tech solutions. Enrich the internal database with newly identified issues.

- Work closely with cross-functional teams (PEGA Developers, Front End Developers, Scrum Masters, Tech lead, QA…) aiming to improve operations and provide recommendations for change.

- Attend Agile (Scrum) ceremonies i.e. daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Refinement, Sprint Reviews and Retrospectives and maintain status of activities up to date in Jira and/or ServiceNow.

- Contribute to and enforce best practices in the developed Product.

- Develop a customer-oriented mindset and a culture of trust and transparency.

Requirements

- Proven work experience as a PEGA Systems Architect or similar role.

- Excellent problem-solving, communication skills and high attention to detail.

- Hands-on experience with PEGA, Postman, Confluence, JIRA, API and event-driven architectures.

- Keen to learn other technologies, namely SAP, Salesforce.

- Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot complex technical issues.

- Excellent in English both written and spoken; other languages are a plus.

- Knowledge of Agile methodologies and its ceremonies (Scrum, Kanban).

- 3-5 Years as a PEGA CSSA or CSA role with proven project experience.

- B.Sc. or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

Other Desired Skills

- Salesforce Marketing cloud, Python, Javascript, SAP ERP.

- Monitoring: Datadog.

- Collaboration tools: Jira, Confluence, Miro.

- API: OpenAPI, REST, Postman, Insomnia.

- Web technologies: HTTP, OAUTH2, WebComponents.

At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The Job:

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Pega Software Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Pega development and will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining Pega applications. This role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet business requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

- Design and develop Pega applications using Pega PRPC (PegaRULES Process Commander) platform.

- Collaborate with business analysts, project managers, and other developers to understand requirements and translate them into technical designs.

- Create and maintain technical documentation including design specifications, test plans, and deployment guides.

- Perform unit testing and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the quality of the delivered solutions.

- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in Pega applications.

- Participate in code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards.

- Optimize application performance and ensure scalability and reliability.

- Stay updated with the latest Pega technologies and industry trends to continuously improve skills and knowledge.

Here's What You Need:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- Minimum of 3 years of experience in Pega development.

- Pega Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA) certification is preferred.

- Strong understanding of Pega PRPC architecture, components, and features.

- Proficiency in Pega Rules, Flows, Activities, Reports, and User Interfaces.

- Experience with integration technologies such as SOAP, REST, JMS, and MQ.

- Knowledge of relational databases and SQL.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Would Be Nice:

- Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

- Knowledge of Java, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

- Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools such as Jenkins, Git, and Docker.

- Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

The base pay range for this position in these locations is shown below. Accenture Federal Services offers a wide variety of benefits. You can find more information on benefits here. We accept applications on an on-going basis and there is no fixed deadline to apply.

The pay range for the states of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia, and the city of Cleveland is:

$73,600—$170,100 USD

We have an unwavering commitment to creating a culture in which all our people are respected, feel a sense of belonging, and have equal opportunity. As a business imperative, every person at Accenture Federal Services has the responsibility to create and sustain a culture where everyone feels welcomed and included. This is grounded in our core values and our experience that hiring and developing great people who reflect different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds is key to driving innovation and delivering the results that our clients and the country count on.

Requesting An Accommodation

HCLTech is a global technology company, home to more than 227,000 people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around AI, digital, engineering, cloud and software, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology & Services, Semiconductor, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, Mobility and Public Services. Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending March 2026 totaled $14.7B

Overview of the Role:

As a Medior Pega Developer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing robust Pega-based solutions that underpin HCLTech’s mission to deliver transformative technology services. Your expertise will contribute directly to client projects within banking and insurance sectors, ensuring scalable, innovative, and efficient applications that drive business value. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact projects, collaborate with dynamic teams, and influence technology strategy within a fast-paced, global environment.

- Work mode: Hybrid, once in a week WFO

- Location: Warsaw or Krakow

- Working hours: normal, 9:00 to 17:00 CET

- Contract type: Employment

Detailed Responsibilities:

- Architect and develop Pega-based applications, leveraging enterprise-class design principles and the latest Pega architecture.

- Implement case management, flow design, data modeling, and rule resolution to ensure optimal application performance and maintainability.

- Configure and analyze data pages, perform log analysis, and optimize background processing using job schedulers and queue processors.

- Lead integration initiatives, ensuring seamless connectivity between Pega applications and external systems.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions aligned with Agile and DevOps methodologies.

- Participate in CICD (Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment) processes to streamline development and deployment cycles.

- Provide technical guidance and troubleshoot issues across server, database, and node classifications.

- Engage in client-facing activities, especially within banking and insurance domains, to understand requirements and deliver tailored solutions.

Skill Requirements:

- PEGA CSSA (Certified Senior System Architect) certification is mandatory.

- Minimum of 4 years’ hands-on experience with Pega platform.

- Deep understanding of latest Pega architecture, including Enterprise-class design, Application layer cake, Data Modelling, and Rule resolution.

- Extensive experience with case management, flow design, data pages, and log analysis.

- Strong background in background processing (job schedulers, queue processors).

- Proven expertise in system integration and interfacing with external applications.

- Practical experience with CICD pipelines and tools.

- Familiarity with Agile and DevOps methodologies.

Nice to have:

- Experience working on banking or insurance projects is highly preferred.

- In-depth understanding of server, database, and node classification would be advantageous.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Excellent communication and teamwork capabilities.

What we offer:

- Life insurance

- Private medical care

- MultiSport Card

- Subsidies for glasses

- Subsidies for language courses

- Christmas and holiday bonuses

Citi is looking for a Lead Applications Developer to take senior ownership of complex application development initiatives within a global technology team. In this role, you will design and deliver high-impact software solutions integrating Pega development and AI capabilities while setting technical standards and mentoring the next generation of engineers. - Build scalable, high-quality software using Pega development frameworks and AI-driven techniques to address complex business challenges.

- Partner with senior stakeholders across technology and business functions to define system enhancements that enable new products and process improvements.

- Lead in-depth analysis of business processes and system workflows to identify root causes and engineer innovative, lasting solutions.

- Develop a deep understanding of how architecture, infrastructure, and application layers interconnect to deliver integrated technology outcomes.

- Coach and guide mid-level developers and analysts, distributing work effectively to maintain delivery quality and team growth.

- 6 to 10 years of hands-on experience in application development or systems analysis, with a track record of delivering complex software projects.

- Deep expertise in systems analysis and software application programming, spanning full development lifecycle activities.

- Subject matter expertise in Pega with the ability to lead technical direction.

- Demonstrated ability to lead projects from initiation through to successful delivery, managing priorities and adapting quickly as requirements evolve.

At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The work

The Pega Senior System Architect (SSA) is responsible for designing, building, and configuring Pega applications that meet complex business process and application requirements. In this role, you will leverage deep Pega Platform expertise to streamline business processes, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver high‑quality technical solutions. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration, deployment, and continuous improvement of Pega applications. A strong background in Pega development—supported by required Pega certification—and familiarity with DevOps tools and practices will be key to success. Your ability to interpret business needs, transform them into scalable technical designs, and support the full development lifecycle will play a critical role in driving project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and configure Pega Platform applications to meet business and technical requirements

- Translate business requirements into functional and technical solution designs

- Develop application components including data models, process flows, case structures, integrations, UI, and business rules

- Apply Pega SSA best practices and guardrails in all development activities

- Collaborate with DevOps teams to support code integration, deployment, and environment readiness

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the application lifecycle

- Ensure solutions are performant, scalable, secure, and maintainable

- Provide knowledge transfer, mentoring, and technical guidance to junior team members

- Maintain clear, well‑structured, and supportable technical documentation

Here’s What You Need

- Pega Certification Required — aligned with internal certification guidance (e.g., Pega Certified Senior System Architect – CSSA)

- Hands-on experience building Pega applications including rules, case types, integrations, and UI

- Experience designing solutions that meet business process and technical requirements

- Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools supporting CI/CD pipelines

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

- Ability to interface effectively with both technical and business partners

Nice to have

- Experience supporting large-scale enterprise implementations

- Exposure to cloud-based Pega deployments or containerized environments

- Knowledge of complementary technologies (APIs, databases, authentication methods)

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field

Eligibility Requirements

- Candidates must be a U.S. Citizen

- Eligibility to obtain a government Public Trust Clearance

As required by local law, Accenture Federal Services provides reasonable ranges of compensation for hired roles based on labor costs in the states of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia, and the city of Cleveland. The base pay range for this position in these locations is shown below. Compensation for roles at Accenture Federal Services varies depending on a wide array of factors, including but not limited to office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. Accenture Federal Services offers a wide variety of benefits. You can find more information on benefits here. We accept applications on an on-going basis and there is no fixed deadline to apply.

The pay range for the states of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, and the District of Columbia, and the city of Cleveland is:

$78,600—$160,200 USD

What We Believe

As a company wholly dedicated to serving the US federal government, we bring together the best talent to help reinvent how federal agencies operate and deliver greater value for their mission and the American people. We have an unwavering commitment to creating a culture in which all our people are respected, feel a sense of belonging, and have equal opportunity. As a business imperative, every person at Accenture Federal Services has the responsibility to create and sustain a culture where everyone feels welcomed and included. This is grounded in our core values and our experience that hiring and developing great people who reflect different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds is key to driving innovation and delivering the results that our clients and the country count on.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities. For details, view a copy of the Accenture Federal Services Equal Opportunity Policy Statement.

Accenture Federal Services is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Additionally, as an Affirmative Action Employer for Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities, Accenture Federal Services is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women.

Requesting An Accommodation

Accenture Federal Services is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for persons with disabilities or religious observances, including reasonable accommodation when needed. If you are hired by Accenture Federal Services and require accommodation to perform the essential functions of your role, you will be asked to participate in our reasonable accommodation process. Accommodations made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodations once hired.

If you are being considered for employment opportunities with Accenture Federal Services and need an accommodation for a disability or religious observance during the interview process or for the job you are interviewing for, please speak with your recruiter.

R232106

Job Profile

Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Software Engineer Sr - Pega Developer within PNC's Treasury Management Service & Implementations Technology organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA; Dallas, TX.

The Software Engineer Senior will join a highly visible team within Corporate & Institutional Banking that is transforming how large commercial clients establish and manage banking relationships. And develop enterprise-scale automation solutions that streamline complex account onboarding, compliance validation, customer due diligence, and servicing processes for large corporations operating across multiple locations.

This role combines deep Pega Platform expertise with strong technical design capabilities, solution architecture experience, and a passion for building scalable business process automation solutions in a fast-paced Agile environment.

PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.

PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

Core Responsibilities

- Lead the technical design, architecture, and development of complex enterprise applications using the Pega Platform to automate banking onboarding, compliance, and servicing workflows.

- Translate business requirements into scalable Pega solutions that support customer validation, due diligence, compliance verification, and operational process automation.

- Design and develop sophisticated Case Management, Business Process Management (BPM), workflows, stages, case types, business rules, and decisioning capabilities.

- Build and maintain applications utilizing Pega Constellation and modern Pega Infinity 24+ capabilities to deliver intuitive and responsive user experiences.

- Develop and configure Data Pages, Data Transforms, Decision Tables, Activities, Report Definitions, and reusable application components.

- Design and implement integrations using REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, JSON, XML, DX APIs, messaging frameworks, and external systems.

- Partner with architects, project managers, business analysts, QA teams, and stakeholders to ensure successful solution delivery.

- Apply Pega Guardrails, platform best practices, and enterprise development standards to ensure maintainable and scalable applications.

- Develop responsive user interfaces utilizing Pega UI/SAIL, views, sections, harnesses, portals, and Constellation-based experiences.

- Perform application performance tuning, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and production issue resolution.

- Manage deployments across development, QA, UAT, and production environments utilizing Git, Jenkins, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

- Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, sprint planning, estimation sessions, and architecture reviews.

- Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to junior and mid-level developers.

- Contribute to modernization initiatives leveraging Generative AI and AI-driven capabilities within the Pega ecosystem.

- Support critical production incidents and release activities, including occasional off-hours support. Production incidents and weekend release events are infrequent, generally occurring fewer than six times annually.

Preferred Skills & Experience

- 5+ years of overall software development experience in enterprise application development environments.

- 3-4+ years of hands-on development experience using the Pega Platform to build workflow-driven business applications.

- Strong expertise in Pega 7.x, Pega 8.x, and modern Pega Infinity 24+ environments for enterprise application development.

- Experience designing solutions with Pega Constellation to create modern, responsive user experiences.

- Strong knowledge of Case Management for managing end-to-end business processes and customer onboarding workflows.

- Expertise in Business Process Management (BPM) and workflow automation for complex operational processes.

- Hands-on experience developing Pega Rules, Process Models, Data Pages, Data Transforms, Decision Tables, Activities, and Report Definitions to implement business logic and decisioning.

- Experience configuring Security, Access Groups, and application architecture components within the Pega Platform.

- Hands-on experience building user interfaces with Pega UI/SAIL, views, sections, harnesses, and portals.

- Strong experience developing integrations using REST APIs and SOAP Web Services to connect enterprise systems.

- Experience working with JSON, XML, external APIs, and third-party system integrations.

- Experience utilizing DX APIs to support modern user interface and integration strategies.

- Strong knowledge of SQL for querying, reporting, performance optimization, and database troubleshooting.

- Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL.

- Working knowledge of Java/J2EE for extending platform functionality and supporting custom implementations.

- Understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for front-end customization and user interface enhancements.

- Experience with application performance tuning, debugging, monitoring, and issue resolution.

- Experience utilizing Git, Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices for automated builds and deployments.

- Experience creating technical designs, application architecture documentation, and solution blueprints.

- Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies with experience participating in sprint ceremonies and iterative delivery.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

- Basic understanding of banking operations, customer onboarding, compliance processes, and financial services workflows.

- Experience implementing Generative AI solutions or AI-powered capabilities within enterprise applications.

- Experience with Pega Customer Service, Customer Decision Hub (CDH), Decisioning, or other Pega industry frameworks.

- Experience with cloud-based Pega deployments and automated deployment strategies.

- Experience designing solutions using event-driven architecture, messaging platforms, or microservices.

- Experience supporting large-scale enterprise platforms serving high-volume business users and transactions.

- One or more Professional Pega certifications, including: Certified Pega Lead System Architect (CLSA), Certified Pega Senior System Architect (CSSA), Certified Pega System Architect (CSA), Certified Pega Decisioning Consultant (CPDC)

- Prior experience within Banking, Financial Services, Corporate Banking, or Institutional Banking environments.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

- Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

- Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills

Application Development, Business Management, Customer Solutions, Design, Group Problem Solving, Pega Architecture, Pega BPM, Pega Software Application Development, Process Improvements, Release Management, Software Solutions, User Experience (UX) Design

Competencies

Application Delivery Process, Application Design, Architecture, Application Development Tools, Application Testing, Packaged Application Integration, System Development Life Cycle, Technical Troubleshooting, Technical Writing/Documentation

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

Licenses

No Required License(s)

Language Assessments

Benefits

No Required or Preferred Language Assessments

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.

In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit pncthrive.com.

Disability Accommodations Statement

If an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at AccommodationRequest@pnc.com. Please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job ID, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877-968-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law.

This position is subject to the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA) and, for any registered role, the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act) and/or the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), which prohibit the hiring of individuals with certain criminal history.

California Residents

Refer to the California Consumer Privacy Act Privacy Notice to gain understanding of how PNC may use or disclose your personal information in our hiring practices.

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States. Preference will be given to those located in North Carolina, Florida, Texas and Arizona.

We are seeking a highly hands-on Pega AI and Customer Decision Hub (CDH) Architect. The individual will have deep, hands-on experience implementing Pega AI capabilities and Pega CDH. The role is approximately 50% Pega AI and 50% CDH. This individual will personally design, configure, develop, integrate, troubleshoot, and implement Pega AI and Customer Decisioning solutions. The individual will be capable of independently driving technical implementation activities with minimal supervision.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities:

- Design, configure, and implement Pega AI capabilities.

- Implement Pega Knowledge Buddy solutions.

- Implement Pega Voice AI capabilities.

- Design and implement AI-powered workflows and AI orchestration.

- Configure and integrate LLMs and external AI services with Pega.

- Implement Pega AI components and AI-powered business solutions.

- Configure and optimize Next-Best-Action strategies.

- Build customer decisioning strategies and engagement policies.

- Configure adaptive models and predictive models.

The SSA will collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, maintainable, and high-performance Pega applications.

- 6 years of dedicated experience in Pega PRPC system administration.

- Pega Certified Senior System Architect is the MUST. (PCSSA)

- Hands-on knowledge of application servers (Tomcat, WebSphere, WebLogic) and container platforms (OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS).

- Proficiency in RDBMS (Oracle, PostgreSQL, DB2, MSSQL) and Linux/Windows administration

- Configure, and maintain Pega nodes, clusters, and application lifecycles (DEV, QA, UAT, PROD).

- Plan and execute Pega platform version upgrades, hotfixes, and dependency updates.

- Package application rules (RAP/Product Rules) and manage deployments using pipelines like Pega Deployment Manager or Jenkins.

- Monitor system health using tools like Pega Diagnostic Cloud (PDC), Splunk, and Grafana; optimize JVM heap, thread pools, and queue processors.

- Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for node failures, Kafka/stream issues, search indexing problems, and database bottlenecks.

Solution Design & Architecture

- Design and implement end-to-end Pega solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

- Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.

- Define application layer structure, class hierarchy, case types, data models, and integration patterns.

- Ensure adherence to Pega Guardrails and best practices.

- Conduct design and code reviews to ensure quality and performance.

Development & Implementation

- Develop complex case workflows, UI rules, data pages, decision rules, and integrations.

- Implement REST/SOAP integrations, connectors, and services.

- Configure and optimize decisioning, routing, SLAs, and business rules.

- Implement security, access control, and authentication mechanisms.

- Support DevOps practices including CI/CD and deployment automation.

Performance & Optimization

- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.

- Optimize database queries, reports, and background processing.

- Ensure application scalability and high availability.

Collaboration & Leadership

- Provide technical leadership to Pega developers and System Architects.

- Mentor junior team members and review deliverables.

- Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and backlog refinement.

- Work closely with Business Architects and stakeholders for requirement clarification.

- Support UAT and production deployment activities.

Governance & Compliance

- Ensure compliance with organizational standards and regulatory requirements.

- Maintain documentation for architecture, integrations, and deployment processes.

- Conduct guardrail compliance reviews and quality assurance checks.

________________________________________

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.

- 5–8+ years of IT experience with Pega application development and minimum 3 years of hands-on Pega development experience with constellation.

________________________________________

Preferred Qualifications

- Pega Senior System Architect (CSSA/SSA) certification – Mandatory

- Pega Lead System Architect (CLSA) – Preferred

- Experience with:

- Pega Customer Service / Sales Automation / Smart Dispute (if applicable)

- Cloud deployments (AWS/Azure/GCP)

- DevOps tools (Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, etc.)

- Database systems (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL)

- Microservices architecture

- Experience in large-scale enterprise implementations.

Strong experience with:

- Pega PRPC / Pega Platform (v7.x / v8.x or above)

- Case Management and BPM concepts

- Data modelling and class structure design

- Integration services (REST, SOAP, JMS, Kafka, etc.)

- Pega Decisioning and business rules

- UI/UX configuration using Pega UI frameworks

- Strong understanding of Pega guardrails and performance tuning.

- Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Activities and utility functions

- Decision tables, decision trees, and declarative rules

- Report definitions and performance optimization

- Authentication (OAuth, SSO, LDAP)

We are

At Synechron, we believe in the power of digital to transform businesses for the better. Over the last 20+ years, our company has been honored with multiple employer awards, recognizing our commitment to our talented teams. With top clients to boast about, Synechron has a global workforce of 16,700+, and has 57 offices in 22 countries within key global markets.

Position Overview

- We are seeking an experienced Pega Developer with strong expertise in Pega Constellation architecture and application development. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and implementing scalable Pega applications using modern UI and low-code development practices.

- The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience delivering enterprise-grade solutions using Pega Platform, Constellation UI, Case Management, App Studio, and Pega Infinity.

Additional Information

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within Charlotte, NC is $120K - $130K/year & benefits (see below)

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, configure, and implement Pega applications using Pega Constellation.

- Build modern, responsive user experiences using Constellation UI components and design patterns.

- Develop and configure case types, workflows, stages, processes, data objects, views, and business rules.

- Use Pega App Studio and Pega Dev Studio to deliver business applications.

- Translate business and technical requirements into scalable Pega solutions.

- Configure case lifecycle management, approvals, SLAs, notifications, correspondence, and service-level workflows.

- Develop integrations with external systems using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, APIs, connectors, and data pages.

- Design and configure data models, data objects, data views, and reusable application components.

- Support CI/CD, version control, release management, and deployment across environments.

- Prepare technical documentation, solution designs, development standards, and implementation guides.

- Stay current with Pega Constellation product capabilities, roadmap updates, and emerging best practices.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

- 10+ years of experience in Pega development, preferably on Pega Infinity or Pega Platform.

- Strong hands-on experience with Pega Constellation and modern Pega application development.

- Experience with Pega App Studio and Dev Studio.

- Strong knowledge of:Case Management

- Workflow and process design

- Data modeling and data objects

- Views, forms, layouts, and UI configuration

- Business rules and decision logic

- Data pages and integration patterns

- Security, roles, access groups, and authorization

- SLAs, notifications, correspondence, and approvals

- Experience developing integrations using REST and SOAP web services.

- Proficiency in Pega debugging, tracing, performance analysis, and error handling.

- Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Pega Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA) or higher.

- Pega Constellation certification or relevant Constellation implementation experience.

- Experience migrating or modernizing applications from Theme Cosmos or traditional Pega UI to Constellation.

- Experience with Pega DX API, React-based front-end integration, or headless application patterns.

- Knowledge of Pega Customer Service, Pega Platform, Pega Financial Services, Pega Healthcare, or other industry frameworks.

- Experience with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

- Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Pega Cloud.

- Experience with automated testing and PegaUnit testing.

- Understanding of accessibility, responsive design, and user-centered application design.

Key Skills

- Pega Constellation

- Pega Platform / Pega Infinity

- Pega App Studio

- Pega Dev Studio

- Case Management

- Workflow Automation

- UI and View Configuration

- Data Pages and Data Modeling

- REST and SOAP Integrations

- Pega DX API

- Decisioning and Business Rules

- Agile/Scrum

- CI/CD and DevOps

- Application Performance and Troubleshooting

We offer:

- A highly competitive compensation and benefits package.

- A multinational organization with 60 offices in 20 countries and the possibility to work abroad.

- 10 days of paid annual leave (plus sick leave and national holidays).

- Maternity & paternity leave plans.

- A comprehensive insurance plan including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and long-/short-term disability (plans vary by region).

- Retirement savings plans.

- A higher education certification policy.

- Commuter benefits (varies by region).

- Extensive training opportunities, focused on skills, substantive knowledge, and personal development.

- On-demand Udemy for Business for all Synechron employees with free access to more than 5000 curated courses.

- Coaching opportunities with experienced colleagues from our Financial Innovation Labs (FinLabs) and Center of Excellences (CoE) groups.

- Cutting edge projects at the world’s leading tier-one banks, financial institutions and insurance firms.

- A flat and approachable organization.

- A truly diverse, fun-loving, and global work culture.

SYNECHRON’S DIVERSITY & INCLUSION STATEMENT

Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.

All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Strong business acumen along with strong communication skills (both oral and written) is an absolute must. Certified Lead System Architects are expected to think independently, but also must value teamwork as they define first-rate software solutions in a collaborative setting.

Specific responsibilities of the new Pega Lead System Architect will be:

- Lead and drive the architectural design and integration strategy for a Pega application implementation, in alignment with transformational initiatives.

- Formulate the overall data strategy for the business solution, based on the client’s business needs and enterprise strategy.

- Provide architectural guidance and act as the subject matter expert for integration strategy.

Title : Technology Lead - Pega

Location : Atlanta, GA

Mode : Full Time

In the role of Technology Lead, you will interface with key stakeholders and apply your technical proficiency across different stages of the Software Development Life Cycle including Requirements Elicitation, Application Architecture definition and Design. You will play an important role in creating the high level design artifacts. You will also deliver high quality code deliverables for a module, lead validation for all types of testing and support activities related to implementation, transition and warranty. You will be part of a learning culture, where teamwork and collaboration are encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is respected and valued.

Key areas of responsibility include:

- Development: Participate as needed in the development and implementation of PEGA software based on approved design. Write new programs or create modifications to existing applications as necessary based on product specifications. Follow established standards for the design, coding, and testing of software. Also has responsibility for developing and implementing internal projects and toolsets for consumption by other team members that improve team productivity and quality. Has experience of Pega upgrades.

- Testing: Work with users to validate system testing and conformity with functional requirements.

- Implementation: Follow appropriate change management and implementation procedures. Ensure that appropriate technical and functional documentation is prepared. Co-ordinate the implementation process.

- Support: Provide support to new or upgraded applications during and after implementation.

Location for this position is Atlanta, GA, US

This role needs travel as per project needs.

Qualifications

Basic

- Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.

- At least 10 years of experience in the job description below

- Should have work as PEGA Implementation Lead for US Customers with Onsite- Offshore Model. Should be aware of the LEAN principles and able to lead all customer BPO/Customer Interfacing

Mandatory Skills

- Pega Infinity Application Design and Development with CSSA/LSA certification by PEGA

- Should have Application Architecture and Design Experience and should be able to convert business requirements into design.

- Should have expertise in DCO tools like Application Profiler, Enterprise Application Accelerator.

- Should have experience in development, support projects and to setting up PRPC environments.

- Should have good Knowledge in formulating design of class Structure.

- Should have good knowledge on Data Modelling, UI rules, Validation, Declarative and Decision, Correspondence rules, PRPC flows, interpretation of flow shapes.

- Should have Strong verbal and written communication skills.

- Should have both PEGA Scrum(Agile) and smart BPM experience .

- Should have Experience on Design Review, Code Review using PRPC best practices and PEGA Guardrails.

- Should be familiar and be able to do estimations for enhancements/projects.

- Should have knowledge in Performance tools (PAL,AES,PLA) and Deployment Process using PEGA Tools .

- Should have Knowledge on Agents and File Listeners.

- Knowledge on AccessGroup, ClassGroup, Access Roles, Privileges.

Who We Are

Infosys BPM Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Infosys Limited (NYSE: INFY), provides end-to-end transformative business process management (BPM) services for its clients across the globe. The company’s integrated IT and BPM solutions approach enables it to unlock business value across industries and service lines, and address business challenges for its clients. Utilizing innovative business excellence frameworks, ongoing productivity improvements, process reengineering, automation, and cutting-edge technology platforms, Infosys BPM enables its clients to achieve their cost reduction objectives, improve process efficiencies, enhance effectiveness, and deliver superior customer experience.

Infosys BPM has 42 delivery centers in 14 countries spread across 5 continents, with 60,530 employees from 105 nationalities, as of March, 2026.

The company has been consistently ranked among the leading BPM companies globally and has received over 60 awards and recognitions in the last 5 years, from key industry bodies and associations like the Outsourcing Center, SSON, and GSA, among others. Infosys BPM also has very robust people practices, as substantiated by the various HR-specific awards it has won over the years. The company has consistently been ranked among the top employers of choice, on the basis of its industry leading HR best practices. The company’s senior leaders contribute widely to industry forums as BPM strategists.

EOE/Minority/Female/Veteran/Disabled/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin

Infosys is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of protected veteran, or disability.

Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. In this role, you will build marketing messaging based on defined business requirements using Pega Customer Decision Hub (CDH). You will interact with teams across Product, Marketing, Technology, and our delivery channels to coordinate the successful deployment of new marketing creatives.

Responsibilities Include

- Interpreting business requirements to develop business rule logic within Pega to create targeted marketing campaigns

- Provide consultation with business partners across Product and Marketing

- Perform quality control checks on developed logic

- Coordinate across business and technology teams

- Manage multiple projects and meet target deadlines

- Assisting lower level analysts

Experience with customer decisioning software such as Pega Customer Decision Hub (CDH)

Pega Decisioning Consultant certification

HTML coding proficiency

SQL knowledge

Understanding of a Test/QA/Production environment structure

Interest in Marketing Technology

Strong communication and problem solving skills

PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.

PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

- Supports coordinated planning, execution, and oversight across defined functional areas to enable marketing objectives. Functional scope may include strategy, planning, and change enablement; governance, risk, and control management; and channel activation. Applies established processes and guidance to enable efficient and compliant marketing operations.

- Contributes to marketing enablement by identifying bottlenecks within marketing workflows and evaluating opportunities to improve processes, tools, and ways of working. Partners across Marketing to assess and improve existing processes and workflows to optimize efficiency, reduce processing time, and support effective execution. Assists in evaluating existing processes using data analysis, metrics, and process modeling to design streamlined workflows that integrate seamlessly into day‑to‑day execution. Applies foundational enablement and operational expertise and a continuous improvement mindset to strengthen planning, program delivery, and adoption of improved ways of working across the organization.

- Executes marketing workflows, governance routines, and tools in alignment with business requirements, quality standards, PNC’s risk appetite, governance expectations, and enterprise risk management framework. Participates in the resolution of operational issues, risk considerations, and cross‑functional coordination, applying established processes and exercising judgment in escalating matters to promote consistent application of controls and accountability. Supports planning, coordinating, and scheduling marketing enablement activities across Marketing teams.

- Executes and delivers marketing initiatives across assigned functional areas with a focus on quality, consistency, efficiency, and risk management. Independently executes and delivers marketing campaigns and activation activities across multiple channels, including 1:1, physical and sales channels, by applying operational discipline, clear standards, and scalable processes to drive consistent, high‑quality outcomes. Supports a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence to ensure successful execution and delivery of marketing efforts across the full range of activation channels.

- Applies foundational marketing enablement expertise to support coordination, decision support, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborates with marketing teams to effectively leverage processes, governance routines, platforms, and tools in support of business outcomes. Demonstrates accountability, collaboration, and learning that enables high‑quality, consistent marketing delivery across strategy, governance, and activation activities.

- Supports Business Owners in managing marketing technology platforms and contributes to coordination with Product Owners and Technology partners.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

- Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

- Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Competencies

Business Process Improvement, Collaborating, Decision Making and Critical Thinking, Effective Communications, Innovation, Marketing Function, Marketing Systems, Organizational Change Management, Problem Solving

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 2+ years of relevant professional experience. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

Licenses

No Required License(s)

Language Assessments

No Required Or Preferred Language Assessments

Pay Transparency

Base Salary: $63,750.00 – $116,875.00

Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education.

Application Window

Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 07/30/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.

In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit pncthrive.com.

Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877-968-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law.

California Residents

jobs.description_text:
About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on PEGA Lead System Architect (LSA) to lead the design, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-grade Pega solutions. In this role, you will drive the development of scalable, secure, and high-performing applications while ensuring adherence to Pega best practices and architectural standards. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing and implementing complex Pega applications, including expertise with the Pega Smart Claims Engine (SCE). A strong background in healthcare, enterprise integrations, data modeling, and regulatory compliance is essential. Knowledge of healthcare standards and transactions, including HIPAA, EDI, 835, and 837, is required to support efficient and compliant claims processing solutions.

In This Role, You Will

- Lead the design, development, configuration, testing, and optimization of Pega applications, applying Pega best practices, design patterns, coding standards, and performance tuning techniques.

- Architect and implement scalable Pega class structures, case types, workflows, user interfaces, integrations, and reusable components to support enterprise healthcare solutions.

- Utilize healthcare domain expertise to deliver solutions aligned with healthcare operations and claims processing requirements.

- Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex application issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing effective technical solutions.

- Collaborate within Agile/SAFe teams, participating in sprint ceremonies, technical reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives while partnering with distributed and cross-functional teams.

- Build strong relationships with business and technical stakeholders, effectively communicating technical concepts and driving successful solution delivery.

Work Model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants working within the Eastern Time Zone. Regardless of your work arrangement, we support a healthy work-life balance through a variety of wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the posting date and may change based on project, client, or business needs. We will communicate any changes to role expectations as they occur.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

- Pega Lead System Architect (LSA) certification with proven experience providing technical leadership across large-scale Pega implementations.

- Experience designing, developing, testing, and deploying secure, scalable, and high-performance Pega applications, including class structures, case management workflows, UI models, and reusable frameworks.

- Strong expertise integrating Pega applications with enterprise platforms using REST APIs, microservices, and other modern integration technologies.

- Demonstrated ability to conduct technical reviews, monitor application quality and performance, mitigate technical risks, and ensure compliance with Pega guardrails and development standards.

- Experience working in Agile/SAFe environments with strong stakeholder engagement and healthcare claims processing knowledge.

These Will Help You Stand Out

- Pega Lead System Architect (LSA) Certification

- Pega Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA) Certification

- Pega Certified System Architect (CSA) Certification

- Experience with Pega Smart Claims Engine (SCE)

- Experience in healthcare payer environments and Facets-based implementations

We're excited to meet professionals who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every listed qualification. Transferable experience, diverse perspectives, and unique skills are highly valued.

Applications are being accepted through 10/15/2026.

The salary range for this role is $120,000 - $140,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications. This position is also eligible for Cognizant's discretionary annual incentive program, subject to performance and applicable plan terms.

Benefits

(Subject to eligibility requirements)

- Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

- Paid Holidays and Paid Time Off

- 401(k) Plan with Company Contributions

- Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage

- Paid Parental Leave

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer: Compensation and benefits information is current as of the posting date. Cognizant reserves the right to modify compensation and benefits programs at any time in accordance with applicable laws.

UNITED STATES CITIZEN

REQUIRES TOP SECRET CLEARANCE

100% ONSITE (5 DAYS A WEEK) - WASHINGTON, DC AREA

Salary range is 135-170k/yr. but IS DEPENDENT UPON THE CANDIDATE’S SKILLS, EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

NO THIRD PARTY VENDORS

Soft Tech Consulting is seeking a skilled Pega Developer to design, develop, and deploy Pega applications. This role requires working on-site at the client's location every day and collaborating with stakeholders to meet business requirements. The designated candidate for this position will join a collaborative team environment, providing support and expertise necessary toward the successful delivery of the project deliverables, and provide effective communication to all levels of staff for reporting status/progress.

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and deploy Pega applications.

- Develop and implement Pega applications.

- Customize and configure Pega solutions.

- Integrate Pega with other systems.

- Troubleshoot and resolve application issues.

- Ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field; or 7+ years of relavent experience in place of a degree

- Proven experience with Pega PRPC.

- Strong problem-solving skills.

- Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

- Pega certification (CSA, CSSA, or CLSA) preferred.

- Experience with Pega Architecture (Intermediate)

- Experience with Pega Software Application Development (Intermediate)

- Experience with Pega Platform (Intermediate)

- Must be able to work independently, with little to no oversight.

- Must be able to develop and maintain strong client relationships.

About Us

Soft Tech Consulting, Inc. is a woman and minority-owned small business headquartered in Chantilly, VA. With contracts in both the public and private sectors in the DC metro area and across the country, Soft Tech is an organization made up of highly successful and talented Information Technology professionals offering enterprise class solutions for any size organization at great value. Soft Tech’s mission is to help government organizations design, implement, and maintain mission critical Information Technology solutions. By focusing jointly on our employees and our customers, we are able to achieve our mission by providing each and every one of our customers with continuous quality customer support.

At Genworth, we empower families to navigate the aging journey with confidence. We are compassionate, experienced allies for those navigating care with guidance, products, and services that meet families where they are. Further, we are the spouses, children, siblings, friends, and neighbors of those that need care—and we bring those experiences with us to work in serving our millions of policyholders each day.

We apply that same compassion and empathy as we work with each other and our local communities. Genworth values all perspectives, characteristics, and experiences so that employees can bring their full, authentic selves to work to help each other and our company succeed. We celebrate our diversity and understand that being intentional about inclusion is the only way to create a sense of belonging for all associates. We also invest in the vitality of our local communities through grants from the Genworth Foundation, event sponsorships, and employee volunteerism.

Our four values guide our strategy, our decisions, and our interactions:

- Make it human. We care about the people that make up our customers, colleagues, and communities.

- Make it about others. We do what's best for our customers and collaborate to drive progress.

- Make it happen. We work with intention toward a common purpose and forge ways forward together.

- Make it better. We create fulfilling purpose-driven careers by learning from the world and each other.

Position Title

Lead Solution Architect, Pega

- This role is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship *

Position Location

This position is available to Virginia residents as Richmond and Lynchburg, Virginia hybrid/in-office applicants (preferred locations)

This position is available to remote applicants residing in states/locations under Eastern or Central Standard Time: Alabama, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Vermont, Virginia, Washington DC, West Virginia or Wisconsin

Your Role

The Lead Solution Architect, Pega is a hands-on, outcomes‑oriented leader who partners with business and technology stakeholders to design, validate, and deliver end‑to‑end solutions centered on the PEGA platform. You will own discovery for high‑impact initiatives across claims, servicing, and operations—translating strategy into executable workflows, case lifecycles, and decisioning while ensuring scalability, compliance, and an excellent associate and customer experience. The Solutions Architect is responsible for designing and delivering technology solutions that align with Genworth’s business objectives and enterprise architecture standards. This role bridges business requirements and technical implementation, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant.

What You Will Be Doing

- Translate business requirements into technical designs for applications, data, and infrastructure.

- Ensure solutions comply with Genworth’s Architecture Design Framework (ADF) and EA principles.

- Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Principal Architects, and development teams to maintain consistency and reuse patterns.

- Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) processes and prepare solution review documentation.

- Provide technical leadership during solution implementation and integration

- Lead business architecture for complex programs: process modeling, case/lifecycle design, persona & channel strategy, and data/interface mapping in Pega.

- Facilitate requirements discovery (journey mapping, use cases, BRDs, epics/stories) and align them to Pega capabilities, frameworks, and guardrails.

- Define solution scope, MVPs, and incremental releases; balance business outcomes, operational risk, compliance, and technical constraints.

- Partner with Product Owners, UX, and Pega SSAs/CSAs to translate business rules into decision strategies, DCO assets, and testable acceptance criteria.

- Establish functional designs, mockups, prototypes, and test plans; lead SIT/UAT to validate value realization and readiness for production.

- Coach agile teams and stakeholders on Pega methodology and best practices; mentor other BSAs and evangelize continuous improvement.

- Contribute to platform governance: backlog triage, reuse standards, data quality, and compliance documentation; support audits where needed

- Support business cases and roadmaps with measurable KPIs (cycle time, STP rate, NIGO reduction, CSAT, operational cost)

What You Bring

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

- 7+ years in business analysis/architecture with 4+ years focused on Pega programs.

- Pega Certified Business Architect (PCBA/CPBA) required; CSSA/CSBA preferred

- Demonstrated delivery across full lifecycle: discovery → design → build support → testing → go‑live → adoption

- Expertise in case management, workflow orchestration, rules/decisioning, integrations, and data modeling in Pega

- Strong facilitation and communication skills with senior stakeholders; ability to drive consensus and decisions rapidly

- Strong knowledge of application architecture, integration patterns, and technology stacks.

- Ability to understand business processes and translate them into technical solutions.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Problem-solving and analytical capabilities for complex technical challenges.

Nice to have

- Experience in insurance, financial services, or healthcare operations (claims, policy servicing, customer care)

- Familiarity with Genworth’s values and customer mission; prior exposure to LTC claims or servicing is a plus

- Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban), Jira/Azure DevOps, DCO workshops, and design‑thinking techniques

Employee Benefits & Well-Being

Genworth employees make a difference in people’s lives every day. We’re committed to making a difference in our employees’ lives.

- Competitive Compensation & Total Rewards Incentives

- Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage

- Multiple 401(k) Savings Plan Options

- Auto Enrollment in Employer-Directed Retirement Account Feature (100% employer-funded!)

- Generous Paid Time Off – Including 12 Paid Holidays, Volunteer Time Off and Paid Family Leave

- Disability, Life, and Long Term Care Insurance

- Tuition Reimbursement, Student Loan Repayment and Training & Certification Support

- Wellness support including gym membership reimbursement and Employee Assistance Program resources (work/life support, financial & legal management)

- Caregiver and Mental Health Support Services

Additional

National Range: $120,900-$187,000

High-Cost Range (includes New York): $151,100-$234,000

Disclaimer: This role is aligned to a national market-based pay range. Actual compensation will vary based on geographic location, experience, skills, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in a bonus incentive plan. Incentive compensation is based on individual and company performance and is not guaranteed.

IGS is currently recruiting a remote Lead Pega System Architect to support our work with our federal customer.

The Pega Lead System Architect (LSA) provides technical leadership for the design, development, integration, and optimization of Pega based solutions. This role works closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, define technical strategies, and ensure successful system implementation aligned with organizational goals. - Define IT strategies and manage infrastructure to meet organizational objectives.

- Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and information security protocols.

- Coordinate with Pega vendor on Service Requests and their resolution.

- Mentor and guide junior developers and system architects.

Requirements

- Bachelors/master’s in computer science (CS) preferred
