Je bent LSA. Je draait complexe projecten. Maar wanneer heb je voor het laatst écht invloed gehad op de technologische koers? Bij BPM Company ben je meer dan alleen een technisch uitvoerder. Je werkt aan impactvolle projecten bij toonaangevende en dynamische organisaties, met de ruimte om jouw visie vorm te geven en bij te blijven met de innovaties van Pega. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar je samenwerkt met inhoudelijk sterke collega’s en waar je continu wordt uitgedaagd om het beste uit jezelf te halen.

Waarom BPM Company dé plek is voor jou als Pega Lead System Architect

Ben je als LSA toe aan meer afwisseling en échte invloed? Bij BPM Company werk je aan impactvolle projecten binnen een divers klantportfolio: van financiële instellingen tot retail en overheid. Dankzij onze langdurige klantrelaties zitten we vroeg aan tafel en ben jij als LSA technisch koersbepalend. Je denkt actief mee over innovatie, schaalbaarheid en toekomstbestendigheid en hebt directe invloed op de business. Tegelijkertijd investeren we doelgericht in jouw professionele groei. Je krijgt hierbij ondersteuning van een eigen Field Manager: een inhoudelijk betrokken sparringpartner die jouw vak verstaat, met je meedenkt en helpt om jouw ambities te vertalen naar concrete groeistappen.

Jouw rol als Pega Lead System Architect

Als LSA ben jij de technische autoriteit binnen onze Pega-projecten. Je ontwerpt schaalbare, herbruikbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen, leidt het technische design en begeleidt het development team. Je waarborgt kwaliteit, performance en security gedurende de hele Application Lifecycle en werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders, developers en andere architecten. Daarbij blijf je actief op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen Pega, zodat je jouw architectuurkeuzes steeds kunt onderbouwen met actuele inzichten en best practices.

Onderdeel van een sterke Pega community

Bij BPM Company maak je deel uit van een hechte community van LSA’s en SSA’s. We stimuleren kennisdeling en innovatie in de volle breedte van het vak: van interne kennissessies tot hackathons en inhoudelijke practice sessies met thema’s als de overgang naar Constellation UX en toepassingen van nieuwe GenAI-mogelijkheden metpraktische toepassingen. Daarnaast nemen we jaarlijks collega’s mee naar PegaWorld, zodat jij als een van de eersten inzicht hebt in de nieuwste roadmap, features en strategische richting van het platform. Zo blijf je altijd een stap voor en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen.

Dit breng jij mee als LSA

- HBO/WO opgeleid

- Pega CLSA gecertificeerd met minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring

- Ervaring met het (bege)leiden van ontwikkelteams

- Ervaren met de nieuwste Pega features en best practices en continu up-to-date met ontwikkelingen.

- Gedreven om jezelf te ontwikkelen

- Communicatief vaardig in zowel het Nederlands & Engels

Dit verdien jij

- Een contract voor onbepaalde tijd

- Bandbreedte jaarsalaris: €75k – €110k

- Een volledige uitrusting zoals leaseauto (of mobiliteitsvergoeding), telefoon en laptop

- Carrière ontwikkeling door ons unieke talent management systeem gericht op Pega

- Een cultuur waarin we samen hard werken, maar waar dat hand in hand gaat met mooie extra’s, zoals bonussen en jaarlijkse skitrips.

- Een plek binnen een betrokken en gedreven team van gelijkgestemde collega’s

Spreek met een professional

Wil jij met één van onze Lead System Architecten praten over werken bij BPM Company? Plan een gesprek in via ons recruitment team en stel al jouw vragen direct aan je eventuele toekomstige collega! Bekijk nu ook de podcast van onze Pega Lead System Architect, Maarten Veger. Een podcast speciaal voor Pega ontwikkelaars.

jobs.description_text:
PEGA Application Developer - Werk vanuit Nederland of Belgie en maak impact voor de Nederlandse overheid

Bij Atos krijg je de kans om als PEGA Application Developer bij te dragen aan de digitale transformatie van de overheid. Als partner van Atos voor Pega in Nederland werken we aan strategische projecten voor de Rijksoverheid, één van de grootste en meest invloedrijke klanten in Nederland. In deze hybride rol werk je 1 à 2 dagen per week op locatie bij de klant, de rest van de tijd bepaal jij zelf waar en hoe je werkt.

Low-code ontwikkeling met Pega is de toekomst, en jij kunt je verder ontwikkelen als expert in dit vakgebied. Dit is een kans om je te verdiepen in innovatieve softwareoplossingen die essentieel zijn voor de publieke sector.

Wat ga je doen?

- Analyseren van bedrijfsprocessen en klantbehoeften en deze vertalen naar Pega-oplossingen die de strategie van de klant versterken.

- Samenwerken met het interne team en de klant om applicaties te ontwikkelen en te implementeren op het Pega-platform.

- Ondersteunen van de verkoopcyclus door als solution architect Pega-voorstellen te ontwikkelen en mee te denken met de klant.

- Meewerken aan presales-activiteiten en technische klantbijeenkomsten.

- Integreren van Pega-oplossingen met bestaande systemen en verbeteringen aanbrengen in de IT-infrastructuur van de klant.

- Actief bijdragen aan de groei van de Pega-praktijk binnen Eviden/Atos en zorgen voor kennisdeling.

- Werken in een Agile team waarbij je je technische expertise deelt om de kwaliteit en snelheid van projecten te verbeteren.

- Leveren van technische begeleiding en ondersteuning aan je collega’s.

Wat bieden wij jou?

- Low coding is de toekomst; als je van puzzelen en efficiëntie houdt, is dit jouw platform!

- Sky is the limit; doorgroeien en ontwikkeling staan centraal bij Eviden/Atos. Je krijgt een ruim opleidingsbudget en kunt binnen de organisatie blijven groeien. We zitten wereldwijd, dus je kunt jezelf uitweiden naar een van onze vestigingen in het buitenland.

- Hecht team; ondanks dat we een grote organisatie zijn, heerst er door het werken in kleinere teams een fijne, informele sfeer en kun je als team op elkaar bouwen.

- Veel kennisdeling; we organiseren minimaal 1 keer per 2 maanden een kennissessie, waar we met al onze Pega-specialisten samenkomen en kennis uitwisselen. Hoewel het vrijblijvend is, is vrijwel iedereen aanwezig.

- Vrijheid en vertrouwen; we werken hybride, en je bent vrij om zelf je dagen in te delen. Uiteraard stem je af met je team, maar we vertrouwen erop dat jij een werkwijze kiest die het beste uit jou als persoon haalt!

- Een uitdagende baan op het snijvlak tussen business en IT.

- Goede onboarding; waarbij je start met het behalen van je Pega-certificering, gekoppeld wordt aan een senior buddy die jou wegwijs maakt in de wereld van Pega en al snel aan een oplossing kan werken voor onze klanten.

Wat breng jij mee?

- Je hebt (bijna) een bachelor of master in Data Science, AI, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting.

- Je hebt ervaring met het werken in klantgerichte rollen en het vertalen van klantbehoeften naar technische oplossingen.

- Ervaring met Pega is vereist. Certificeringen zoals CSSA en CLSA zijn een pré.

- Kennis van integratiecomponenten zoals REST, SOAP en XML.

- Je spreekt vloeiend Engels en hebt minimaal B2-niveau in de Nederlandse taal.

- Bereidheid om te leren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen in een snelgroeiende technologie.

Wat bieden we nog meer (NL)?

- Een competitief salaris dat is afgestemd op jouw ervaring.

- Direct een vast contract.

- Maandelijks budget voor alternatief vervoer.

- Vakantietoeslag.

- Vaste eindejaarsuitkering.

- Vaste maandelijkse netto onkostenvergoeding.

- De mogelijkheid om 32 uur per week te werken.

- 29 vakantiedagen per jaar (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), met de optie om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen.

- Een laptop, telefoonabonnement en budget voor een zakelijke gsm.

- Bijdrage in de collectieve ziektekostenverzekering.

- Een ruim opleidingsbudget.

Klaar om de digitale transformatie van de overheid mee vorm te geven? We horen graag van je!

Over Atos Group

Atos Group is een wereldwijde speler op het gebied van digitale transformatie met circa 67.000 medewerkers en een jaaromzet van ongeveer €10 miljard. Atos is actief in 61 landen en opereert onder twee merken Atos voor dienstverlening en Eviden voor producten. In Europa is Atos marktleider op het gebied van cybersecurity, cloud en high performance computing. Atos SE is genoteerd aan Euronext Parijs.

Atos helpt organisaties bij het ontwerpen van de toekomst van de digitale informatievoorziening, met aandacht voor veiligheid, duurzaamheid en technologische innovatie.

Bij Atos zijn diversiteit en inclusie ingebed in ons DNA. Lees meer over ons streven naar een eerlijke werkomgeving voor iedereen.

Atos is een erkende leider in zijn branche op het gebied van milieu, maatschappij en bestuur. Lees meer over ons MVO-engagement.

Kies je toekomst. Kies Atos.

jobs.description_text:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een mooie toekomst voor iedereen, dat is waar we bij Sopra Steria naartoe werken. Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen zijn we één van de grootste leveranciers van digital solutions in Europa. We geloven dat niet alleen technologie transformatie aandrijft, maar dat mensen de kern van verandering vormen. Daarom staan mensen centraal in alles wat we doen en kun je bij ons zowel individueel als in een team uitblinken.

In Nederland werk je binnen RulesMatter. Een nuchter, betrokken team dat organisaties helpt hun processen slimmer en toekomstbestendig te maken met regelgebaseerde technologie. Binnen onze Business Process practice vertalen we complexe businessvragen naar overzicht, structuur en richting, met Pega als belangrijk platform.

We bouwen geen losse oplossingen, maar slimme processen die écht gebruikt worden.

The world is how we shape it.

Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Als Business Architect bij Sopra Steria ben je inhoudelijk leidend op het snijvlak van business en Pega. Jij overziet het geheel. Je begrijpt hoe processen samenhangen, waar de echte knelpunten zitten en hoe je daar een toekomstbestendige oplossing voor ontwerpt.

Je werkt intensief samen met stakeholders, Business Analisten en Pega Consultants. Jij zet de richting uit. Je bewaakt samenhang, prioriteit en businesswaarde, van eerste klantgesprek tot werkende oplossing.

In deze rol houd je je vooral bezig met:

- Het vertalen van strategische businessdoelen naar een duidelijke Pega-aanpak en roadmap

- Het ontwerpen van Microjourneys en het neerzetten van een logisch, schaalbaar fundament

- Het begeleiden van teams in het realiseren van een Minimum Lovable Product dat direct waarde levert

Je bent sparringpartner voor de klant én voor je team. Je stelt de juiste vragen, maakt scherpe keuzes en zorgt dat oplossingen niet alleen werken, maar ook blijven werken.

Je werkt hybride vanuit ons kantoor in Nieuwegein, gecombineerd met klantlocaties en thuis. Binnen RulesMatter krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te pakken en écht richting te geven.

Functie-eisen

Dit zijn jouw sterktes

Je overziet het grotere geheel en raakt niet in de war van complexiteit. Je begrijpt hoe processen samenhangen, waar risico’s zitten en waar je moet versimpelen in plaats van toevoegen. Je bent inhoudelijk sterk, maar ook communicatief volwassen. Je durft richting te geven, zonder dominant te worden.

Wat we bij jou terugzien:

- Je hebt ruime ervaring in een rol als Business Architect of als senior business analist met duidelijke eindverantwoordelijkheid

- Je kunt strategische doelen vertalen naar een concrete aanpak, roadmap en ontwerp

- Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen van procesarchitecturen en het opzetten van samenhangende oplossingen

- Je beweegt je makkelijk tussen stakeholders, ontwikkelteams en management

- Je spreekt Nederlands op minimaal B2-niveau en voelt je comfortabel in een klantomgeving

Ervaring met Pega en certificering als Business Architect is sterk gewenst. Heb je die nog niet, maar wel aantoonbare ervaring in vergelijkbare BPM- of low-code omgevingen? Dan kijken we daar serieus naar.

Aanvullende informatie

Dit krijg je van ons

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

- Een vast contract en een salaris afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en inschaling

- Vakantiegeld van 8%;

- Sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van gezellige borrels tot sportieve of inhoudelijke uitjes;

- Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via trainingen, kennisdelingssessies en inspirerende (netwerk)events;

- Hybride werken: thuis, op ons kantoor in Groningen of bij de klant, afhankelijk van wat jij nodig hebt;

- Een royaal mobiliteitsbudget, in de vorm van een leaseregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatief vervoersregeling. Net wat het beste bij jouw manier van reizen past;

- Winstdeling van 8% on target;

- 27 betaalde vakantiedagen;

- Mogelijkheid om op fiscaal vriendelijke manier studieschuld af te lossen, een fiets, zonnepanelen of sportabonnementen aan te schaffen (Cafetaria-systeem) of andere personeelskortingen te verkrijgen;

- Een internetvergoeding van €15 netto per maand, een aanvullende thuiswerkvergoeding van €21,50 netto per maand waarbij wij jou daarbij faciliteiten bieden voor de uitrusting van jouw eigen thuiskantoor;

- Een flexibele pensioenregeling, waaraan jij op maat en passend bij jou, bijdragen kan toevoegen.

Reageer gerust. We kijken ernaar uit om je te leren kennen.

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

jobs.description_text:
Wil jij werken aan slimme, procesgedreven oplossingen met PEGA en organisaties helpen hun dienstverlening écht te verbeteren? Of heb je juist de ambitie om je te ontwikkelen tot Business Analist PEGA en wil je daarin professioneel worden opgeleid? Bij ilionx bieden we beide mogelijkheden.

Jouw functie als Business Analist PEGA

Als Business Analist PEGA werk je op het snijvlak van business en IT. Pega is een modern ICT-platform dat gebruikt wordt om zaakgerichte werkprocessen voor opdrachtgevers te automatiseren. Je vertaalt complexe processen en klantvragen naar heldere requirements d.m.v. interviews en realiseert samen met je team krachtige PEGA-oplossingen. Je bent betrokken bij het hele traject: van analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie en optimalisatie.

Heb je al ervaring met PEGA? Dan krijg je direct verantwoordelijkheid binnen uitdagende projecten. Heb je nog geen of beperkte PEGA-ervaring, maar wel affiniteit met businessanalyse en procesautomatisering? Dan leiden wij je op via onze ilionx Academy en groei je stap voor stap in de rol.

Je werkt aan projecten bij klanten waar PEGA een belangrijke rol speelt in het verbeteren van processen en digitale dienstverlening.

Wat ga je doen

• Analyseren en modelleren van bedrijfsprocessen

• Vertalen van businesswensen naar functionele en niet-functionele requirements

• Opstellen, analyseren en prioriteren van user stories

• Samenwerken met developers, consultants en stakeholders

• Bijdragen aan de doorontwikkeling en optimalisatie van PEGA-oplossingen

• Meedenken over procesverbetering en automatisering

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ilionx krijg je de ruimte om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen. We investeren in opleidingen, certificeringen en kennissessies zodat jij zowel persoonlijk als in het vakgebied van PEGA kan groeien.

Daarnaast bieden we jou:

• Een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen de €3500,- en €6000,- o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring

• Een ruime mobiliteitsvergoeding, netto onkostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling bij a.s.r.

• Direct een vast contract en een bonus die kan oplopen tot een kalendermaand

• Uitdagende & innovatieve PEGA-projecten met impact

• Een open en informele cultuur met collega’s die expert zijn in hun vakgebied

• Regelmatige bijeenkomsten met collega’s om inzichten en ervaringen te delen

• Leuke evenementen en uitjes, waaronder onze jaarlijkse ilionx wintersport

Wat vragen wij van jou?

• Affiniteit met IT en low-code platformen, bij voorkeur PEGA

• Interesse in businessanalyse en procesoptimalisatie

• Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en analytisch vermogen

• Bereidheid om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen

Verder heb je:

• Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding

• Minimaal 3 jaar IT-ervaring als PEGA Consultant, Business (Informatie) Analist, functioneel ontwerper of vergelijkbaar

• Behaalde PEGA-certificeringen zoals Certified Business Architect PEGA zijn een grote pré

• Kennis en ervaring met het werken met Agile methodieken

• Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel in woord als geschrift

Bovenstaande criteria zijn een indicatie van het profiel wat we zoeken. We beseffen dat elk individu een unieke set aan vaardigheden, expertise, skills en denkwijzen met zich meebrengt. Tegelijkertijd blijkt uit onderzoek dat sommigen pas solliciteren als er een 100% match is. Hierbij nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren als je je herkent in het profiel, óók als je niet aan alle eisen voldoet!

Het Team

Binnen de unit Digitale Strategie werken we dagelijks nauw samen met collega’s die net even dat stapje extra voor onze klanten in regio Noord-Nederland durven te zetten. En dat vooral met passie, gedrevenheid én enthousiasme.

Jouw manager Albert Jan zorgt hierin vooral voor een prettige werkomgeving waarin hij jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling én de samenwerking met jouw collega’s juist alleen maar zal aanmoedigen. Dit doet hij op basis van onderling vertrouwen, transparantie en het motto 'afspraak is afspraak'.

Lees hier praktijkervaringen van jouw toekomstige ilionx collega’s!

Als Requirements Engineer bij ASN Bank speel jij een grote rol in optimaliseren en verder automatiseren van onze Collections & Recovery (C&R) processen. Jij wordt een van de drijvende krachten achter het vertalen en realiseren van complexe eisen naar werkende systemen. Iets voor jou? Solliciteer dan nu!

Wat ga je doen

Als Requirements Engineer werk je aan de optimale doorontwikkeling van onze Pega applicaties. Binnen C&R neemt PEGA een zeer centrale rol in. Onze gehele applicatie voor onze service medewerkers is ontwikkeld in PEGA en daarnaast hebben we ook diverse selfservice processen werken met PEGA. C&R vraagt daarom om systemen die feilloos werken én voldoen aan de strengste regelgeving. Je vertaalt complexe eisen naar heldere, uitvoerbare requirements en zorgt dat interne én externe teams weten wat er van hen verwacht wordt. Samen met meerdere teams zorg je voor een veilige en compliant bank. Je werkt samen met interne stakeholders en een internationaal engineering team aan systemen die impact hebben. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

- Je bent mede-eigenaar van de Pega applicaties binnen C&R. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en doorontwikkeling van deze systemen

- Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar heldere, concrete requirements en technische oplossingen

- Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor stakeholders zoals: service team leads, het data team en business developers

- Je brengt belangen samen en houdt alle partijen scherp en betrokken

- Je stuurt off-shore teams aan, zorgt voor een gestructureerde samenwerking en bewaakt dat requirements correct worden begrepen, opleveringen voldoen aan de gestelde eisen en je bewaakt de voortgang

- Van eerste analyse tot en met acceptatie, jij zorgt ervoor dat de realisatie soepel verloopt en dat wat wordt opgeleverd ook optimaal werkt

Hier kom je te werken

Het team binnen C&R bestaat straks uit 6 requirements engineers. Daarmee werkt je nauw samen met Business Developers en IT-engineers, zowel interne collega's als een engineering-teams in India. Gezamenlijk vertalen we beleid en de roadmap voor C&R naar praktische, hoogwaardige en efficiënte oplossingen. In een internationale, informele en open sfeer werken we voortdurend aan het verbeteren en optimaliseren van onze systemen.

Wat breng jij mee?

Als Requirements Engineer ben je analytisch, communicatief sterk en gewend om te schakelen tussen business en techniek. Je houdt van structuur, maar bent flexibel genoeg om in een dynamische omgeving te opereren. Jij bent die Requirements Engineer die technische kennis combineert met sterk stakeholder management . Verder heb je:

- Hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau

- Je hebt ervaring met het opstellen van Satements of Work (SoW’s) voor outsourcingspartners

- Je hebt ervaring met offshore teams

- Kennis van Collections & Recovery en haar processen is een pré

- Je hebt kennis van Pega Collections, CDH (customer decision hub), Pega customer service

- Je kunt complexe vraagstukken terug brengen naar begrijpelijke oplossingen

- Ervaring met het ophalen en vertalen van requirements in een compliance- of financiële omgeving

- Met jouw scherpe oog voor detail en sterke gevoel voor samenwerking neem jij zowel interne stakeholders als externe teams mee

Wat krijg je van ons?

Deze functie valt in schaal 9, met een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.552,48 en € 6.069,97 op basis van 36 uur per week. Verder bieden wij:

- Een flexibel in te delen 36-urige werkweek, zoals 4x9 en thuiswerken

- 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand, op een moment dat het jou goed uitkomt

- Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband: 208,8 uur verlofuren per jaar

- Een goede collectieve pensioenregeling

- € 750,- per jaar om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen (te sparen tot € 3.000,-)

- Elke 5 jaar € 900,- om je thuiswerkplek weer helemaal op orde te maken

- Een NS-Business Card en een kilometervergoeding voor als je op de fiets komt

- Lees hier alles over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden

Over ons

ASN Bank is een toegankelijke en vooruitstrevende bank met oog voor mens, maatschappij en de toekomst. We dragen op duurzame wijze bij aan financiële oplossingen voor onze klanten én aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken in Nederland. Daarbij hebben we bijzondere aandacht voor duurzaamheid, financieel welzijn en goed wonen. Als bank combineren we het gemak van veilig mobiel bankieren met de kracht van persoonlijk advies. Dankzij ons landelijk dekkend netwerk van kantoren zijn we ook fysiek dichtbij op de momenten die ertoe doen.

Word onze collega

Maak jij je sterk voor morgen? Solliciteer dan vandaag bij ASN Bank. Upload je motivatie en cv, dan nemen we snel contact met je op. De sollicitatieprocedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken en een assessment. Voor meer informatie kun je terecht bij Robin Schenk, corporate recruiter, via robin.schenk@asnbank.nl

Job Title/Designation: Architect / Senior Architect

Job Role: Pega Architect

Job Type: Full Time

Job Location: Bangalore only

Joining Availability: Immediate to 45 days max

Job Description:

We are looking for an accomplished Pega Architect (LSA Certified) with proven expertise in architecting and developing enterprise-scale Pega applications. The role involves leading solution design, mentoring development teams, enforcing Pega best practices, and ensuring successful delivery of high-quality, scalable solutions.

Essential Technical Qualification:

- Mandatory - Certified Lead System Architect (LSA) (both Part 1 & 2)

- Overall 10+ years relevant Pega experience and at least 3-5 Pega projects implementation.

- Pega experience across versions 8.6.6 to Pega Infinity 25.1 and above.

- Proven experience in architecting and implementing end-to-end Pega solutions in large-scale enterprise environments. Strong understanding of Design concepts like Situational Layer Cake, Data Modelling and Case type modelling.

- Hands-on experience in setting up Authentications using SAML/OAUTH protocols. Understanding of ABAC/ RBAC concepts.

- Experience in solutions development on Pega using Case type rules, flows, data models, Activities, integrations and Pega mobility.

- Hands-on experience across the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, integration design and implementation and deployment within Pega environments, both using manual approach and using Pega Deployment Manager.

- Strong understanding of Case management concepts, Flows, Data pages, Connectors & Services and their Synchronous and Asynchronous execution concepts.

- Debugging Skills and experience using Tracer, Clipboard, PAL, Profiler, DB Trace. Special expertise required in debugging Constellation applications using developer tools.

- Experience in handling bulk data processing using Data Flows. Excellent understanding of Data flows, data sets, their types and usage including Kafka queues.

- Implementation experience / working knowledge on Customer Service (Constellation) framework. Setting up interactions, service cases, dialogs, channels, Knowledge articles and suggested cases and intents and next best offers.

- Knowledge on Pega's Gen AI offerings like BluePrint, Agents, Gen AI Connect, Coach and Knowledge Buddy.

- Experience working in a Constellation application. Understanding of Constellation architecture, differences with cosmos, prescribed UX advantages/disadvantages.

- Experience in Data migration. Ability to setup design and implementation strategies for migrating data from legacy systems to Pega applications.

- Demonstrates excellent customer interaction abilities and strong verbal and written communication skills.

- Experience in working on Agile/Scrum methodologies.

- Capable of applying customer standards by reusing existing frameworks or establishing and enforcing appropriate standards in solution development. Proficient in designing and promoting reusable components as enterprise assets.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead and mentor the development team, providing technical guidance and support as required.

- Responsible for architecting and designing business applications using Pega PRPC and related Pega frameworks.

- Drive the design, development, testing, and deployment of scalable and maintainable solutions within the PRPC Rules environment.

- Create technical designs, estimations, define enterprise class structures, integration standards and design and review infrastructure requirements such as data architecture definitions and data management plans.

- Collaborate with the Enterprise Solution Architect to deliver end-to-end Pega applications and projects.

- Understand the customer's enterprise technology landscape and position Pega effectively within the overall architecture.

- Demonstrated expertise in code review, optimization, and Pega application performance analysis, including performance tuning. Responsible for analysing, identifying, and logging application enhancements and defects.

- Ensure the application not only meets current business needs but is also designed to accommodate future scalability and feature enhancements.

- Analyze and resolve complex design and configuration challenges to meet defined objectives.

- Prepare High-Level Designs (HLDs), low-code platform solutions, and gather non-functional requirements (NFRs).

- Review and approve solution designs, logic configurations, and technical artifacts to ensure alignment with Pega best practices.

- Oversee and execute deployment activities across all environments, including Production.

- Provide accurate time and resource estimates for project deliverables in line with established processes.

- Offer thought leadership, technical inputs on dependencies, sequencing, and risks to assist the Project Manager in project planning and execution.

- Support decisions with evidence-based research and influence stakeholders accordingly.

Preferred Qualification: (Optional/Good to have)

- Experience in any of the Pega frameworks: Underwriting, CS, Smart Dispute, Smart Investigate, CLM/KYC etc.

- Exposure to Pega Decisioning or Pega Marketing modules, with a solid grasp of their application within customer engagement and business process workflows.

Job Title/Designation: Senior Consultant

Job Role: Pega Developer

Job Type: Full Time

Job Location: Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Bhubaneshwar, Gurgaon, Pune

Availability to Join: Immediate to 15 days

Job Description:

We are seeking a Pega Senior System Architect (SSA) to support our client's digital transformation initiatives using the Pega platform. The ideal candidate will have strong hands‑on development skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a project team to design, build, and enhance Pega applications. This role will be part of a delivery team and may be based on‑site or offshore, depending on project and client needs. It offers an excellent opportunity to grow technical expertise while working under guidance from senior architects and consultants.

Essential Technical Qualification:

Mandatory:

- Pega Certified System Architect (CSA)

- Pega Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA)

- 4.5–6 years of hands‑on experience in Pega application development with at least one end‑to‑end project implementation.

- Experience working on Pega 7.x / 8.x / latest Pega versions.

Mandatory Platform Exposure

- Experience in Constellation is considered a strong advantage. Pega Constellation applications – OOTB UI usage, dashboards/insights, basic developer‑level debugging

Core Pega Technical Skills

Good understanding of case management concepts, including:

- Parent–child cases

- Parallel processing

- Locking and data propagation

- Use of standard and advanced flow shapes

- Hands‑on experience with Flows, Screen Flows, Activities, SLAs, and decision rules.

- Working knowledge of Declarative Rules, Data Pages, and background processing concepts.

- Experience in configuring integrations such as REST, Email, File, MQ, JMS, with exposure to synchronous and asynchronous patterns.

- Basic understanding of Report Definitions, dashboards, and insights.

- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills using Pega developer tools.

Delivery & Collaboration

- Experience working in Agile / Scrum delivery environments.

- Ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional and geographically distributed teams.

- Good communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop, configure, and enhance Pega applications following Pega guardrails and best practices.

- Support application design and implementation activities under guidance from senior architects.

- Participate in design discussions to understand business requirements and domain context.

- Troubleshoot and resolve application issues and defects.

- Prepare and maintain technical documentation for assigned components.

- Create prototypes and proofs of concept to validate requirements and design approaches.

- Adhere to established coding, testing, and quality standards.

- Participate in show‑and‑tell sessions and demos, incorporating feedback to improve solutions.

- Work collaboratively as part of a project delivery team to ensure timely and high‑quality outcomes.

Preferred Qualification: (Optional/Good to have)

- Exposure to Pega frameworks such as Customer Service, CRM, BFSI, Smart Dispute, Smart Investigate, CLM‑KYC

- Awareness of performance tools such as PAL / PLA / PDC.

- Basic understanding of Java, SQL, Unix/Linux concepts.

- Ability to assist senior team members with design reviews, estimations, and integration discussions.

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem‑solving skills.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in planning and executing complex Pega upgrades, including migration from legacy Pega versions to the latest Infinity platform, while ensuring application stability, performance, security, and business continuity.

The candidate will work closely with Business Architects, Lead System Architects, DevOps teams, Infrastructure teams, and Business Stakeholders to deliver scalable and future-ready Pega solutions.

Pega Upgrade & Modernization

Lead end-to-end Pega platform upgrade initiatives from older Pega versions to Pega Infinity.

Perform upgrade impact assessments and prepare technical remediation plans.

Analyze deprecated features and implement suitable alternatives.

Refactor and optimize legacy applications to align with current Pega best practices.

Resolve upgrade-related guardrail violations and technical debt.

Validate compatibility of integrations, agents, queue processors, REST/SOAP services, and authentication mechanisms.

Solution Design & Development

Design and develop enterprise-grade Pega solutions using Pega Platform.

Configure Case Types, Data Pages, Flows, Decisioning, Integrations, Security, and Reporting components.

Ensure adherence to Pega guardrails and enterprise architecture standards.

Participate in architecture reviews and technical design discussions.

Performance & Stability

Conduct performance analysis and tuning post-upgrade.

Identify and mitigate application bottlenecks.

Support load testing and production readiness activities.

Ensure platform scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

CI/CD & DevOps

Support deployment automation using CI/CD pipelines.

Manage branch strategies and application packaging.

Coordinate code migration across environments.

Work closely with DevOps and Infrastructure teams during upgrade and deployment activities.

Testing & Production Support

Support SIT, UAT, and Production validation activities.

Analyze and resolve defects identified during upgrade testing.

Participate in production implementation and hypercare support.

Mandatory Skills

CSSA Certification

Strong hands-on experience in Pega Upgrade Projects

Experience upgrading applications from Pega 7.x/8.x to Pega Infinity

PEGA AI ,CDH

Pega Case Management

Data Pages

Integration (REST, SOAP, Kafka, JMS)

Security Frameworks (SSO, OAuth, LDAP, SAML)

Performance Tuning

Branching & Application Packaging

Deployment Management

SQL , Postgres

Meet Our Team

Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high-quality, outcome-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.

Picture Yourself At Pega

Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.

At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.

We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

What You'll Do At Pega

- Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment

- Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle

- Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions

- Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.

- Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro-actively respond to adhoc questions

Who You Are

- Pega CLSA Certified resource must.

- You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.

- 12 plus years of Pega experience in building and implementing model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions.

- Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities

- Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate

- Willingness to go the extra mile

- Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example

- Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business & IT stakeholders

- Open to work from 1:00 - 10:00 PM IST

You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.

You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You've Accomplished

- You’ve built and implemented model-driven, enterprise-level business solutions and applications.

- You’ve led end-to-end delivery of medium to large component of bigger solution.

- You’ve been exposed to a variety of technologies including Application Servers, programming languages, relational and non-relational data bases and integration techniques.

- You’ve demonstrated knowledge of and applicability of Object-Oriented techniques and principles.

- You’ve delivered solutions in Agile and Scrum methodologie

Pega Offers You

- Gartner Analyst acclaimed technology leadership across our categories of products.

- Continuous learning and development opportunities.

- An innovative, inclusive, agile, flexible, and fun work environment.

- Competitive global benefits program inclusive of pay and bonus incentive, employee equity in the company

- An opportunity to work in an organization that actively invests in AI‑enabled learning, innovation, and responsible adoption across its engineering practices

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer – Pega Development

Location: Bangalore

Business & Team:

CBA has a vision of building a brighter future for all.

Our team brings together Pega engineers, technical specialists and experienced leaders. We partner closely with ASB (Auckland Savings Bank, NZ) to design and deliver secure, scalable enterprise solutions that support key business outcomes.

Impact & Contribution:

As a Senior Software Engineer – Pega Development, you will design, build, test and support secure, scalable enterprise applications using Pega, working within an Agile squad to deliver reliable customer and business outcomes.

You will translate requirements into well-designed Pega solutions, develop reusable components and integrations, apply engineering standards, troubleshoot production issues, and contribute to continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Pega Application Development: Design, develop, test and deploy Pega applications and enhancements within an Agile squad.

Solution Design: Translate business requirements and solution designs into secure, scalable and maintainable Pega configurations and code.

Case Management & Integrations: Build and support integrations, reusable components, case management workflows and user experiences.

Engineering Best Practices: Apply Pega development, deployment, security, performance and engineering best practices.

Testing & Deployment: Participate in code and design reviews, automated testing, release activities and production support.

Production Support: Investigate incidents, defects, vulnerabilities and performance issues, and implement sustainable fixes.

Continuous Improvement: Share knowledge with engineers and contribute to continuous improvement of squad delivery practices.

Essential Skills:

Pega Development Experience:

- 5+ years of hands-on Pega development experience delivering enterprise applications.

- Pega Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA) certification, or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience across analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and production support.

- Strong understanding of Pega case management, data modelling, rules, user interface, security and application architecture.

Integration & Engineering:

- Good understanding of enterprise integration patterns, APIs, services and troubleshooting.

- Ability to apply knowledge of technology stacks to solve business problems and articulate technical trade-offs.

- Working knowledge of Agile delivery methods, CI/CD, source control, automated testing and secure engineering practices.

Pega Platforms & Frameworks:

- Experience with Pega Cloud, Constellation, or frameworks such as KYC/CLM, Smart Disputes/Investigate, Customer Service or AIM.

Collaboration & Communication:

- Strong communication and collaboration skills across business and technical audiences.

- Ability to collaborate with product, business, architecture, testing and operations stakeholders to resolve delivery challenges.

- Ability to contribute to peer reviews, knowledge sharing, engineering guardrails and continuous improvement across the squad.

Education Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer Science/Information Technology.

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

Job Title: Staff Software Engineer

Location: Bangalore-Manyata Tech Park

Impact & Contribution:

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer with strong hands-on engineering and architecture experience across Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices and cloud-native platforms, complemented by expertise in Pega and enterprise workflow/case management solutions.

You will play a key technical leadership role in designing and modernising large-scale applications, building resilient services and integration capabilities, and evolving our platforms towards modern cloud-native architectures. The ideal candidate brings a strong software engineering and product mindset, is comfortable working across Java-based services and Pega applications, and can make pragmatic architectural decisions across distributed systems, APIs, data, cloud and workflow platforms.

Knowledge of AI fundamentals, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions is highly regarded. As a Staff Engineer, you will remain hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers and influencing engineering standards and architecture across teams.

Roles & Responsibilities:

- Lead the architecture, design and delivery of Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices and Pega solutions, ensuring scalable, resilient, secure and maintainable enterprise applications.

- Drive application modernisation and cloud-native engineering, including legacy decomposition, API enablement, AWS migration, containers/Kubernetes/ECS, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and DevSecOps.

- Define architectural boundaries and integration patterns across Pega, Java services, enterprise platforms and external systems, determining when capabilities should be implemented in Pega versus custom services.

- Establish and champion strong engineering practices covering clean code, API design, automated testing, security, observability, performance, production readiness, code/design reviews and troubleshooting.

- Provide technical leadership and mentoring across engineering teams, collaborate with product and architecture stakeholders, and enable appropriate adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within enterprise applications.

Essential Skills:

- 12–18 years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership across complex enterprise platforms and architecture-level decision-making.

- Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices and distributed systems, including RESTful APIs, enterprise integration, concurrency, resiliency, scalability, performance and troubleshooting.

- Strong experience with relational/NoSQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB, along with authentication and application security including OAuth2, JWT and OWASP principles.

- Hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-native engineering, including ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS, API Gateway, IAM, Secrets Manager and CloudWatch, as well as Docker and Kubernetes.

- Strong experience with CI/CD, DevSecOps and infrastructure automation, including GitHub Actions/Jenkins, Terraform/CDK, automated testing, code quality, secrets management and production observability.

- Hands-on experience designing and delivering Pega enterprise applications, with strong knowledge of case management, workflows, data/integration patterns, security, performance and application architecture; Pega LSA or equivalent architecture-level experience is highly regarded.

- Experience with modern Pega capabilities, including Constellation, Blueprint, App Signature and Pega GenAI features, is highly regarded.

- Ability to make architecture decisions across custom Java development, APIs/microservices and Pega low-code capabilities, selecting the appropriate technology for each business problem; TypeScript and modern front-end experience is desirable.

- Knowledge of AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures, with exposure to agent design/orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LangSmith, OpenAI/Bedrock Agent SDKs, CrewAI or AutoGen desirable.

Education Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in engineering in Computer Science/Information Technology.

jobs.description_text:
Citi is looking for a Lead Applications Developer to take senior ownership of complex application development initiatives within a global technology team. In this role, you will design and deliver high-impact software solutions integrating Pega development and AI capabilities while setting technical standards and mentoring the next generation of engineers. Your work will directly influence how Citi builds and evolves its application landscape to meet the demands of a fast-moving financial services environment.

Responsibilities

- Design and deliver application solutions that align with Citi's overall architecture, setting standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation across engineering teams.

- Build scalable, high-quality software using Pega development frameworks and AI-driven techniques to address complex business challenges.

- Partner with senior stakeholders across technology and business functions to define system enhancements that enable new products and process improvements.

- Lead in-depth analysis of business processes and system workflows to identify root causes and engineer innovative, lasting solutions.

- Develop a deep understanding of how architecture, infrastructure, and application layers interconnect to deliver integrated technology outcomes.

- Coach and guide mid-level developers and analysts, distributing work effectively to maintain delivery quality and team growth.

- Evaluate risk implications of engineering decisions with sound judgement, ensuring compliance with applicable standards and escalating control issues transparently.

Required Qualifications & Skills

- 6 to 10 years of hands-on experience in application development or systems analysis, with a track record of delivering complex software projects.

- Proficiency in Pega development, with practical experience applying Pega frameworks to build and configure enterprise applications.

- Proficiency in AI development techniques, with experience integrating AI capabilities into application design and delivery.

- Deep expertise in systems analysis and software application programming, spanning full development lifecycle activities.

- Subject matter expertise in Pega with the ability to lead technical direction.

- Demonstrated ability to lead projects from initiation through to successful delivery, managing priorities and adapting quickly as requirements evolve.

- Clear and confident communicator, able to convey technical concepts effectively to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.

- Ability to adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate

- Ability to train and mentor teams on best practices, Engineering standards and work as a team to deliver the goals

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

- Experience collaborating across multiple technology functions, Product and Operations to deliver integrated solutions.

- A background in mentoring or coaching junior and mid-level engineers in a structured team environment.

- Ability to think creative and ideate solutions that can simplify and automate workflows

Education:

- Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

What We Offer

At Citi, senior technologists have the platform to shape meaningful solutions at global scale. You will work alongside skilled engineers and business teams in a performance-driven environment that values technical leadership, continuous growth, and real delivery ownership.

- A hybrid working model offering 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you flexibility alongside meaningful team collaboration.

- Strategic influence over application architecture and engineering standards in a large-scale, globally connected technology organisation.

- Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities to deepen your expertise in Pega, AI, and enterprise application development.

- Competitive financial wellbeing benefits, including compensation and reward structures aligned to senior-level contribution and impact.

- Wellbeing and work-life balance support programmes available to all employees.

- A high-visibility role where your technical decisions and leadership have direct impact on how Citi builds and modernises its application ecosystem.

Apply today to bring your Pega and AI expertise to a senior engineering role where your technical leadership will shape application systems used across one of the world's leading global banks.

jobs.description_text:
About Citi:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients' best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We'll enable growth and progress together.

About the Team:

The Lead Solutions Architect is a strategic professional and visionary technologist within the Consumer Operations Technology Engineering & Architecture organization. Operating at the leading edge of enterprise architecture, digital transformation, and intelligent automation, this pivotal role establishes the structural foundation for scalable, resilient, and next-generation platforms that power financial services for millions of customers globally. As a subject matter expert in end-to-end system design, artificial intelligence integration, and enterprise workflow orchestration, the successful candidate will bridge technical strategy with complex business execution, spearheading architectural blueprints that ensure continuous modernization, operational excellence, and long-term competitive advantage.

In this role, you will partner collaboratively with engineering directors, business executives, product strategists, and cross-functional technology teams across a global matrixed environment. You will champion innovation by identifying emerging industry paradigms—such as generative AI, intelligent decisioning, and low-code workflow platforms—driving technical governance, and de-risking critical technology investments while safeguarding the enterprise against operational and regulatory risks. By translating ambitious business imperatives into high-performing, future-proof architectural frameworks, you will play an instrumental role in elevating Citi’s technological capabilities and driving our mission of delivering secure, seamless, and world-class client experiences.

Responsibilities:

- Design and deliver enterprise architecture solutions across major, complex IT programs, ensuring all systems align with and conform to established enterprise blueprints and standards.

- Build and maintain technology roadmaps that reflect emerging industry trends, and present clear, evidence-based recommendations to guide business direction and investment decisions.

- Translate complex business problems into well-structured, technically sound solutions that span hardware, software, and system integration design.

- Architect and integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI solutions into enterprise workflows to enhance decisioning, automate operations, and optimize consumer banking journeys.

- Design, optimize, and standardize enterprise workflow and case management solutions on the Pega Platform (including Pega Infinity, Customer Decision Hub, and 1:1 Customer Engagement), ensuring seamless integration with core banking systems.

- Provide technical leadership across systems design initiatives, taking ownership of both individual components and overall solution architecture where required.

- Identify and recommend innovative technologies and platforms that enhance existing systems and strengthen IT infrastructure to meet strategic goals.

- Advise and mentor junior architects and engineers, sharing technical expertise to raise capability and support professional development across the team.

- Assess risk in architectural and technology decisions with a focus on safeguarding the organization, ensuring adherence to relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies.

Qualifications:

- 6+ years of hands-on experience in solutions architecture, system design, software engineering, or enterprise IT architecture.

- Demonstrated hands-on expertise in architecting end-to-end distributed systems across diverse hardware, software, and networking topologies using sound engineering principles.

- Working knowledge of industry-standard enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or Zachman, with experience applying architectural artifacts, principles, and governance models.

- Practical knowledge and experience applying Agentic AI, Autonomous AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in solutioning and automating complex business applications.

- Hands-on experience architecting and deploying scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native solutions on platforms such as AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, Bedrock, SageMaker, EKS) or Microsoft Azure (AKS, Azure OpenAI, Functions, Cosmos DB).

- Proficiency in core programming languages such as Java, Python 3.10+, TypeScript, Go, or C++, with direct experience developing and maintaining high-throughput enterprise systems.

- Extensive experience designing event-driven and message-oriented integration architectures using technologies such as Apache Kafka, TIBCO, MuleSoft, or RabbitMQ.

- Strong practical knowledge of containerization and orchestration platforms, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Red Hat OpenShift, covering cluster deployment, scaling, and fault tolerance.

- Practical experience with CI/CD automation pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD to support automated testing and deployment lifecycles.

- Proficiency with enterprise data stores, including relational databases such as Oracle and PostgreSQL as well as NoSQL platforms such as MongoDB, Redis, or vector databases, with expertise in schema design and performance optimization.

- Proven experience implementing observability, telemetry, and distributed tracing solutions using tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK Stack to maintain system health and reliability.

- Robust analytical and technical debugging capability to solve multi-variable architectural bottlenecks, latency challenges, and failure modes across complex IT ecosystems.

- Familiarity with architecting enterprise applications and workflow solutions using the Pega framework (e.g., Pega Infinity, PRPC, or Pega Cloud) is a strong plus.

Education:

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant technology or engineering field.

- Master's degree in a technology, engineering, or related discipline is beneficial.

- TOGAF certification, Pega certifications (CSA/CSSA/CLSA), or relevant Cloud/AI Architecture certifications are an advantage.

jobs.description_text:
Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) - Lead Software Engineer I

Role Overview: As an Applied AI Platform Engineer (PEGA Systems Engineer) , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.

Key Responsibilities:

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.

- Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, low-level architecture and component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.

- Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.

- Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.

- Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.

- Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.

- Possess deep expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.

- Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.

- Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.

- Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The successful candidate will possess:

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

Required Qualifications:

- A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.

Prior experience with enterprise case management & low-code workforce platforms (PEGA) is important.

- 10 + years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.

- 3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).

- 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems.

- 1+ years of experience establishing engineering standards and golden paths, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards, treating the platform as a product.

- Prior experience with AI control-plane and agent-runtime patterns: model/LLM gateway, A2A and MCP integration, agent runtimes (e.g., Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore), guardrails (PII redaction, prompt-injection, content, tool permissioning/tool-RBAC), policy-as-code, and multi-tenant isolation.

- Prior experience with enterprise data platform engineering: data pipelines, self-service and data-product enablement, governance-as-code enforcement, and metadata/lineage.

- Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.

- Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, and ArgoCD to deliver high-quality platforms and products rapidly.

Other:

- Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.

- Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Recruiting tips

Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The successful candidate will possess:

jobs.description_text:
Pega Developer (India)

Location: Hyderabad OR Bangalore (Remote during training, then project deployment – minimum 2 days per week in office)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Company: Revolent

About the Opportunity

Revolent is seeking experienced Pega Developers to join an exciting career acceleration programme designed in partnership with a leading global professional services and consulting organisation.

This unique opportunity combines advanced technical training, mentorship, and real-world project delivery, enabling experienced Pega professionals to further develop their expertise in intelligent workflow automation, BPM technologies, and enterprise application development while working on large-scale digital transformation programmes.

Successful candidates will initially complete an intensive 3-week virtual training academy, designed collaboratively with a leading global consulting and technology transformation organisation. Following the academy, consultants will be deployed onto enterprise Pega projects for a minimum of 12 months, applying their knowledge in complex, large-scale client environments.

High-performing consultants may ultimately have the opportunity to transition into permanent roles with the client organisation.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

- Fully funded, instructor-led Pega training programme.

- Training designed alongside a globally recognised consulting organisation.

- Exposure to large-scale digital transformation projects.

- Opportunity to work with leading enterprise customers across multiple industries.

- Continuous mentoring and professional development.

- Potential pathway to a permanent role with the client following successful project delivery.

The Role

As a Pega Developer, you will design, develop, and implement business process management (BPM) and workflow automation solutions using the Pega Platform.

You will work within enterprise delivery teams to build scalable applications, automate complex business processes, and support organisations in modernising operations through low-code development and intelligent workflow technologies.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and implement Pega applications and workflow solutions using platform best practices.

- Configure and customise Pega case management, business processes, and user interfaces.

- Develop solutions using Pega PRPC and low-code development capabilities.

- Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements.

- Build integrations between Pega and enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and system connectors.

- Develop reusable components, rules, and workflows to support scalable application development.

- Support application testing, code reviews, deployment activities, and release management processes.

- Identify and resolve application defects, technical issues, and performance bottlenecks.

- Maintain comprehensive technical documentation and development standards.

- Provide ongoing support and maintenance for deployed Pega applications.

- Promote best practices in Pega development, Agile delivery, and software engineering.

- Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to platform governance activities.

Required Experience

Essential

- 3+ years’ (Associate) 6+ years' (Senior Associate) hands-on Pega development experience.

- Strong experience working with the Pega Platform and Pega BPM solutions.

- Experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise workflow applications.

- Experience integrating Pega with other enterprise systems and applications.

- Experience working with cloud-based Pega environments.

- Strong understanding of:

- Pega Case Management

- Business Process Management (BPM)

- Decisioning and Business Rules

- Integrations and APIs

- User Interface Development

- Application Debugging and Troubleshooting

- Performance Optimisation

- Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Pega Platform Experience

Candidates should demonstrate strong experience in one or more of the following areas:

Pega Customer Service

Experience delivering customer-focused workflow solutions, including:

- Case management

- Service request automation

- Omnichannel customer engagement

- Customer interaction management

- Intelligent routing and workflow automation

Pega Sales Automation

Experience supporting sales and business development processes, including:

- Lead and opportunity management

- Customer onboarding processes

- Workflow orchestration

- Business process automation

- CRM-related integrations

Pega Platform & Workflow Automation

Experience building enterprise workflow solutions, including:

- Case lifecycle management

- Business rules implementation

- Process orchestration

- Workflow automation

- Enterprise system integrations

Desirable Experience

- Pega Certified System Architect (CSA).

- Pega Certified Senior System Architect (CSSA).

- Additional Pega certifications.

- Experience with cloud technologies and modern application architectures.

- Experience with REST and SOAP integrations.

- Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices.

- Experience working within enterprise consulting environments.

- Knowledge of AI-enabled workflow automation and intelligent decisioning.

- Experience mentoring junior developers or supporting development teams.

Training Programme

Before project deployment, successful candidates will complete an intensive 4-week virtual academy delivered by Pega and enterprise technology experts.

The programme covers:

- Advanced Pega Development

- Enterprise Architecture and Design Principles

- Workflow Automation Best Practices

- Integration Patterns and API Development

- Agile Delivery Methodologies

- Consulting and Stakeholder Management Skills

- Project-based technical exercises reflecting real client scenarios

This training has been developed in collaboration with a leading global consulting organisation to ensure consultants are project-ready from day one.

Career Progression

This role offers a structured pathway to accelerate your Pega career through:

- Advanced technical training

- Enterprise project experience

- Exposure to global transformation programmes

- Mentoring from industry experts

- Professional certification support

- Potential long-term opportunities with a leading professional services organisation

About Revolent

Revolent specialises in identifying, developing, and deploying exceptional technology talent. Through our unique talent creation programmes, we help experienced professionals accelerate their careers while supporting organisations undertaking large-scale digital transformation initiatives.

We are seeking a skilled Senior Pega Developer to design, develop, and implement enterprise-level applications using the Pegasystems platform. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in Pega PRPC (Pega Platform), business process management (BPM), and case management solutions, with a focus on delivering scalable and high-quality applications.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop Pega-based applications aligned with business requirements.

- Build and configure Pega rules, flows, UI components, and integrations.

- Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

- Develop BPM workflows, case management, and decisioning components.

- Perform code reviews, unit testing, and debugging to ensure quality delivery.

- Integrate Pega applications with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, messaging, and databases.

- Optimize application performance and ensure compliance with Pega best practices and guardrails.

- Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives).

- Maintain documentation for applications, technical designs, and workflows.

- Support production deployments and resolve post-release issues.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

- 5–10+ years of experience in Pega development.

- Strong experience with Pega PRPC / Pega Platform (version 7.x/8.x or above).

- Proficiency in:

- Case management & BPM concepts

- Data modeling

- UI design (Sections, Harness, Portals)

- Experience with Pega integration tools (REST, SOAP, Connectors/Services).

- Knowledge of Java, SQL, and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

- Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.

- Pega certifications such as:

- CSA (Certified System Architect) – required

- CSSA (Certified Senior System Architect) – preferred

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Pega Decisioning (CDH) or Robotics (RPA).

- Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).

- Knowledge of DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines.

- Experience in industries such as banking, insurance, or telecom.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Soft Skills

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

- Adaptability in a fast-paced environment.
